                                cetanāhetubhūtātiriktātmasambandhamantarā (cetanāyuktaṃ

) kartuṃ na
                                pāryeta, ghaṭādivadacetanatvaprasaṅgāt; cetanāhetuścātmā nityatvena
                                na kriyate, tasmāccetanāhetunityatvena janmāntarasambandhinamātmānaṃ
                                gṛhītvā śarīraṃ cetanaṃ paraḥ karotīti svīkaraṇīyam; evamapi
                                ceśvaradaridrādijagadvaicitryadarśanādātmano
                                dharmādharmayogavaicitryaṃ kalpanīyaṃ; tathāca satyātmana eva
                                dharmādharmasahāyatā+avaśyaṃ svīkaraṇīyā, tasmāt sa eva
                                śarīrādyutpattau kāraṇamastu kimapareṇehātmaviśeṣakalpanena; yadi
                                vā, evamātmanyanekajanmasambandhini
                                saṃsārahetudharmādharmaguṇaśālini siddhe astu
                                    so+apyātmaviśeṣaḥ
na parīkṣā na parīkṣyaṃ na kartā kāraṇaṃ na ca
na devā narṣayaḥ siddhāḥ karma karmaphalaṃ na ca

yadṛcchāvādimataṃ dūṣayati- na parīkṣetyādi|
                                yadṛcchāvādī khalvekamapi pramāṇaṃ nānumanyate, tataśca
                                tasyāprāmāṇikatvāt pramāṇaṃ vinaiva yatkiñcidbruvato na śraddheyaṃ
                                vacanaṃ bhavati, tasmādupekṣaṇīya evāyamiti prakaraṇābhiprāyaḥ|
                                yadṛcchayā aparisthitapakṣatayā, upahata ihalokaparalokānupayukta
                                ātmā yasya sa yadṛcchopahatātmā; tasya parīkṣā nāstīti
                                parīkṣāhetūnāṃ pramāṇānāmabhāvādityarthaḥ; parīkṣyamapi nāsti,
                                parīkṣakapramāṇābhāvādeva; evaṃ kartā+api nāsti tatkāraṇamapi nāsti,
                                pramāṇāsvīkārāditi bhāvaḥ; tathā sarvajanasiddhā devādayo+api na
                                santītyabhidhānena nāstikasya varjanīyatvaṃ darśayati| pātakebhyo
                                brahmāvadhādibhyaḥ; paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ; nāsti paraloka ityādiko graho
                                nāstikagrahaḥ; nāstikabuddhyā hyucchṛṅkhalaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvamapi
                                pātakaṃ karotīti bhāvaḥ||14-15||

nāstikatāparityāgena yathākartavyatāmāha-
                                tasmādityādi| etāmiti nāstikabuddhim| amārge adharme prasṛtā
                                amārgaprasṛtā| buddhireva pradīpo buddhipradīpaḥ, tena
                                pratyakṣādipramāṇena paśyedityarthaḥ| yathātathamiti
                                yathāsvarūpam||16||

dvividhameva khalu sarvaṃ saccāsacca; tasya
                                caturvidhā parīkṣā- āptopadeśaḥ, pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ,
                                yuktiśceti

samprati parapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā
                                svapakṣaparalokasādhanāni pramāṇānyavatārayati- dvividhamityādi|
                                sarvamiti yatkiñcit pramāṇapratīyamānaṃ, taddvividhaṃ;
                                taddvaividhyamāha- saccāsacca; saditi vidhiviṣayapramāṇagamyaṃ
                                bhāvarūpam, asaditi niṣedhaviṣayapramāṇagamyamabhāvarūpam|
                                parīkṣyate vyavasthāpyate vastusvarūpamanayeti parīkṣā pramāṇāni,
                                āptopadeśādaya uttaragranthe sphuṭā bhaviṣyanti||17||

āptopadeśaṃ darśayitumāptameva tāvadāha- āptā
                                ityādi| niḥśeṣeṇa muktā nirmuktāḥ| tapojñānabaleneti
                                rajastamonirmuktau kāraṇatvena yojanīyam| trikālamiti
                                atītānāgatavartamānaviṣayam| amalamiti yathārthagrāhitvena|
                                avyāhatamiti kvacidapi viṣaye+akuṇṭhitaśaktitvena| āptī
                                rajastamorūpadoṣakṣayaḥ, tadyuktā āptāḥ

; śāsati
                                jagatkṛtsnaṃ kāryākāryapravṛttinivṛttyupadeśeneti śiṣṭāḥ; boddhavyaṃ
                                viśeṣeṇa buddhametairiti vibuddhāḥ; āptāḥ, śiṣṭāḥ, vibuddhā iti
                                sañjñātrayeṇāptānāṃ loke prasiddhiṃ darśayati; teṣāmāptānāṃ
                                vākyamasaṃśayaṃ niścitaṃ satyaṃ yathārthamityarthaḥ|
                                tadvākyasatyatve hetumāha- vakṣanti te kasmādasatyaṃ nīrajastamā
                                iti| nīrajastamā iti tamappratyayāntaḥ śabdaḥ, tena
                                nīrajastvaprakarṣeṇa tamo+api vyudastaṃ bhavati; na hi sarvathā
                                nīrajaske puruṣe tamo bhavati; yaduktaṃ- “nārajaskaṃ tamaḥ” (vi.a.6)
                                iti| vakṣanti te kasmādasatyaṃ na kasmādapītyarthaḥ; asatyaṃ
                                mithyājñānādvā+abhidhīyate, samyagjñāne satyapi rāgadveṣābhyāṃ
                                vā+abhidhīyate, tacca tritayamapi mithyājñānarāgadveṣarūpaṃ
                                rajastamonirmukte sattvaguṇodrekādamalavijñāne na
                                sambhavatītyarthaḥ; yadi vā ‘nīrajastamaso mṛṣā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sugamaḥ|
                                etaccāptalakṣaṇaṃ sahajāptabrahmādyabhiprāyeṇa, laukikānāṃ tu
                                puruṣāṇāmāptatvaṃ prativiṣayasamyagjñānasambhavane
                                tadviṣayarāgadveṣāsambhavena ca boddhavyam; etena, āptopadeśa iti
                                śabdarūpapramāṇalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati; buddhipramāṇapakṣe tu,
                                āptopadeśajanitā buddhiḥ pramāṇamiti boddhavyam||18-19||

pratyakṣalakṣaṇamāha- ātmendriyetyādi|
                                sannikarṣāditi sambandhāt; sa ca sambandhaḥ- saṃyogaḥ, samavāyaḥ,
                                saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ, saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyaḥ, samavetasamavāyaḥ,
                                viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇo boddhavyaḥ| vyaktā ityanena
                                vyabhicāriṇīmayathārthabuddhiṃ saṃśayaṃ ca nirākaroti| tadātve
                                tatkṣaṇam; anena ca pratyakṣajñānānantarotpannānumānajñānaṃ smaraṇaṃ
                                ca paramparayā+a+atmendriyamanorthasannikarṣajaṃ

vyavacchinatti; ātmādicatuṣṭayasannikarṣābhidhānaṃ ca
                                pratyakṣakāraṇābhidhānaparaṃ; tena, ‘indriyārthasannikarṣāt
                                pravartate yā’ ityetāvadeva lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam; etena
                                sukhādiviṣayamapi pratyakṣaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhavati; tatra hi
                                catuṣṭayasannikarṣo nāsti, ātmasannikarṣastu
                                pramāṇajñānasādhāraṇatvenaiva lakṣaṇānupayuktaḥ

| iha ca
                                pratyakṣaphalarūpā+api buddhiḥ pratyakṣaśabdenābhidhīyate, tathaiva
                                lokavyavahārāt; paramārthatastu yato bhavatīndriyāderīdṛśī
                                buddhistat pratyakṣam||20||
vyaktā tadātve yā buddhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ sa nirucyate

anumānasvarūpamāha- pratyakṣetyādi|
                                pratyakṣagrahaṇaṃ vyāptigrāhakapramāṇopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena
                                pratyakṣapūrvamiti vyāptigrāhakapramāṇapūrvakam|
                                trividhamityanenānumānatraividdhyaṃ darśayati; tena, kāryāt
                                kāraṇānumānaṃ, yathā- garbhadarśanānmaithunānumānaṃ; tathā kāraṇāt
                                kāryānumānaṃ, yathā- bījāt sahakārikāraṇāntarayuktāt phalānumānaṃ;
                                tathā+akāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ ca sāmānyato darśanādanumānaṃ, yathā-
                                dhūmādvartamānakṣaṇasambandhādagnyanumānam; etattrividhamanumānaṃ
                                gṛhītaṃ bhavati| trikālamityanena trikālaviṣayatvamanumānasya
                                darśayati| anumīyate ityatra ‘yena tadanumānam’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ|
                                tena, vyāptigrahaṇādanu anantaraṃ mīyate samyaṅniścīyate parokṣārtho
                                yena tadanumānaṃ, vyāptismaraṇasahāyaliṅgadarśanamityarthaḥ|
                                trividhamiti yaduktaṃ tasyodāharaṇaṃ darśayati- vahnirityādi| etacca
                                    vyākṛtameva

| nigūḍhaḥ
                                adṛśyamānaḥ| evaṃ vyavasyantyatītamiti vyavacchedaḥ| bījāditi
                                sahakārikāraṇāntarajalakarṣaṇādiyuktāditi boddhavyam| anāgataṃ
                                phalaṃ sadṛśaṃ vyavasyantīti sambandhaḥ| dṛṣṭvā bījāt phalaṃ
                                jātamityanena bījaphalayoḥ kāraṇakāryalakṣaṇāṃ vyāptiṃ darśayati;
                                yadyapi ca kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vyabhicarati, yato nāvaśyaṃ bījasadbhāve
                                phalaṃ bhavati, tathā+api sahakārikāraṇāntarayuktaṃ bījaṃ phalaṃ na
                                vyabhicaratītyabhiprāyo boddhavyaḥ; kāraṇasāmagrī ca kāryaṃ na
                                vyabhicaratyeva||21-22||
dṛṣṭvā bījāt phalaṃ jātamihaiva sadṛśaṃ budhāḥ

tāvaddarśayati,
                                udāharaṇe jñāte yukterlakṣaṇaṃ sukhena jñāyate ityabhiprāyeṇa-
                                jalakarṣaṇetyādi| karṣaṇaśabdena karṣaṇasaṃskṛtā bhūmirgṛhyate,
                                jalakarṣaṇabījartusaṃyogāt sasyasya sambhavo bhavatīti yajjñānaṃ
                                tadyuktiriti yojanīyam| ṣaḍdhātusaṃyogāt pañcamahābhūtātmasaṃyogāt|
                                tathāśabdo yuktirityākarṣati| mathyaṃ manthanakāṣṭhayantrakaṃ,
                                kāṣṭhaṃ manthanaṃ, manthānaṃ kāṣṭhabhrāmaṇaṃ; kiṃvā ‘manthaka’ iti
                                pāṭhaḥ, tatra manthānaṃ bhrāmyamāṇakāṣṭhaṃ; saṃyogānmelakāditi
                                boddhavyaṃ, yato manthanasya kriyārūpasya saṃyogo na saṅgacchate;
                                kiṃvā manthanaśabdena manthanarajjurucyate| yujyate
                                sambadhyate+anayeti yuktiḥ, tayā yuktā yuktiyuktā| catuṣpāda iti
                                vaktavye sampadgrahaṇaṃ guṇavaccatuṣpādagrahaṇārtham||23-24||

samprati yukterlakṣaṇamāha- buddhirityādi| yā
                                buddhirbhāvān paśyati viṣayīkaroti, bahukāraṇayogo bahūpapattiyogaḥ,
                                janiścāyaṃ jñānārthe, tena bahūpapattiyogajñāyamānānarthān yā
                                buddhiḥ paśyati ūhalakṣaṇā sā yuktiriti pramāṇasahāyībhūtā|
                                evamanena bhavitavyamityevaṃrūpa ūho+atra yuktiśabdenābhidhīyate; sā
                                ca paramārthato+apramāṇabhūtā+api vastuparicchede pramāṇasahāyatvena
                                vyāpriyamāṇatvāt, tathā tayaiva ūharūpayā prāyo lokānāṃ
                                vyavahārādiha pramāṇatvenoktā| ata eva pradeśāntare yuktiṃ vinā
                                yathoktaṃ pramāṇatrayaṃ darśayiṣyati- “trividhā vā (parīkṣā)
                                sahopadeśena” (vi. a.4) iti vacanāt| tathā, upamānaṃ gṛhītvā
                                rogabhiṣagjitīye śabdādīni catvāri pramāṇānyabhidhāsyati| trikālā
                                vartamānātītānāgataviṣayā; trikālaviṣayatvaṃ
                                cāsyāstrikālānumānaviṣayopadeśakatvenaiva| trivargasādhakatvaṃ ca
                                trivargasādhanādeva, ūhenaiva hi prāyastrivargānuṣṭhāne
                                pravṛttirbhavati; (pramāṇaparicchedena

tu pracāro virala
                                eva|) yattu bahukāraṇajalakarṣaṇabījartusaṃyogādbhāvisasyajñānaṃ
                                yuktirucyate, taccānumānānnārthāntarabhūtaṃ; tatrānumānādbhedo
                                duṣkara iti nādriyāmahe; kiñca kāraṇebhyaḥ kāryaṃ pratīyamānaṃ na
                                kadā+api vartamānaṃ pratīyate, tataśca trikāleti parāhataṃ syāt|
                                atra śāntarakṣitakamalaśīlābhyāṃ yuktipramāṇāntarasvīkāre
                                pūrvapakṣasiddhāntāvuktau- “yasmin sati bhavatyeva na bhavatyasatīti
                                ca| tasmādato bhavatyetadyuktireṣā+abhidhīyate||
                                pramāṇāntaramevedamityāha carakā muniḥ| nānumānamiyaṃ
                                yasmāddṛṣṭānto+atra na vidyate” (ta.saṃ.kā.1692-93) iti|
                                etacchāntarakṣitavacanaṃ kamalaśīlena vyākhyātaṃ-
                                “tadbhāvabhāvitvena yā tatkāryatāpratītiriyaṃ yuktiḥ; iyaṃ ca
                                savikalpatvānna pratyakṣaṃ; nāpyanumānaṃ dṛṣṭāntābhāvāt, tathāhi-
                                dṛṣṭānto+api- ata eva tadbhāvabhāvitvāttatkāryatāpratipattiḥ,
                                tatrāpi dṛṣṭānto+anyo+anveṣaṇīyaḥ

, tatrāpyapara ityanavasthā syāt; tasmāt pramāṇāntaraṃ
                                yuktirityāha carako vaidyaḥ; evaṃ pūrvapakṣamutthāpya dūṣitaṃ yat-
                                “kāryakāraṇabhāvasya pratipattirna saṅgatā| tasmādasyāṃ na
                                bhedo+asti sādhyasādhanayoryataḥ|| tadbhāvavyavahāre tu yogyatāyāḥ
                                prasādhane| saṅketakālavijñāto vidyate+artho nidarśanam”
                                (ta.saṃ.kā.1696-48)| etadvyākhyātaṃ kamalaśīlena- “yuktau na
                                sādhyasādhanayorbhedaḥ; tathāhi- atra tadbhāvabhāvitā hetuḥ,
                                kāryakāraṇatā ca sādhyā, na cānayorbheda upalabhyate
                                paryāyatvāttarupādapavat; atha mataṃ- na

kāryakāraṇatā
                                sādhyate kintarhi tadbhāvavyavahāra iti, tatrāha- tadbhāvavyavahāre
                                ityādi; tasyā hetuphalatāyā bhāvastadbhāvaḥ, tatra vyavahāro yaḥ sa
                                tadbhāvavyavahāraḥ jñānābhidhānapravṛttilakṣaṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ, tasmin
                                yogyatā mūḍhaṃ prati sādhyate; ye
                                yadvyāpārānantaraniyatopalambhasvabhāvāste tatkāryavyavahārayogyāḥ,
                                tadyathā- saṅketakālānubhūtāḥ kulālādivyāpārānantaropalambhasvabhāvā
                                ghaṭādayaḥ; tathā ca tālvādivyāpārānantaraniyatopalambhasvabhāvāḥ
                                śabdā iti svabhāvo hetuḥ; tataśca sa dṛṣṭāntatvādanumānādabhedo
                                yukteḥ”| etau ca pūrvapakṣasiddhāntau
                                    evambhūtayuktyasvīkārādevāpratividheyau
yuktistrikālā sā jñeyā trivargaḥ sādhyate yayā
eṣā parīkṣā nāstyanyā yayā sarvaṃ parīkṣyate

upasaṃharati- eṣetyādi|
                                nāstyanyetivacanenārthāpattyasambhavādīnāmanyatantramatānāṃ
                                pramāṇānāṃ niṣedhaṃ karoti| prastute parīkṣāṃ prayojayati- tayā
                                cāsti upalabhyate ca punarbhava iti||26||

tatra śabdasya punarbhavapratipādakatvaṃ
                                darśayati- tatrā+a+aptāgama ityādi| prathamaṃ vedaṃ pradarśayan
                                vedasya nirastavibhramāśaṅkaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ darśayati,
                                yaścānyo+apītyanena granthena vedārthāviparītatvādibhirhetubhiḥ
                                paricchedanīyaprāmāṇyāyurvedasmṛtiśāstrādīni darśayati| śāstrarūpo
                                vādaḥ śāstravādaḥ| āptāgamāditi vedāt| yajñaḥ agniṣṭomādiḥ;
                                brahmācaryam upasthasaṃyamādi| abhyudayaḥ svargaḥ, niḥśreyasaṃ
                                mokṣaḥ; atra yathāyogyatayā svargasya mokṣasya ca kāraṇamiti
                                boddhavyam| etena
                                janmāntarabhogyasvargānekajanmalabhyamokṣopadeśenātmanaḥ paralokaḥ
                                kathito bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||27||

, yaścānyo+api kaścidvedārthādaviparītaḥ parīkṣakaiḥ
                                praṇītaḥ śiṣṭānumato lokānugrahapravṛttaḥ śāstravādaḥ, sa
                                cā+a+aptāgamaḥ;
                                āptāgamādupalabhyatedānatapoyajñasatyāhiṃsābrahmacaryāṇyabhyudayaniḥśreyasakarāṇīti

āgamāntaramāha- na cetyādi| anativṛttau
                                avanupaśāntau sattvadoṣau manodoṣau rajastamorūpau yeṣāṃ te tathā,
                                teṣām; punarbhavo mokṣaḥ, dharmadvāreṣu dharmaśāstreṣu, adoṣaiḥ
                                nirmanodoṣairmaharṣibhiḥ, upadiśyate na, iti sambandhaḥ; tena
                                punarbhava upadiśyate ityarthaḥ||28||

āgamāntaramṛṣivacanamāha- dharmadvāretyādi|
                                brahmā adhyātmajñānaṃ, tatparaiḥ| karmavidbhiḥ
                                anuṣṭhātavyayāgādikarmavidbhiḥ| anupahatasattvaguṇo buddheḥ pracāro
                                bodhalakṣaṇo yeṣāṃ te tathā, etena viśuddhabuddhitvaṃ darśayati|
                                divyamatīndriyārthadarśi cakṣuḥ samādhirūpaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te
                                divyacakṣuṣaḥ, taiḥ| dṛṣṭvopadiṣṭaḥ svayamanubhūya kathita
                                ityarthaḥ| itiśabdo hetau| evamiti āgamena||29||

pratyakṣaṃ ca yadyapi punarbhavaṃ na gṛhṇāti,
                                tathā+api tat punarbhavagrāhakānumānasya liṅgagrahaṇe yathā
                                vyāpriyate tathā darśayati- pratyakṣamapītyādi| visadṛśānīti kaścit
                                kurūpaḥ, kaścit surūpaḥ| tulyasambhavānāṃ tulyotpādakāraṇānāṃ
                                kaścidgauraḥ kaścit kṛṣṇaḥ, evaṃ svarādāvapi viśeṣo boddhavyaḥ|
                                dāsyaiśvaryamiti kasyaciddāsyaṃ kasyacidaiśvaryam| evamaparatrāpi
                                viparyayaḥ puruṣabhedena boddhavyaḥ| sukhāsukhamiti āyuṣo viśeṣaṇam|
                                ruditādayo+amī avyutpannabālagocaratayā boddhavyāḥ; ete ca
                                ruditādayo yathāyogamiṣṭāniṣṭasmaraṇamantarā na bhavanti, smaraṇaṃ
                                ca pūrvajñānaṃ vinā na bhavatīti pūrvajanmajñānānumānāt
                                paralokānumāyakā bhavanti| pūrvapratipāditaṃ ca
                                visadṛśatvādivaicitryamuttaratra pratipādanīyaṃ ca
                                lakṣaṇotpattyādikāraṇāntarādarśane sati
                                pūrvajanmakṛtakāraṇānumāyakamiti paralokānumāyakaṃ mantavyam|
                                lakṣaṇotpattiriti sāmudrakalakṣaṇapratipāditalakṣaṇotpattiḥ|
                                karmasādṛśye sevādisādṛśye| medhā kvacit karmaṇi
                                citralekhanāstravidyādau| jāteratītāyāḥ smaraṇaṃ jātismaraṇaṃ;
                                tadeva smaraṇaṃ darśayati- ihāgamanamitaścyutānāmiti; iha kule
                                jāto+asmi, itaśca kulādāgato+asmītyevamākāraṃ jātismaraṇamityarthaḥ
                                yadi vā, iha janmani cyutānāmiha janmani punarāgamanam, anena ca

’ ucyate| prākṛtamiti janmādipravṛttaṃ

arthānām indriyārthānām| karmaṇaḥ

                                atiprabhāvatām ātapāgniprabhṛtīnām| atra hīnamātradarśanaṃ vikāraṃ

                                sparśanarasanayoḥ samyagyoge+asamyagyoge ca bahavaḥ

                                prakṛtisaṃyogasaṃskārādayaśca kāraṇatvena vaktavyāḥ|
                                atimātrastanitaṃ pravṛddho meghadhvaniḥ, paṭahaḥ paṭahaśabdaḥ,

;

                                darśitaṃ bhavati||38||

, cetaḥ- samavāyi,
                                sparśanavyāptervyāpakamapi ca cetaḥ; tasmāt sarvendriyāṇāṃ
                                vyāpakasparśakṛto yo bhāvaviśeṣaḥ, so+ayamanupaśayāt
                                pañcavidhastrividhavikalpo bhavatyasātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ;
                                sātmyārtho hyupaśayārthaḥ

arthānāmayogātiyogamithyāyogānabhidhāya
                                karmaṇastānāha- karmetyādi| atra yadyapi
                                bhūripradhānaśarīrarogakartṛtvena pūrvaṃ śārīrameva
                                karmāsātmyamabhidhātuṃ yujyate, tathā+apyalpatvena vāṅmanase karmaṇī
                                pūrvamukte, pratyekamithyāyogakathane tu prādhānyācchārīra eva
                                mithyāyogaḥ prathamaṃ darśitaḥ|
                                atrātiyogarūpā+atipravṛttistathā+ayogarūpā+apravṛttirvihitānāṃ
                                kāyavāṅmanaḥ karmaṇāṃ boddhavyā, ahitācaraṇasya tu sarvasya
                                mithyāyogatvena vaktavyatvāt| vegodīraṇam aprāptavegodīraṇam|
                                viṣamaśabdo+aṅgapraṇidhānāntaiḥ sabadhyate| aṅgadūṣaṇam
                                atikaṇḍūyanādibhiḥ| saṅkleśanaṃ

madyātapajalasecanādibhiḥ| abaddhavacanam
                                asambaddhṃ yāvattāvatkīrtanam| anupacāravacanam| iha
                                cānṛtavacanādayo+adharmadvāreṇa rogakarāḥ||39||

tatra vāṅmanaḥśarīrātipravṛttiratiyogaḥ;
                                sarvaśo+apravṛttirayogaḥ;
                                vegadhāraṇodīraṇaviṣamaskhalanapatanāṅgapraṇidhānāṅgapradūṣaṇaprahāramardanaprāṇoparodhasaṅkleśanādiḥ
                                śārīro mithyāyogaḥ,
                                sūcakānṛtākālakalahāpriyābaddhānupacāraparuṣavacanādirvāṅmithyāyogaḥ,
                                bhayaśokakrodhalobhamohamānerṣyāmithyādarśanādirmānaso
                                mithyāyogaḥ

saṅgraheṇa cātiyogāyogavarjaṃ karma
                                vāṅmanaḥśarīrajamahitamanupadiṣṭaṃ yattacca mithyāyogaṃ vidyāt

anuktamithyāyogasaṅgrahārthamāha-
                                saṅgraheṇetyādi| ahitamiha janmani, anupadiṣṭamityanena
                                paraloke+adharmahetutayā pāpakārakaṃ paradārasevādi grāhayati; etena
                                yaducyate- adharmasyāgrahaṇānnyūnametadāyatanakathanamiti, tanna
                                bhavati|
                                śārīramānasikavācanikakarmamithyāyogenaivādharmotpādāvāntaravyāpāreṇādharmajanyānāṃ
                                vikārāṇāṃ kriyamāṇatvāt, yathā- agniṣṭomena svargaḥ kriyate
                                dharmotpādāvāntaravyāpāreṇaiva; anye tu kālamithyāyoge+adharmaṃ
                                kṣipanti, adharmo hi kālavaśādeva phalati na tatkālamiti kṛtvā;
                                etacca prathamādhyāya eva prapañcitam||40||

iti trividhavikalpaṃ trividhameva karma
                                prajñāparādha iti vyavasyet

samprati karmāsamyagyogaḥ prajñāparādhamūlatvāt
                                prajñāparādha evocyata iti trividhamityādinā darśayan, yaduktaṃ
                                pūrvaṃ hetutrayakathane “asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ prajñāparādhaḥ
                                pariṇāmaśca” ityasyāvirodhaṃ darśayati; evaṃ yadagre vakṣyati ‘kālaḥ
                                punaḥ pariṇāma ucyate’ tatrāpi pūrvoktāvirodhopadarśanaṃ
                                vyākhyeyamiti| trividhavikalpamihātiyogādirūpam||41||

tatrātimātrasvalakṣaṇaḥ kālaḥ kālātiyogaḥ, hīnasvalakṣaṇaḥ
                                (kālaḥ) kālāyogaḥ, yathāsvalakṣaṇaviparītalakṣaṇastu (kālaḥ)
                                kālamithyāyogaḥ

kālātiśayayogādīn darśayati- śītoṣṇetyādi|
                                atimātrasvalakṣaṇaḥ atimātraśītādiḥ|
                                yathāsvalakṣaṇācchītāderviparītalakṣaṇo yathā- hemante varṣaṇaṃ,
                                varṣāsu śītamityādi||42||

āyatanānyupasaṃharati- itītyādi| vikārāṇāṃ
                                hetavo bhavantīti sambandhaḥ; tathā samayogayuktāḥ samyagyogayuktāḥ
                                prakṛtihetavo bhavantīti yojyaṃ; prakṛtiḥ ārogyam||43||

sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāṃ bhāvābhāvau nāntareṇa
                                yogāyogātiyogamithyāyogān samupalabhyete; yathāsvayuktyapekṣiṇau hi
                                bhāvābhāvau

idānīṃ dhātusāmyavaiṣamyahetutvena
                                samyagyogāyogau ca pratipādya bāhyānāmapi vṛkṣaghaṭādīnāṃ
                                samyaksthitivināśayoḥ samyagyogāyogāveva kāraṇamiti dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ
                                bhāvasvarūpajñānārthaṃ cāha- sarveṣāmityādi| bhāvaḥ
                                samyagavasthānam, abhāvaḥ, asamyagavasthānaṃ vināśo vā; yogāt
                                samyagyogādbhāvaḥ, ayogādibhyo+abhāvaḥ; yathāsvaṃ yuktiryā yasya
                                bhāvasyābhāvasya vā yuktiḥ svakāraṇayuktiḥ, tadapekṣiṇau bhavata iti
                                sambandhaḥ| yathā- vṛkṣasya bhāve
                                avasthāne+anatyalpapānīyayogādiryuktiḥ, abhāve tu vṛkṣasya
                                pānīyātapātiyogāyogau tathā vajrapātādiryuktiḥ; tatastadapekṣau
                                vṛkṣasya bhāvābhāvau bhavata ityādi kalpanīyam||44||

tatra nijaḥ śārīradoṣasamutthaḥ,
                                āganturbhūtaviṣavāyvagnisamprahārādisamutthaḥ, mānasaḥ punariṣṭasya
                                lābhāllābhāccāniṣṭasyopajāyate

rogānāha- trayo rogā ityādi| iṣṭalābhājjāyate
                                kāmaharṣādiḥ, aniṣṭapriyaviyogādilābhācca śokādayaḥ; yadi vā
                                ‘iṣṭasyālābhāllābhāccāniṣṭasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ; atra tu pāṭhe
                                cakārādiṣṭalābho+api heturboddhavyaḥ||45||

samprati mānasavyādhicikitsāyā
                                alpavaktavyatvenehaiva taccikitsāmāha- tatretyādi|
                                mānasavyādhiparītenāpīti apiśabdena śārīravyādhiyuktenāpi
                                vakṣyamāṇamanuṣṭheyamiti sūcayati| trayametaddharmārthakāmarūpaṃ
                                mānasaṃ sukhaṃ vā mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā niṣpadyata iti yojyam| tadvidya
                                iha mānasavyādhibheṣajavedī| ātmadeśetyādi|- ko+ahaṃ, kiṃ me
                                hitamityātmajñānaṃ; ko deśaḥ, asmin kimucitamiti deśajñānam; evaṃ
                                kālādāvapi jñānaṃ boddhavyam||46||

tatra buddhimatā mānasavyādhiparītenāpi satā
                                buddhyā hitāhitamavekṣyāvekṣya dharmārthakāmānāmahitānāmanupasevane
                                hitānāṃ copasevane prayatitavyaṃ, na hyantareṇa loke
                                trayametanmānasaṃ kiñcinniṣpadyate sukhaṃ vā duḥkhaṃ vā;
                                tasmādetaccānuṣṭheyaṃ- tadvidyānāṃ

bhavati cātra- mānasaṃ prati bhaiṣajyaṃ
                                trivargasyānvavekṣaṇam

sampratyamumevārthaṃ sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ
                                ślokenāha- mānasaṃ pratītyādi|- mānasaṃ vikāramiti bhāvaḥ|
                                trivargasya dharmādeḥ||47||

‘pratirogamārgān’ iti,
                                    ‘prati prati rogamārgān’ iti ca pā.;

- traya ityādi|
                                marmāsthisandhibhyāmeko mārgaḥ| atra śākhetisañjñākaraṇaṃ
                                vyavahārārthaṃ, tathā raktādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ śākhābhidheyānāṃ
                                vṛkṣaśākhātulyatvena bāhyatvajñāpanārtham| tvakceti tvakśabdena
                                tadāśrayo raso+api gṛhyate; sākṣāttu rasānabhidhānaṃ hṛdayasthāyino
                                rasasya
                                    śākhāsañjñāvyavacchedārthaṃ

, tasya hi koṣṭhagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam; anena
                                nyāyena yakṛtplīhāśritaṃ ca śoṇitaṃ koṣṭhatvenaivābhipretamiti
                                boddhavyaṃ, samānanyāyatvāt

|
                                uktaṃ ca koṣṭhavivaraṇe- “sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya
                                ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phuphphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate” (su.ci. a.2)
                                iti| asthisandhivivaraṇam- asthisaṃyogā ityādi| tatreti
                                asthisandhau| kaṇḍarā iha tantre sthūlasnāyuḥ| āmasya pakvasya
                                cāśaya āmapakvāśayaḥ| etacca mārgabhedakathanaṃ tadāśritavyādhīnāṃ
                                sukhasādhyatvādijñānārtham||48||

trayo rogamārgā iti- śākhā, marmāsthisandhayaḥ,
                                koṣṭhaśca

tatra śākhā raktādayo dhātavastvak ca, sa bāhyo
                                rogamārgaḥ; marmāṇi punarbastihṛdayamūrdhādīni,
                                asthisandhayo+asthisaṃyogāstatropanibaddhāśca
                                    snāyukaṇḍarāḥ

,
                                sa madhyamo rogamārgaḥ; koṣṭhaḥ punarucyate mahāsrotaḥ śarīramadhyaṃ
                                mahānimnamāmapakvāśayaśceti paryāyaśabdaistantre, sa rogamārga
                                ābhyantaraḥ

tatra,
                                gaṇḍapiḍakālajyapacīcarmakīlādhimāṃsamaṣakakuṣṭhavyaṅgādayo vikārā
                                bahirmārgajāśca visarpaśvayathugulmārśovidradhyādayaḥ śākhānusāriṇo
                                bhavanti rogāḥ;
                                pakṣavadhagrahāpatānakārditaśoṣarājayakṣmāsthisandhiśūlagudabhraṃśādayaḥ
                                śirohṛdbastirogādayaśca madhyamamārgānusāriṇo bhavanti rogāḥ;
                                jvarātīsāracchardyalasakavisūcikākāsaśvāsahikkānāhodaraplīhādayo+antarmārgajāśca
                                visarpaśvayathugulmārśovidradhyādayaḥ koṣṭhānusāriṇo bhavanti
                                rogāḥ

samprati yanmārgāśrito yo rogo bhavati taṃ
                                darśayati- tatra gaṇḍetyādi| bahirmārgajāśceti visarpādīnāṃ
                                viśeṣaṇaṃ visarpādayo hyantarmārgabhājo+api
                                sambhavantyatastadvyudāsārtham| pakṣaśabdo vadhagrahābhyāṃ
                                sambadhyate, śoṣo dhātuśoṣaḥ| jvaro yadyapi sarvaśarīraga eva,
                                tathā+api viśeṣeṇāmāśayasamutthatvādihocyate| antarmārgajāśceti
                                visarpādiviśeṣaṇam| arśo bahirvalyāśritaṃ śākhāgatam, anyacca
                                koṣṭhagatam| bahirmārgajo gulmo yo bahiruttuṇḍita upalabhyate
                                bahiśca pacyate sa jñeyaḥ, anyastu sarvaḥ koṣṭhagata eva||49||

trividhā bhiṣaja iti- bhiṣakchadmacarāḥ santi
                                santyeke siddhasādhitāḥ

bhiṣakchadmacarā bhiṣagveśacarāḥ| siddhena
                                prasiddhena sādhitāḥ siddhasādhitāḥ| vaidyabhāṇḍaṃ bastinetrādi|
                                pratirūpakā vaidyasadṛśāḥ| vyapadeśaḥ anyasambandhena kīrtanam|
                                atadvidhā jñānahīnāḥ||50-53||

tatra daivavyapāśrayaṃ-
                                mantrauṣadhimaṇimaṅgalabalyupahārahomaniyamaprāyaścittopavāsasvastyayanapraṇipātagamanādi,
                                yuktivyapāśrayaṃ- punarāhārauṣadhadravyāṇāṃ yojanā, sattvāvajayaḥ-
                                punarahitebhyo+arthebhyo manonigrahaḥ

daivamadṛṣṭaṃ tadvyapāśrayaṃ, tacca
                                yadadṛṣṭajananena vyādhipratyanīkaṃ mantrādi; yadi vā daivaśabdena
                                devā ucyante, tānāśritya yadupakaroti tattathā; mantrādayo hi
                                devaprabhāvādeva vyādhiharāḥ, balyupahārādiprītāśca devā eva
                                prabhāvādvyādhīn ghnanti| atra
                                daivavyapāśrayamādāvuktamāśuvyādhiharatvena| praṇipāto devādīnāṃ
                                śārīro namaskāraḥ, gamanaṃ vidūradevādigamanam||54||

śarīradoṣaprakope khalu śarīramevāśritya
                                prāyaśastrividhamauṣadhamicchanti- antaḥparimārjanaṃ,
                                bahiḥparimārjanaṃ, śastrapraṇidhānaṃ ceti

samprati prakārāntareṇopayuktaṃ
                                bheṣajatraividhyamāha- śarīretyādi| prāyaḥśabdaḥ śarīradoṣakopa
                                ityanena sambadhyate; tena, mānasadoṣaje+apyunmādāpasmārādāvañjanādi
                                bhavatīti darśayati; yadi vā prāyastrividhamityanena śārīre+api
                                daivavyapāśrayaṃ svastyayanādi darśayati||55||

vaidyabhedābhidhānaprasaṅgenāturabhedamāha-
                                prājña ityādi| śarma sukhamārogyamiti yāvat| pramādaḥ buddhvā+api
                                rogamapratīkāraḥ| sañjñā samyagjñānaṃ vyādhirayaṃ tvarayā
                                pratikartavya evamākāram| trātāraṃ vaidyamanāsādya; tathāvidhaṃ hi
                                rogiṇaṃ vaidyo nopasarpatīti bhāvaḥ| bālaḥ ajñaḥ| godhādṛṣṭāntena
                                jīvanārthaṃ yatnaṃ kurvannapi vipadyata iti darśayati| pratikurvīta
                                ‘yatnam’ iti śeṣaḥ||56-63||

bhavanti cātra- prājño roge samutpanne
                                bāhyenābhyantareṇa vā
bālastu khalu mohādvā pramādādvā na budhyate
tathāvidhaṃ ca kaḥ śakto durbalaṃ vyādhipīḍitam
tasmāt prāgeva rogebhyo rogeṣu taruṇeṣu vā

tatra ślokau- eṣaṇāḥ samupastambhā balaṃ
                                kāraṇamāmayāḥ

saṅgrahe dhīmatā bhāvā iti chedaḥ; aṣṭau bhāvā
                                iti sambandhaḥ| bhāveṣu viṣayeṣu| asaktena aprasaktena| yeṣu
                                eṣaṇādiṣvaṣṭasu| sarvamiti dharmārthakāmāḥ||64-65||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                ślokasthāne tisraiṣaṇīyo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne
                                nirdeśacatuṣke tisraiṣaṇīyo nāmaikādaśo+adhyāyaḥ||11||

pūrvādhyāye rogāḥ
                                svarūpamārgabāhyakāraṇabheṣajairabhihitāḥ,
                                upayuktajñānāstatkāraṇavātādayo bahuvācyatvānnoktāḥ, ataḥ samprati
                                pṛthakprakaraṇe te+abhidhīyante vātakalākalīye; tatrāpi
                                prādhānyādvāyureva prathamamucyate| kalā guṇaḥ, yaduktaṃ-
                                “ṣoḍaśakalam” (sū.a.10) iti; akalā guṇaviruddho doṣaḥ; tena
                                vātakalākalīyo vātaguṇadoṣīya ityarthaḥ; yadi vā kalā sūkṣmo bhāgaḥ,
                                tasyāpi kalā kalākalā; tasyāpi

vātakalākalājñānamadhikṛtya parasparamatāni
                                jijñāsamānāḥ samupaviśya maharṣayaḥ papracchuranyo+anyaṃ- kiṅguṇo
                                vāyuḥ, kimasya prakopaṇam, upaśamanāni vā+asya kāni, kathaṃ
                                cainamasaṅghātavantamanavasthitamanāsādya prakopaṇapraśamanāni
                                prakopayanti praśamayanti vā, kāni cāsya kupitākupitasya
                                śarīrāśarīracarasya śarīreṣu carataḥ karmāṇi bahiḥśarīrebhyoveti

atrānekarṣivacanarūpatayā vātādiguṇavacanaṃ
                                bahvṛṣisammatidarśanārthaṃ tantradharmaitihyayuktatvakaraṇārthaṃ ca|
                                asaṅghātamiti pittaśleṣmavadavayavasaṅghātarahitam| anavasthitamiti
                                calasvabhāvam| anāsādyeti calatvenānibiḍāvayatvena ceti
                                mantavyam||3||

atrovāca kuśaḥ sāṅkṛtyāyanaḥ-
                                rūkṣalaghuśītadāruṇakharaviśadāḥ ṣaḍime vātaguṇā bhavanti

rūkṣādayo bhāvapradhānāḥ, tena rūkṣatvādayo guṇā
                                mantavyāḥ| dāruṇatvaṃ calatvaṃ calatvāt, evaṃ dīrghañjīvitīyoktaṃ
                                calatvamuktaṃ bhavati; yadi vā, dāruṇatvaṃ śoṣaṇatvāt kāṭhinyaṃ
                                karotīti||4||

tacchrutvā vākyaṃ kumāraśirā bharadvāja uvāca-
                                evametadyathā bhagavānāha, eta eva vātaguṇā bhavanti, sa
                                tvevaṅguṇairevandravyairevamprabhāvaiśca
                                karmabhirabhyasyamānairvāyuḥ prakopamāpadyate, samānaguṇābhyāso hi
                                dhātūnāṃ vṛddhikāraṇamiti

tacchrutvā vākyaṃ kāṅkāyano bāhlīkabhiṣaguvāca-
                                evametadyathā bhagavānāha, etānyeva vātaprakopaṇāni bhavanti; ato
                                viparītāni vātasya praśamanāni bhavanti, prakopaṇaviparyayo hi
                                dhātūnāṃ praśamakāraṇamiti

tacchrutvā vākyaṃ baḍiśo dhāmārgava uvāca-
                                evametadyathā bhagavānāha, etānyeva vātaprakopapraśamanāni
                                bhavanti

yathā hyenamasaṅghātamanavasthitamanāsādya
                                prakopaṇapraśamanāni prakopayanti praśamayanti vā,
                                tathā+anuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ- vātaprakopaṇāni khalu
                                rūkṣalaghuśītadāruṇakharaviśadaśuṣirakarāṇi śarīrāṇāṃ, tathāvidheṣu
                                śarīreṣu vāyurāśrayaṃ gatvā+a+apyāyamānaḥ prakopamāpadyate;
                                vātapraśamanāni punaḥsnigdhagurūṣṇaślakṣṇamṛdupicchilaghanakarāṇi
                                śarīrāṇāṃ, tathāvidheṣu śarīreṣu vāyurasajyamānaścaran
                                praśāntimāpadyate

śarīrāṇāmiti śarīrāvayavānām| śuṣirakarāṇi
                                randhrakarāṇi| āśrayamiti samānaguṇasthānam| āpyāyamānaḥ cīyamānaḥ|
                                dāruṇaviparīto mṛduḥ, śuṣiraviparīto ghanaḥ| asajyamānaḥ
                                anavatiṣṭhamānaḥ, kṣīyamāṇāvayava iti yāvat| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati-
                                yadyapi vāyunā vātakāraṇānāṃ vātaśamanānāṃ vā tathā sambandho nāsti,
                                tathā+api śarīrasambaddhaistairvātasya śarīracāriṇaḥ sambandho
                                bhavati, tataśca vātasya samānaguṇayogādvṛddhirviparītaguṇayogācca
                                hrāsa upapanna eveti||6-7||

śarīrāśarīracarasyeti vātasvarūpakathanaṃ, tena
                                śarīreṣu carata iti bahiḥ śarīrebhyo veti ca punaruktaṃ na bhavati|
                                atrāvayavāniti vadan

kārtsnyābhidhānamaśakyaṃ bahuprapañcatvāditi darśayati| sādhayitvā
                                pratipādya| vātakarmasu pratyakṣāṇi vacanādīni,
                                manaḥpreraṇādyanumeyaṃ, garbhākṛtikaraṇādyāgamagamyam| tantraṃ

| prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ, śabdakāraṇatvaṃ ca

| dhātūnāmiti pṛthivyādīnāṃ,

vāyostadapi devatārūpatvenaiva samādheyam| samprati

tacchrutvā
                                baḍiśavacanamavitathamṛṣigaṇairanumatamuvāca vāryovido rājarṣiḥ-

                                śarīreṣu carataḥ karmāṇi bahiḥśarīrebhyo vā bhavanti, teṣāmavayavān

                                pravartakaśceṣṭānāmuccāvacānāṃ, niyantā praṇetā ca manasaḥ,

, kṣeptā bahirmalānāṃ, sthūlāṇusrotasāṃ

, sarvendriyāṇyupahanti, vinihanti garbhān

,

                                kupitākupitaḥ śubhāśubhāni karoti; tadyathā- paktimapaktiṃ

bhavati cātra- tadātreyavacaḥ śrutvā sarva

aikāntikavacanāditi avadhāraṇādityarthaḥ|

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke

nirdeśavātakalākalīye vātādayo+abhihitāḥ, teṣāṃ
                                bheṣajaṃ yathā kalpanīyaṃ tadupadeṣṭuṃ kalpanācatuṣko+abhidhīyate|
                                bheṣajānāṃ kalpanā bheṣajakalpanā, sā ca kalpanā

; ataḥ snehādidravyagocarā
                                sneha-sveda-vamana-virecanakalpanehābhidhīyate, bastikalpanā tviha

                                pradhānabheṣajatvācca tatpratipādaka eva snehādhyāyo+abhidhīyate|

saṅkhyā samyagjñānaṃ, tena vyavaharantīti
                                sāṅkhyāḥ| saṅkhyātaṃ jñātaṃ saṅkhyeyaṃ jñeyaṃ yaiste tathā; yadi vā

                                kartavyapraśnānuguṇamanaḥsamādhānopadarśanārtham| saṃśayamiti
                                    saṃśayena

viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ lakṣayati, tena saṃśayamiti
                                saṃśayaviṣayamityarthaḥ||3||
kiṃyonayaḥ kati snehāḥ ke ca snehaguṇāḥ pṛthak
kālānupāne ke kasya kati kāśca vicāraṇāḥ
kati mātrāḥ kathammānāḥ kā ca keṣūpadiśyate
kaśca kebhyo hitaḥ snehaḥ prakarṣaḥ snehane ca kaḥ

snehyāḥ ke ke na ca
                                snigdhāsnigdhātisnigdhalakṣaṇam
kiṃ pānāt prathamaṃ pīte jīrṇe kiñca hitāhitam
ke mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhāḥ kā vyāpadaḥ siddhayaśca kāḥ
acche saṃśodhane caiva snehe kā vṛttiriṣyate
vicāraṇāḥ keṣu yojyā vidhinā kena tat prabho!

ko+asau saṃśaya ityāha- kiṃyonaya ityādi|

|

sarvasnehottamā ityatra sarvaśabdena
                                dadhikṣīrādayo gṛhyante; sarvasnehottamatvaṃ ca sarpirādīnāṃ

; tathāhi-

sarpiḥ śaradi pātavyaṃ vasā majjā ca mādhave

sarpirādipānakālamāha- sarpiḥ śaradītyādi|
                                mādhave vaiśākhe| prāvṛḍāṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau, yaduktaṃ- “prāvṛṭ
                                śukranabhau jñeyau” (si.a.6) iti| śaradi bahupittatvena
                                pittaviruddhaṃ ghṛtameva yaugikaṃ, nānyastailādiḥ| vasāmajjñostu
                                nātiśītoṣṇatvāt sādhāraṇe; yatastayoranupāne śītatvena voṣṇatvena vā
                                nirdeśo na kṛtaḥ; “yathāsattvaṃ tu śaityauṣṇye
                                vasāmajjñorvinirdiśet” (sū.a.27) iti tu vacanena
                                śaityauṣṇyābhidhānaṃ sāmānyena,
                                tailasarpirvadauṣṇyaśaityānabhidhānānna
                                prakarṣaprāptaśaityoṣṇatvaprāpakam| ata evoktaṃ-
                                “tailavasāmajjasarpiṣāṃ tu yathāpūrvaṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ
                                vātaśleṣmavikāreṣu bhavati, yathottaraṃ pittavikāreṣu” (vi.a.8) iti|
                                atrottarasya sarpiṣaḥ śaityāt pittaharatvaṃ, tailasya
                                tūṣṇatvādvātaśleṣmaharatvaṃ, vasāmajjñostu sādhāraṇatvena
                                madhyagatatvamiti sthitam| evaṃ vasāmajjñoḥ sādhāraṇatvena tathā
                                balyatvadhātuvṛddhikaratvābhyāmanatiśītoṣṇe tathā
                                balakṣayadhātukṣayayukte mādhave prayogo yuktaḥ| caitrastu
                                mukhyasādhāraṇaguṇo+api prabhūtaśleṣmatayā na snehaviṣaya
                                ityanuktaḥ| sāmānyena snehopayoge śastaṃ kālamāha- nātyuṣṇetyādi|
                                nātyuṣṇe grīṣme, nātiśīte hemante śiśire ca tathā varṣajanitaśaitye
                                varṣākāle| ayaṃ cānātyayikavikāre sati kālaniyamo jñeyaḥ, agre uṣṇe
                                śīte ca kāle snehopadeśāt||18||

kālaviśeṣe doṣaviśeṣe ca pānakramaṃ darśayati-
                                vātetyādinā| vātaśca pittaṃ ca vātapittaṃ, tadadhiko
                                vātapittādhikaḥ| rātrāviti sāyam| uṣṇe grīṣme|
                                śleṣmādhikagrahaṇamatyantaśītavikāragṛhītapuruṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena
                                vātaśleṣmādhikaḥ śleṣmādhikaśca gṛhyate; ata eva suśrute+apyuktaṃ-
                                “vātapittādhiko rātrau vātaśleṣmādhiko divā” (su.ci.31) iti|
                                kevalavātādhikasya tathā pittādhikasya śleṣmādhikasya ca sādhāraṇe
                                śaradādau kāle utsargasiddha eva pānakālo vakṣyamāṇo bhavati|
                                vakṣyati hi- “pibet saṃśamanaṃ snehamannakāle” ityādi| anye tu
                                bruvate- vātādhikagrahaṇena kevalavātasyāpi grahaṇaṃ,
                                śleṣmādhikavyapadeśācca vātaśleṣma-pittaśleṣmaṇorapi grahaṇamiti|
                                śīte hemantādau| amalaḥ prabalaraśmiryasmin dinasya bhāge bhāskaraḥ
                                so+amalabhāskaro madhyāhna iti yāvat||19||
atyuṣṇe vā divā pīto vātapittādhikena vā

śīte rātrau piban snehaṃ naraḥ śleṣmādhiko+api
                                vā

uktakālaniyamaviparyaye doṣamāha- atyuṣṇe
                                vetyādi| atyuṣṇe kāle divā pītaḥ snehaḥ ślaiṣmikasyāpi
                                yathoktavikārakaraḥ, tathā vātapittādhikena pītaḥ śītakāle+api
                                yathoktavikārakaraḥ; evaṃ niśāpāne+api vākyārthaḥ; paraṃ niṣiddhasya
                                kālasya doṣasya ca melake+atyaye coktavikāraprakarṣāprakarṣau
                                tarkaṇīyau||20-21||

anupānamāha- jalamityādi| taile+anviti anupāne|
                                anupānaparimāṇaṃ tu samyagbheṣajapākārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ
                                bheṣajāvaikārikapākenaivonneyaṃ, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārācca||22||

vicāraṇāḥ saṅkhyayā svarūpeṇa caikagranthenāha-
                                odanaścetyādi| vilepī viraladravā yavāgūrbahusikthasamanvitā jñeyā|
                                saśākapallavena kṛto yūṣaḥ khaḍaḥ| kāmbaliko
                                dadhilavaṇasnehatilādikṛta īṣadamlaḥ| etayorudāharaṇaṃ yathā- “takre
                                    kapitthacāṅgerīmaricājājicitrakaiḥ

| supakvaḥ khaḍayūṣo+ayamayaṃ kāmbaliko mataḥ||
                                dadhyamlo lavaṇasnehatilamāṣānvitaḥ śṛtaḥ” iti| lehaḥ śarkarādīnāṃ
                                pākāt kṛtaḥ; lihyata iti lehaḥ| pravicāryate
                                avacāryate+anukalpenopayujyate+anayeti pravicāraṇā odanādayaḥ;
                                odanādayaśca snehapravicāraṇāyāṃ snehayuktā eva boddhavyāḥ;
                                abhyañjanādayastu yadyapi śuddhasnehasampādyāstathā+api
                                jaṭharāgnisambandhe na vyāpriyanta iti tantre
                                vicāraṇāśabdenocyante||23-25||
odanaśca vilepī ca raso māṃsaṃ payo dadhi
yavāgūḥ sūpaśākau ca yūṣaḥ kāmbalikaḥ khaḍaḥ

kevalasnehapānaṃ tu snehane śaktyatiśayavattvena
                                na vicāraṇāsañjñayocyate, etadevāha- acchapeya ityādi| acchaśca
                                peyaśca acchapeyaḥ, odanādyasambandhe sati peya ityarthaḥ| na
                                tāmāhurvicāraṇāmiti vacanena vaidyaparamparāsiddho+ayaṃ vyavahāra
                                iti darśayati| bhiṣagbhirdṛṣṭo bhiṣagdṛṣṭaḥ| prathame śreṣṭhe kalpe
                                pakṣe bhavatīti prāthamakalpikaḥ, śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ||26||

prakārāntareṇa vicāraṇābhedamāha- rasaiścetyādi|
                                samāso rasānāmanyonyamelakaḥ, vyāso+amelakaḥ; samāsavyāsavadbhiḥ
                                ṣaḍbhī rasairodanādigatairupahito yuktaḥ san snehastriṣaṣṭisaṅkhyāṃ
                                prāpnoti| ekaśca kevala ityacchapeyaṃ
                                varjayitvā+abhyañjanādiprayojyaḥ| triṣaṣṭhī rasabhedā
                                ātreyabhadrakāpyīye “svāduramlādibhiryogaṃ” (sū.a.26) ityādivākye
                                vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyāḥ| evaṃ snehānāṃ rasayuktānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ
                                pravicāraṇā bhavanti| catuḥṣaṣṭiriti snehānāmityanena sambadhyate,
                                tena pravicāraṇetyekavacanamupapannaṃ bhavati| na sarvavicāraṇā
                                sarvatra kartavyā, kintu sātmyartuvyādhidoṣapuruṣān parīkṣya yā
                                yatra yujyate sā tatra kartavyetyāha- okartvityādi| okaḥ abhyāsaḥ|
                                puruṣagrahaṇena kasmin deśe+ayaṃ puruṣo vartata iti parīkṣayā
                                deśo+apyavaruddho boddhavyaḥ, vayobalaprabhṛtayaśca
                                boddhavyāḥ||27-28||

mātrāyāḥ saṅkhyāṃ pramāṇaṃ cāha-
                                ahorātramityādi| ahorātraśabdo+aṣṭapraharopalakṣaṇaḥ,
                                evamahaḥśabdārdhāhaśabdau catuḥpraharadvipraharopalakṣaṇau, tena
                                praharādyatīte+apyahani pītā mātrā yathoktapraharakālaprāptyā
                                dināntare rātrau vā jīryamāṇā mantavyā; anye tvahorātraśabdena
                                nyūnenāpyahnā yuktā rātrirahorātraśabdenocyate

, kṛtsnārdhāhau tu
                                praharopalakṣaṇāviti vadanti| atra yadā ahorātrapariṇāminī mātrā
                                kriyate, tadā tadaharāhāro na kartavyaḥ; ata evaitatpānaṃ
                                puruṣaviśeṣaviṣayakathane uktaṃ- “kṣutpipāsāsahānarāḥ” iti|
                                prabhūtasnehanityāḥ prabhūtasnehasātmyāḥ| samyagyo jitetivacanena
                                mahāvyāpattitvamasyāḥ sūcayati| sarvamārgāḥ koṣṭhasandhimarmaśākhāḥ|
                                punarnavakarī niḥśeṣadoṣaharatvena| aruṣketyādi madhyamamātrāguṇaḥ;
                                aruṣkā arūṃṣikā| śodhanārtha iti śodhanārtha(ṅga)snehakaraṇe; etena
                                uttamamātrā saṃśamane

eva paraṃ, na
                                tu śodhanāṅgasnehe kartavyeti darśayati| ye tvityādi
                                hrasvamātrāguṇaḥ| parihāre sukheti alpaparihāratvena||29-40||
pradhānā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati
iti tisraḥ samuddiṣṭā mātrāḥ snehasya mānataḥ
tāsāṃ prayogān vakṣyāmi puruṣaṃ puruṣaṃ prati
sukhena ca snehayati śodhanārthe ca yujyate
ye tu vṛddhāśca bālāśca sukumārāḥ sukhocitāḥ
snehamātrāṃ pibeyuste hrasvāṃ ye cāvarā bale

yaḥ sneho yatra kāryastamāha- vātapittetyādi|
                                vātapittavikāragrahaṇenaiva vātapittaprakṛtiṣu labdheṣu
                                punastadabhidhānaṃ vātapittaprakṛtīnāṃ stokaśleṣmavikāre+api
                                ghṛtapānopadeśārtham; evaṃ vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ya
                                ityatra vyākhyeyam| balārthina ityatra balaśabdaḥ smṛtyādibhiḥ
                                sambadhyate| ārtāḥ pīḍitāḥ, dāhādibhiriti sambandhaḥ||41-43||

tailaviṣayamāha- pravṛddhetyādi| śītale kāla iti
                                tailasyoṣṇatvena śītale+api kāla ityarthaḥ; tena sāmānyapratiṣedhaḥ
                                ‘nātyuṣṇaśīte snehaṃ pibennaraḥ’ iti na virudhyate; yadi vā
                                sarpiḥpānakālāpekṣayā śītatvaṃ boddhavyam||44-46||
pibeyuḥ śītale kāle tailaṃ tailocitāśca ye

vasāviṣayamāha- vātātapetyādi|
                                saṃśuṣkaniṣpītaśabdau kṣīṇārthāveva| mahāruja ityasthyādibhiḥ
                                sambadhyate| khāni srotāṃsi||47-49||

yebhyo yebhyo hito yo yaḥ snehaḥ sa
                                parikīrtitaḥ

dīptāgnaya ityādi majjapānaviṣayaḥ| ghasmarā
                                bahubhakṣakāḥ| āpnuyuḥ upayuñjīran||50||-

; tena, alpatvena
                                trairātrikaḥ prakarṣaḥ, bhūyastvena sāptarātrika iti ca bhavati|
                                etacca vakṣyamāṇasadyaḥsnehaprayogātiriktaprayoge boddhavyaṃ; yadi
                                vā, sadyaḥsnehaprayogā api tryaheṇaiva snehayanti, stutyarthaṃ tu
                                teṣu sadya ityuktam| yaduktaṃ- “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu
                                snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ| nātaḥ paraṃ snehanamādiśanti
                                sātmyībhavet saptadināt paraṃ tu” (si.a.1.) iti||51||

sāmānyena snehyānāha- svedyā ityādi| svedyāḥ
                                svatantrasvedasādhyā vātarugārtādayaḥ, śodhanāṅgasvedasādhyānāṃ tu
                                śodhayitavyā ityanenaiva gṛhītatvāt| cintakā iti cintābahulāḥ||52||

asnehyānāha- saṃśodhanādṛta ityādi| yeṣāṃ
                                rūkṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate laṅghanabṛṃhaṇīye- “abhiṣyandā mahādoṣā marmasthā
                                vyādhayaśca ye| ūrustambhaprabhṛtayo rūkṣaṇīyā nidarśitāḥ” (sū.
                                a.22) ityanena, teṣāṃ śodhanādṛte snehanaṃ na śastaṃ, yadā tu
                                śodhanena virūkṣyante tadā paraṃ śodhanāṅga(rtha)statra snehaḥ
                                kartavya iti bhāvaḥ| utsanno vṛddhaḥ kapho medaśca yeṣāṃ te tathā;
                                etacca viśeṣaṇaṃ virūkṣaṇīyā evambhūtā eva bhavantīti
                                    darśayati

| abhiṣyaṇṇaḥ
                                dravapradhānaśleṣmavikārī| garaḥ kṛtrimaṃ viṣam| atipratāntaḥ
                                atikṣīṇadravadhātuḥ| vartamāneṣu kriyamāṇeṣvityarthaḥ||53-56||
na snehyā vartamāneṣu na nasto bastikarmasu

asnigdhalakṣaṇamāha- purīṣamityādi| mṛduriti
                                pakturviśeṣaṇam| vātānulomyamityādi snigdhalakṣaṇam| pāṇḍutetyādi
                                atisnigdhalakṣaṇam| jāḍyam indriyajaḍatvam||57-59||

snehāt pūrvaṃ yat pathyaṃ tadāha-
                                dravoṣṇamityādi| asaṅkīrṇam aviruddhavīryam| śva ityāgāmidine|
                                annakāle dvipraharādilakṣaṇe bubhukṣā kadācinna

syādapi tadarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ- prakāṅkṣita iti|
                                śuddhyarthaṃ tu snehaṃ naiśe dināntarakṛte āhāre jīrṇa eva prātareva
                                pibedityarthaḥ| saṃśamanārthasneho yadi jaraṇānte prātareva kriyate
                                tadā koṣṭhopalepakadoṣasyākṣayāttena doṣeṇa sambaddho doṣotkleśaṃ
                                kuryānna saṃśamanaṃ, saṃśodhanārthastu doṣotkleśaṃ
                                karotītyapekṣaṇīya eveti bhāvaḥ| etacca kālakathanamutsargeṇa, tena
                                “vātapittādhiko rātrau” ityuktakālavirodho na bhavati||60-61||

kṣapāyāmeva svapitīti kṣapāśayaḥ| apravātaṃ ceti
                                śayanāsanaviśeṣaṇam| snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna iti snehe jīrṇe+api
                                snehaprayogānuguṇamanyasnehamaviruddhavīryādiguṇayuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ|
                                etena snehe pīte jīrṇe kiñca hitāhitamiti praśnadvayasyottaramidam-
                                uṣṇodakopacārī syādityādi bhavati||62-64||

‘brahmacārī kṣapāśaya ityanena
                                    maithunadivāsvapnarātrijāgaraṇānāṃ niṣedhaḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

gaṅgādharastu ‘snehaṃ pītvā nare
                                    snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca’ iti paṭhati, ‘snehaṃ pītvā tvaparaṃ
                                    snehaṃ pratibhuñjāne nare snehamithyopacārāddāruṇā gadā jāyante’
                                    iti vyākhyānayati; yogīndranāthasenastu ‘snehaṃ pītvā naraḥ
                                    snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca; uṣṇodakopacārī syāt’ ityādi ‘seveta
                                    śayanāsanam; snehamithyopacārāddhi jāyante dāruṇā gadā’ ityevaṃ
                                    kiñcitpaurvāparyaṃ kṛtvā paṭhati, ‘pīte hitāhitamāha- snehaṃ
                                    pītvetyādi; snehaṃ pītvā tathā snehaṃ pratibhuñjānaḥ tasminneva
                                    dine snehaṃ piban snehaṃ pītavān snehaṃ pibaṃścetyarthaḥ, nara
                                    uṣṇodakopacārī syāt’ ityādi vyākhyānayati ca;

pītvā
                                naraḥ snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna eva ca
madyaṃ vā taruṇaṃ pītvā mṛdukoṣṭho viricyate
mṛdukoṣṭhasya tasmāt sa suvirecyo naraḥ smṛtaḥ

mṛdukoṣṭhādilakṣaṇamāha- mṛdvityādi|
                                abhyarhitatvāt koṣṭhajñānasyānyathā+api tallakṣaṇamāha- guḍamityādi|
                                ulloḍitaṃ dadhisaraḥ| kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūḥ; vacanaṃ
                                hi- “tilataṇḍulamāṣaistu kṛśarā trisareti ca”|
                                krūrakoṣṭhāvirecanahetumāha- bhavatītyādi| grahaṇī
                                koṣṭhasthāgnyadhiṣṭhānabhūtā nāḍī; yaduktam- “agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya
                                grahaṇādgrahaṇī matā” (ci.a.15) iti| udīrṇapittetyādi
                                mṛdukoṣṭhasvarūpakathanam| krūrakoṣṭhasya grahaṇīgato vāyurguḍādīnāṃ
                                saratvaṃ pratibadhnāti, mṛdukoṣṭhasya hi grahaṇyāṃ virodhako
                                vāyurnāsti, stambhako+api śleṣmā+alpaḥ, udbhūtasaratvaguṇaṃ ca
                                pittaṃ prabalaṃ; tena guḍādibhiḥ sukhaṃ virecanaṃ bhavatīti
                                bhāvaḥ||65-69||

samprati snehavyāpado darśayati- udīrṇetyādi|
                                ojaḥ sarvadhātusārabhūtaṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ, prakṣārayan
                                sthānādbhraṃśayan kṣapayaṃśca| balītyanena snehendhano vahnirnitarāṃ
                                balavān bhavatīti darśayati| vacanaṃ hi- “nālaṃ snehasamṛddhasya
                                śamāyānnaṃ sugurvapi” iti| uttamāṃ mahatīṃ mātrām| sopasargāṃ
                                sopadravām| kakṣaḥ kāṣṭhasamūhaḥ| chardayediti prathamaṃ snehameva
                                tṛṣṇākārakaṃ chardayitvā punaḥ śītodakaṃ pītvā rūkṣānnaṃ ca bhuktvā
                                ullikhediti yojanīyam| na sarpirityādi|- na sarpiḥ sāme pitte peyaṃ,
                                kevalaṃ tvasaṃskṛtaṃ viśeṣato na peyaṃ sāmapitta eveti yojanā; evaṃ
                                manyate- saṃskṛtaṃ tiktakādibhiryutaṃ sāme pitte
                                tiktakādipācanaguṇānuyogādyogyaṃ kadācidbhavatyapi

, asaṃskṛtaṃ tu sarvathā viruddhameva;
                                yadivā, kevalamasaṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pitte sāmānyena sāme nirāme vā na
                                peyaṃ, sāme pitte viśeṣata iti yojanā| etena, yatrāpi sāmānyena
                                ghṛtaṃ vihitaṃ, yathā- “ata ūrdhvaṃ kaphe mande vātapittottare
                                jvare| paripakveṣu doṣeṣu sarpiḥpānaṃ yathā+amṛtam” (ci.a.3)
                                ityādau, tatrāpyucitabheṣajasaṃskṛtameva boddhavyam| yadivā, na
                                kevalaṃ pitte sāme sarpirviśeṣato na peyaṃ, kintarhi tailādīnyapi
                                vātaśleṣmavihitāni tayoḥ sāmayorna peyānītyarthaḥ| asmin
                                vyākhyāne+apeyamityakārapraśleṣo draṣṭavyaḥ| anurajet pittavarṇaṃ
                                kuryāt| sañjñā smṛtiḥ, taddhananaṃ ceha vyādhiprabhāvāt| staimityam
                                ārdravastrāguṇṭhitatvamiva| āmapradoṣā alasakavisūcikādayaḥ|
                                kālapratīkṣaṇaṃ snehajanitadoṣakṣayaṃ yāvadabhojanam|
                                takrasyāriṣṭānāṃ ca cikitsāvakṣyamāṇānāṃ prayogaḥ| mūtrāṇāṃ
                                triphalāyāśca sevanamiti sambandhaḥ||70-78||
sa jagdhvā snehamātrāṃ tāmojaḥ prakṣārayan balī
sa cet suśītaṃ salilaṃ nāsādayati dahyate
ajīrṇe yadi tu snehe tṛṣṇā syācchardayedbhiṣak
na sarpiḥ kevalaṃ pitte peyaṃ sāme viśeṣataḥ
prati prati vyādhibalaṃ buddhvā sraṃsanameva ca
akāle cāhitaścaiva mātrayā na ca yojitaḥ

saṃśodhanasnehapāne vṛttipracāramāha-
                                snehādityādi| snehāt snehaprayogāt| trirātroparataḥ trirātraṃ
                                parityaktasnehapāna ityarthaḥ| praskandanaṃ virecanam|
                                    snehoparamatrirātra

eva bhojanaṃ darśayati- snehavadityādi|
                                rasapradhānamodanaṃ rasaudanam||80||

vamane snehavṛttimāha- eketyādi| ekāhoparataḥ
                                snehāditi yojanā| tadvaditi snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca rasaudanaṃ
                                snehoparamadivasa eva|81|-

saṃśamanavidhimāha- syāttvityādi|
                                asaṃśodhanārthīye saṃśamane| vṛttiḥ upacāraḥ|
                                viriktavadityanenāgatāvekṣaṇenopakalpanīyavakṣyamāṇaṃ
                                “samyagviriktaṃ cainaṃ” (sū. a.15)
                                ityādigranthapratipādanīyamupacāramāha, natu peyādikramamātram

| yadyapi vamanoktā eva
                                tatroccairbhāṣyādayo virecanavṛttāvapyatidiṣṭāstathā+apīha
                                vamanavidhi parityajya virecanavidhyatideśo
                                dhūmapānapratiṣedhārthaḥ, virecane hi tatra “dhūmapānavarjaṃ” (sū.
                                a.15) iti kṛtaṃ, snehapāne ca dhūmapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ mātrāśitīye- “na
                                madyadugdhe pītvā ca na snehaṃ” (sū. a.5) ityādinā||81||

vicāraṇāviṣayamāha- snehadviṣa ityādinā|
                                lāvādirasānāmuktānāṃ saṃskāramāha- yavetyādi| rase snehārthoktarasa
                                ucitaḥ saṃyogo yeṣāṃ te rasasaṃyogāḥ, teṣāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ saṅgrahaḥ|
                                pūrvamiti bhojanāt pūrvam| tilapradhānaḥ kāmbalikastilakāmbalikaḥ|
                                phāṇitamityādau śṛṅgaveramiti śṛṅgaverarasam| bhṛtaiḥ
                                bhaṭitrīkṛtaiḥ| pāñcaprasṛtikī agre vakṣyamāṇā| māṣamiśrako
                                māṣataṇḍulakṛtamannam| peyā pātavyā||82-90||
phāṇitaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca tailaṃ ca surayā saha
tailaṃ surāyā maṇḍena vasāṃ majjānameva vā
piban saphāṇitaṃ kṣīraṃ naraḥ snihyati vātikaḥ
naraḥ snihyati pītvā vā saraṃ dadhnaḥ saphāṇitam

(śaukaro vā rasaḥ snigdhaḥ sarpirlavaṇasaṃyutaḥ [
                                pīto dvirvāsare yatnāt snehayedacirānnaram [[1[[)
kuṣṭhī śothī pramehī ca snehane na prayojayet
vyoṣagarbhaṃ bhiṣak snehaṃ pītvā snihyati taṃ naraḥ

yathārhamiti yo yatra sneho yujyate sarpirādiḥ|
                                siddhairiti pippalībhistathā harītakyā tathā triphalayā ceti
                                pṛthagyojanīyaṃ; pippalyādisiddhasnehaśca kuṣṭhādiṣu
                                yathāsaṅkhyamiti kecit| yūṣaśabdaḥ kvāthavacanaḥ| vyoṣagarbhaṃ
                                vyoṣakalkam| atra tribhirdravyairmilitvā cāturguṇyam| yavakolādau
                                ṣaḍdravyāṇi snehasamāni| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ kalkaḥ||91-94||

samprati sneha upayukto yathā śarīraṃ
                                sasnehyādhiko dṛśyate, tadāha- gṛhṇātītyādi| tacca
                                śiṣyeṇādhyāyādāvapṛṣṭamapi śiṣyahitatayā+abhidhīyate| yathāgnīti
                                agnyanadhika ityarthaḥ| nanvagnyadhikaścet sravati, tadavadhi ca
                                snehalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, yaducyate- “adhastāt snehadarśanam” iti,
                                tenaikadina evādhikasnehapānaṃ kriyatāmityāha- yathā cetyādi|
                                ākledya īṣatkledayitvā| tvaritasevitaḥ sneho dhātūnasnehayitvaiva
                                sraṃsate+adho yāti yāvān, na tāvatā snehanaṃ bhavatīti
                                bhāvaḥ||96-97||

“idānīmupayuktaḥ snehaḥ śarīraṃ
                                    saṃsnehyādhikaścedbhavati tadā sravati, anyathātu
                                    jīryatyevetyāha- gṛhṇātītyādi; yathāgnīti agnyanurūpam; nanu
                                    snehapānaṃ hi snigdhalakṣaṇāvadhi kāryaṃ, tenaikadina eva tathā
                                    snehapānaṃ kriyatāṃ yathā śīghrameva snehalakṣaṇaṃ syādityāha-
                                    yathā cetyādi; ākledya īṣatkledayitvā, evaṃ tvaritasevito+api
                                    sneho dhātūnasnehayitvaiva sraṃsate adho yāti, tathā ca sati
                                    samyaksnehanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ” iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

snehane sarvasneheṣu lavaṇaprayogamāha-
                                lavaṇopahitā ityādi| taditi lavaṇam| abhiṣyandi
                                doṣasaṅghātavicchedakam| vyavāyi
                                akhiladehavyāptipūrvakapākagāmi||98||

ato vakṣyamāṇasvedopakalpanādhyāyayoḥ
                                sambandhasūcakaṃ svedādiṣu snehasya prāgbhāvamāha-
                                snehamityādi||99||

tatra ślokaḥ- snehāḥ snehavidhiḥ
                                kṛtsnavyāpatsiddhiḥ sabheṣajā

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                ślokasthāne snehādhyāyo nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kalpanācatuṣke
                                snehādhyāyo nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ||13||

vātakaphātmakā asaṃsṛṣṭavātakaphajāḥ,
                                vātakaphajatve+apyudarādayaḥ svedena na śāmyanti, ata āha-
                                svedasādhyāḥ; etenodarādayo+asvedyā vyāvartyante| snehapūrvamiti
                                kriyāviśeṣaṇam| na sajjanti apravṛttāni na bhavanti| yathānyāyaṃ
                                yathāgamam, etacca snehasvedopapādanairityanena sambadhyate; yadi vā
                                yathānyāyaṃ yathāsahajaṃ namayantīti sambandhaḥ||3-5||
dravyavān kalpito deśe svedaḥ kāryakaro mataḥ

rogamṛtuṃ vyādhitaṃ ca balavattvādinā+apekṣata
                                iti rogartuvyādhitāpekṣaḥ| nātyuṣṇo nāticaṇḍatāpaḥ| dravyavāniti
                                snigdharūkṣādidravyavān| kalpita iti rogādīnapekṣya yathocitena
                                dravyeṇa deśe cāmāśayādau yathāyogyatayā sampādita iti
                                mantavyam||6||
vyādhau śīte śarīre ca mahān svedo mahābale
durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhyame madhyamo hitaḥ
vātaśleṣmaṇi vāte vā kaphe vā sveda iṣyate

rogādyapekṣayoktakalpanāṃ darśayati-
                                vyādhāvityādi| vyādhau mahābale tathā śīte kālakṛte mahābale|
                                mahāniti caṇḍatāpa eva punaḥ punaḥ kriyamāṇatvena
                                mṛdusvedāpekṣayā+adhikatāpatvena jñeyaḥ| durbala iti tathā madhyama
                                iti ca vyādhyādiṣu pūrvavadyojanīyam| snigdharūkṣadravyakṛtaḥ
                                snigdharūkṣaḥ, snigdharūkṣadravyādayo vātaśleṣmādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ
                                mantavyāḥ; etacca snigdharūkṣādikathanaṃ
                                dravyāpekṣakalpanodāharaṇaṃ; vāte snigdhaḥ, kaphe rūkṣaḥ||7-8||

taṃ deśaviśeṣasambandhena vyabhicārayan
                                deśāpekṣāṃ kalpanāmāha- āmāśayetyādi| āmāśayagate vāte rūkṣapūrvaḥ
                                sthānāpekṣayā pūrvaṃ rūkṣaṃ kṛtvā paścādvātāpekṣaḥ snigdhaḥ kāryaḥ,
                                evaṃ pakvāśayagate kaphe snehapūrvo vyākhyeyaḥ; āmāśayaśabdena
                                kaphasthānaṃ jñeyaṃ, kaphasthānāpekṣayā hi prathamaṃ rūkṣaḥ kriyate,
                                yaduktaṃ- “sthānaṃ jayeddhi pūrvaṃ tu sthānasthasyāviruddhataḥ”
                                iti||9||
vṛṣaṇau hṛdayaṃ dṛṣṭī svedayenmṛdu naiva vā

mṛdu naiva veti svedaikasādhye vṛṣaṇādigate
                                vyādhau mṛdusvedaḥ, svedavyatiriktopāyāntarasambhave tu na veti
                                boddhavyam| iṣṭata ityāturecchāto vaidyecchātaśca| iṣṭata iti
                                bhāvādicchāvacanaḥ||10||

svede kriyamāṇe cakṣuṣaḥ svedaparihāropāyamāha-
                                suśuddhairityādi| naktakaḥ karpaṭāvayavaḥ

svede kriyamāṇe hṛdayarakṣaṇārthamāha-
                                muktāvalībhirityādi| jalajāni paṅkajādīni|
                                evamasvedyatvasāmānyatvādvṛṣaṇarakṣā+apyunnetavyā,
                                prādhānyāddhṛdayacakṣuḥpālanamuktam||12||

śītaśūletyādi| sveda iti svedabhave gharme|
                                svedanādviratirmatetyupadiśan śītādivyuparame sati svedo
                                nivartanīyaḥ, śītādyanuparame ca svedaḥ kartavya iti
                                dvayamupadiśati; tataśca ita eva
                                svedanivṛttiviṣayaśītādivyuparamotpādaḥ svedasya samyagyogalakṣaṇaṃ
                                tathā śītādivyuparamānutpādaśca
                                svedānivṛttiviṣayo+ayogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavatīti
                                nāyogalakṣaṇānabhidhānamudbhāvanīyam||13||

atisvinnacikitsitamāha- ukta ityādi| graiṣmiko
                                vidhirityanena labdhe punarmadhuraḥ snigdhaśītala ityādivacanaṃ
                                “madyamalpaṃ na vā peyaṃ” (sū.a.6) ityatropadiṣṭamadyapānasya
                                pratiṣedhārthaṃ, madhuraśītādiyogaviśeṣavidhānārthaṃ ca||14-15||

asvedyānāha- kaṣāyetyādi| kaṣāyadravyakṛtaṃ
                                madyaṃ kaṣāyamadyaṃ; kiṃvā kaṣāyaśabdo+amadhuravacanaḥ, na tena
                                yaducyate- kaṣāyanityasya vātapradhānatā syāt kaṣāyasya
                                vātakāritvāt, vāte ca svedo vihita eva, tat kathaṃ kaṣāyanityaṃ
                                prati svedaniṣedha iti, tannirastaṃ bhavati| kiṃvā, kaṣāyanityā
                                rūkṣātistabdhagātrā bhavanti, kaṣāyasya virūkṣakastambhakatvena;
                                tataśca teṣāṃ svedaḥ parvabhedamāvahatītyataḥ kaṣāyanityaniṣedhaḥ|
                                raktapittināmavidhānādeva svede niṣiddhe, punaḥ svedaniṣedho
                                raktapittināṃ yadyanyo+api svedasādhyo vātaśleṣmajo vikāro bhavati
                                tatrāpi svedaniṣedhārthaṃ, tathā raktapittināṃ vamanavirecanāṅgatayā
                                prāptasvedapratiprasavaniṣedhārthaṃ ca; evaṃ pittamehikāmalyādiṣvapi
                                vyākhyeyam| pittināmiti pittaprakṛtīnām| madhumehaśabdena sarva evaṃ
                                mehā gṛhyante, madhumehaśabdo hi sarveṣveva meheṣu vartata iti
                                kiyantaḥśirasīye darśanīyaṃ, meheṣu ca sarveṣveva
                                śarīraśaithilyapravṛtteṣu viśeṣataḥ śarīraśaithilyahetutvena svedo
                                na yujyate; pittamehināmiti tu punarabhidhānaṃ pittasambandhena
                                viśeṣapratiṣedhatādarśanārtham| bradhnaḥ gudaḥ| madyavikāriṇāmiti
                                madyanityasya vātakaphajamadātyaye svedaniṣedhārtham| āḍhyarogīha
                                vātaraktī| eṣu cāsvedaviṣayeṣu yadi svedaikasādhyaḥ
                                sannyāsādirbhavati tadā mahāpratyavāyabhayādalpapratyavāyamupekṣyāpi
                                svedo vidheya iti nyāyasiddhameva; yadāhurnyāyavidaḥ- “bhūyovirodhe
                                svalpamanyāyyam” iti||16-19||

pratiśyāye cetyādinā svedyān darśayati|
                                vināmakaḥ śarīravinamanakārī vātaḥ| vijṛmbhako bahirāyāmaḥ,
                                jṛmbhābahutvaṃ vā| pādajānūrujaṅghābhirartiḥ saṅgrahaśca pṛthak
                                sambadhyate| khallī hastapadāvamoṭanam| vātakaṇṭako gulphāśrito
                                vātaḥ| alāghava iti pūrvamukte+api punargauravavacanamaṅgānāṃ
                                gurutaratvapratipādanārtham, alāghavavacanaṃ tu
                                lāghavapratiṣedhamātraprayojanaṃ nātigurutvaṃ brūte, yataḥ sarvatra
                                nañ viruddhe na vartate, yathā “arūkṣamanabhiṣyandi
                                tvāsīnapracalāyitam” (sū.a.21) ityatra na hyarūkṣaśabdena
                                snigdhatvamabhipretaṃ, kiṃ tarhi rūkṣatāpratiṣedhamātrameva||20-24||

vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṅkarādisvedānāṃ dravyāṇyāha-
                                tilamāṣetyādi| piṇḍarūpaḥ svedaḥ piṇḍasvedaḥ| karīṣaḥ śuṣkagomayaḥ;
                                āyasaḥ ayovikāraḥ, sa ceha puṭakaraṇayogyo boddhavyaḥ| pūrvairiti
                                tilamāṣādibhiḥ| yathāsvamityanena tilamāṣādayo vāte,
                                gokharādigranthoktāśca śleṣmaṇi, prastarasvede kartavyā iti
                                darśayati||25-27||

bhūgṛheṣviti bhūsvedārtheṣu gṛheṣu|
                                uṣṇagarbhagṛheṣviti kuṭīsvedaṃ darśayati| svabhyakta iti
                                samyagabhyaktaḥ||28||

bastaśiraḥ chāgamastakam|
                                snehavantaścairaṇḍabījādayaḥ tilāśca taṇḍulāśca
                                snehavattilataṇḍulāḥ| grāmyetyādinā vātāpaho nāḍīsveda uktaḥ,
                                vāruṇetyādinā kaphāpahaḥ, bhūtīketyādinā vātaśleṣmāpahaḥ| vāruṇo
                                varuṇaḥ amṛtakā guḍūcī, sarṣapairityatra patrairiti sambadhyate|
                                vaṃśo veṇuḥ| punaḥ śobhāñjanagrahaṇāddvitīyo viṭapaśobhāñjano
                                gṛhyate, saireyaḥ jhiṇṭī||29-33||
eta eva ca niryūhāḥ prayojyā jalakoṣṭhake

eta eveti nāḍīsvedoktāstrayo+api| jalakoṣṭhaḥ
                                avagāhārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mahajjalapātram; evaṃ ghṛtakṣīratailakoṣṭhāśca
                                vyākhyātāḥ||34||

godhūmaśakalaiḥ godhūmacūrṇaiḥ| kiṇvaḥ
                                surābījam| upanāhaḥ bahalaṃ lepaṃ dattvā carmādibhirāvṛtya
                                vyādhiyuktasyāṅgasya bandhanam; carmabhiścopanaddhavya ityatra
                                    upanāho+anagnisvedo

‘ayaṃ cānagnirasvedo+atibahalatvena
                                    śarīroṣmarodhaṃ kṛtvā svedayati’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

grāhyaḥ| gandhaiḥ sugandhidravyairupanāho bandhanīyaḥ|
                                uṣṇavīryairiti uṣṇavīryamṛgādiprāṇiprabhavaiḥ

rātrau baddhaṃ divā muñcenmuñcedrātrau divā
                                kṛtam

upanāhasvede bandhamokṣāvadhiṃ darśayati- rātrau
                                baddhamityādi| divākṛtamityatra ‘bandhaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| vidāhaḥ

jentāko+aśmaghanaḥ karṣūḥ kuṭī bhūḥ kumbhikaiva ca

samprati sāgnisvedānāṃ saṅkarādīnāṃ

| prastīryata iti prastaraḥ śayanapramāṇena
                                svedavastūnāṃ vistaraṇaṃ, tasmin prastare| kauśeyāvikottarapracchade

                                veśavārapāyasakṛśarotkārikādīnāṃ vā prastare

svedanetyādinā nāḍīsvedamāha| svedanadravyāṇi
                                svedopagagaṇoktāni iha ca nāḍīsvedakvāthārthamuktāni| śiraḥpadaṃ

                                    snehāktagātraḥ

san nāḍyā
                                upaharediti sambandhaḥ| nāḍīkaraṇavidhimāha- śareṣīketyādi|
                                vaṃśadalo vaṃśavidalaḥ

|
                                gajāgrahastasaṃsthānatvaṃ nāḍyā agra eva boddhavyam| vyāmaḥ
                                tiryagvistṛtabāhudvayapramāṇaṃ; vyāmadīrghatvaṃ nāḍyā bahalasvede
                                kartavyam| vyāmacaturthabhāgena vyāmāṣṭabhāgena ca mūle agre ca

                                boddhavyam||43||

svedanadravyāṇāṃ punarmūlaphalapatraśuṅgādīnāṃ
                                mṛgaśakunapiśitaśiraspadādīnāmuṣṇasvabhāvānāṃ vā
                                yathārhamamlalavaṇasnehopasaṃhitānāṃ mūtrakṣīrādīnāṃ vā kumbhyāṃ
                                bāṣpamanudvamantyāmutkvathitānāṃ nāḍyā
                                śareṣīkāvaṃśadalakarañjārkapatrānyatamakṛtayā
