                                bṛṃhaṇamucyate

prāyaśaḥ kaṭhinaṃ caiva yaddravyaṃ taddhi
                                rūkṣaṇam
dravaṃ sūkṣmaṃ saraṃ snigdhaṃ picchilaṃ guru śītalam
prāyo mandaṃ mṛdu ca yaddravyaṃ tatsnehanaṃ matam

uṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ saraṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dravaṃ
                                sthiram
dravyaṃ guru ca yat prāyastaddhi svedanamucyate

śītaṃ mandaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dravaṃ
                                sthiram
yaddravyaṃ laghu coddiṣṭaṃ prāyastat stambhanaṃ smṛtam

catuṣprakārā saṃśuddhiriti anuvāsanaṃ
                                varjayitvā, tasya bṛṃhaṇatvāt||18||

uktasya daśaprakāralaṅghanasya bhinnaṃ
                                viṣayamāha- prabhūtetyādi| ādāviti vacanamante cchardyādīnāṃ
                                nirāmāṇāṃ saṃśamanīyatvāt| rogāniti laṅghanīyarogān| balināmiti
                                padaṃ balavatāmeva vyāyāmādisevābhidhānārtham| madhyabalāniti
                                madhyabalānapi; etenāñjasā alpabalā eva gadā vyāyāmādiviṣayā iti
                                bhāvaḥ| bṛṃhiṇāṃ bṛṃhaṇayuktānām| laṅghanaṃ śastamiti daśavidhamapi|
                                śiśira iti śiśiraguṇayukte hemante śiśire ca; atra ca laṅghanaṃ
                                balavattvāt prāṇināṃ kāryam||19-24||

adigdhaviddhamiti viṣāktaśastrāviddham| sātmye
                                deśe carantīti sātmyacāriṇaḥ| laghava iti saṃskāreṇa laghavaḥ; kiṃvā
                                kravyādānāṃ ye laghavaḥ śyenādayaḥ, tanmāṃsarasā ityarthaḥ||25-28||

kṣīṇāḥ kṣatāḥ kṛśā vṛddhā durbalā
                                nityamadhvagāḥ
strīmadyanityā grīṣme ca bṛṃhaṇīyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ

snehāḥ snehayitavyāśca svedāḥ svedyāśca ye
                                narāḥ

madhvādīnāṃ ca sevanamiti sambandhaḥ| khaliḥ
                                sarṣapakhaliḥ; piṇyākaṃ tilakhaliḥ, kiṃvā piṇyākaśākam|
                                prabhṛtigrahaṇādāḍhyavātapramehādayo grāhyaḥ||29-31||

tanu abahalam| sarati gacchatīti saraṃ, na
                                saramasaraṃ, sthiramityarthaḥ||32-33||
svādu tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca stambhanaṃ sarvameva tat

kṣutpipāsayorasahaḥ pīḍākaratvenodayaḥ
                                kṣutpipāsāsahodayaḥ, na tu kṣutpipāsayoryugapadudayaḥ

'kṣutpipāsayorasahaḥ pīḍākaratvenodayaḥ kṣutpipāsāsahodayaḥ, na
                                    kṣuptipāsayoryugapadudaya iti, suśrute- “sṛṣṭamārutaviṇmūtraṃ
                                    kṣutpipāsāsahaṃ laghum” ityuktatvāditi cakraḥ; kintu,
                                    “kṣuttṛṭsahodayaḥ śuddhahṛdayodvārakaṇṭhatā ;
                                    vyādhimārdavamutsāhastandrānāśāśca laṅghite” (sū.a.14) iti
                                    vāgbhaṭavacanādyugapadudaya ityartho+api pramāṇasiddha eva' iti
                                    śivadāsasenaḥ;

| ata evoktaṃ suśrute-
                                “sṛṣṭamārutaviṇmūtraṃ kṣutpipāsāsahaṃ laghum” (su. u. taṃ. 39)
                                ityādi| antarātmanīti manasi| manasaḥ sambhramo bhrāntireva| ūrdhve
                                kāye vāta ūrdhvavātaḥ

'ūrdhvakāye vāta ūrdhvavāto
                                    hikkāśvāsakarṇasvanajṛmbhādiḥ; na punarudgāra viśeṣaḥ,
                                    tasyāvarodhakakaphajanyatvāt; prakṛte tu laṅghanena
                                    kaphasaṅkṣayāt, sa ca kaphakopāt; yaduktaṃ “adhaḥpratihato vāyuḥ
                                    śleṣmaṇā kupitena ca; karoti nityamudgāramūrdhvavātaḥ sa ucyate”
                                    iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

kārśyadoṣavivarjanamiti kārśye ye doṣāḥ
                                śītoṣṇāsahatvādayaḥ, teṣāṃ varjanam||38||-

bale labdhe iti balavān yadā puruṣo bhavati|
                                yathoktairiti “pittakṣārāgnidagdhā ye” ityādyabhidheyaiḥ| udvega
                                ūrdhvavātavegaḥ; kiṃvā bhaiṣajyānabhilāṣaḥ||39-40||

tadauṣadhānāmiti laṅghanādisādhyānām| vṛddhireva
                                ceti stokamātrakṛtalaṅghanādikriyayā doṣakṣobhamātrasya kṛtatvāt|
                                dhātūnāmiti doṣāṇāṃ, “doṣā api dhātuśabdaṃ labhante” iti
                                vacanāt||41-42||

sampratyuktalaṅghanādyupakramāṇāṃ vikārāpekṣayā
                                saṃsargamāha- doṣāṇāmityādi| doṣāṇāṃ yasmāt saṃsargā bahavaḥ,
                                tasmāttatsādhanārthamupakramā api saṅkīryante miśratāṃ yānti| yathā-
                                kvacillaṅghanasvedane, kvacidbṛṃhaṇasnehane

, evamādi| ṣaṭtvaṃ tu nātivartanta iti saṃsṛṣṭā
                                api laṅghanādisvarūpaṃ na jahati; na laṅghanādayaḥ parasparayuktā
                                madhusarpiḥsaṃyogavat prakṛtiguṇānapekṣikāryāntaramārabhanta iti
                                bhāvaḥ| atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha- tritvamityādi| ayaṃ ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ
                                saṃsargisaṅkhyā+aparityāgamātrakaḥ||43||

bhavati cātra- doṣāṇāṃ bahusaṃsargāt saṅkīryante
                                hyupakramāḥ
ṣaṭtvaṃ tu nātivartante tritvaṃ vātādayo yathā

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                ślokasthāne laṅghanabṛṃhaṇīyo nāma dvāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yojanācatuṣke
                                laṅghanabṛṃhaṇīyo nāma dvāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||22||

vyākhyātaṣaḍupakramāṇāmeva
                                santarpaṇāpatarpaṇabhedena dvividhānāṃ dvividhaviṣaye pravṛttiṃ
                                darśayituṃ santarpaṇīyo+abhidhīyate

'pūrvādhyāye ṣaḍupakramā
                                    uktāste santarpaṇāpatarpaṇabhedena dvividhāḥ, taduktam,
                                    “upakramyasya hi dvitvāddvidhaivopakramo mataḥ| ekaḥ santarpaṇaḥ
                                    prokto dvitīyaścāpatarpaṇaḥ” (vā. sū. 14) iti| atasteṣāṃ
                                    dvividhaviṣaye pravṛttiṃ darśayituṃ santarpaṇīyo+abhidhīyate-
                                    athāta ityādi' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

santarpayati santarpaṇamācarati|
                                snigdhairityādivacanamasnigdhādibhirapi
                                śaktuprabhṛtibhistṛptimātrakārakatvena santarpaṇaniṣedhārthaṃ;
                                bhavati hi tṛptikārake santarpaṇaśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā+atraiva
                                santarpaṇaprayoge- “śaktūnāṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇo bhāgaḥ santarpaṇaṃ pibet”
                                iti| śayyāsanasukhe ratatvenaiva ceṣṭādveṣitve labdhe
                                punastadvacanaṃ śayyāsanasthitasyāpi
                                gītāṅgacālanādiceṣṭāniṣedhārtham| āmapradoṣā visūcikādayaḥ|
                                pramīlakaḥ satataṃ pradhyānam||3-7||

sakṣaudraścābhayāprāśa iti kṣaudreṇa saha
                                harītakīprāśaḥ; kiṃvā agastyaharītakyādiprāśaḥ| ye coktā iti
                                āragvadhīye (sū. 3)| teneti kvāthena karaṇabhūtena,
                                abhyasyato+abhyāsaṃ kurvāṇasya; kiṃvā tena kvāthena
                                triphalādīnyabhyasyata iti yojanā| yathādoṣamiti doṣapramāṇāpekṣayā
                                gṛhītamātram| udvartanamabhyaṅgapūrvakam,
                                uddharṣastvanabhyaṅgapūrvakaḥ| snehopasaṃhitairiti
                                snehasādhanopayuktaiḥ| gomedakaḥ maṇiviśeṣaḥ| krauñcaḥ pakṣī,
                                ‘koñca’ iti khyātaḥ| kharāhvā ajamodā| lohodakāpluta iti
                                agurūdakāplutaḥ| udakakaraṇaṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgajalavidhānena| iha prayoge
                                vakṣyamāṇavyoṣādyuktapramāṇena sāhacaryāccūrṇādimānaṃ jñeyam|
                                santarpaṇamiti jalāloḍitaśakturūpatayā, tena
                                santarpaṇasañjñasyāpyapatarpaṇatā jñeyā| śvaitryaṃ śvitritvaṃ;
                                ‘śvaityaṃ’ iti pāṭhe śvetāvabhāsatā||8-25||-
śvadaṃṣṭrā khadiro nimbo haridre tvakca vatsakāt

kuṣṭhaṃ gomedako hiṅgu krauñcāsthi tryūṣaṇaṃ
                                vacā

'vyoṣamityādi; atra
                                    tailaghṛtakṣaudrāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ militacūrṇasamatvaṃ,
                                    samuditacūrṇamapekṣyaiva saktūnāṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇo bhāgaḥ' iti
                                    śivadāsasenaḥ;
bṛhatyau dve haridre dve pāṭhāmativiṣāṃ sthirām
hṛdrogo rājayakṣmā ca kāsaḥ śvāso galagrahaḥ

ūrdhvavātādaya iti pūrvādhyāyoktāḥ
                                “ūrdhvavātastamo hṛdi” (sū. 22) ityādayaḥ| ūrdhvavātaḥ
                                śvāsādiryatrordhvaṃ vāyuryāti; kiṃvā tantrāntarokto rogaviśeṣa eva,
                                yathā- “adhaḥ pratihato vāyuḥ śleṣmaṇā kupitena ca|
                                karotyaniśamudgāramūrdhvavātaḥ sa ucyate” iti||26-30||

sadyastarpaṇatarpaṇābhyāsayoruktayorviṣayabhedamāha- sadya ityādi|
                                atvaramāṇeneti vacanena ciradurbale tvarayā kriyamāṇaṃ
                                tarpaṇamagnivadhādidoṣaṃ karotīti sūcayati| tarpaṇāstarpaṇāśceti
                                santarpaṇakārakā manthādayaḥ; tena, iha

sañjñāmātreṇa ye tarpaṇā apatarpaṇakārakā vyoṣādayaste na grāhyāḥ;
                                    kintu
hitā māṃsarasāstasmai payāṃsi ca ghṛtāni ca
saktavo madirā kṣaudraṃ śarkarā ceti tarpaṇam
svāduramlo jalakṛtaḥ sasneho rūkṣa eva vā

svāduramla ityādinā sadyastarpaṇamāha| amla iti
                                amladāḍimādiyogāt| atra rūkṣasaktukṛtasyāpi manthasya
                                dravatvaśaityadehānusāritvaiḥ sadyaḥsantarpakatvaṃ bhavatyeva, ata
                                eva ‘sadya’ ityuktaṃ, snehādibṛṃhaṇadravyayogāttu
                                kālāntaratarpakatvamapi bhavati||39||

tatra ślokaḥ- santarpaṇotthā ye rogā rogā ye
                                cāpatarpaṇāt

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                ślokasthāne santarpaṇīyo nāma trayoviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yojanācatuṣke
                                santarpaṇīyo nāma trayoviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||23||

samprati vātādivadbahuvikārakartṛtvena śoṇitasya
                                śoṇitavikārāṇāṃ pūrvoktānevopakramān laṅghanabṛṃhaṇādīn viśeṣeṇa
                                darśayituṃ vidhiśoṇitīyo+abhidhīyate| iyamapyarthaparā sañjñā
vidhinā śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ śuddhaṃ bhavati dehinām

vidhineti samyagāhārācāravidhinā| śuddhaṃ
                                bhavatītyatra bhavati vidyata ityarthaḥ, utpādasya
                                jātaśabdenaivoktatvāt| kena vidhinetyāha- deśetyādi| sātmyaśabdasya
                                deśādibhiḥ pratyekamanvayaḥ| okasātmyam abhyāsasātmyam| samprakāśita
                                iti tasyāśitīye (sū.a.6), samprakāśita ityatra ‘tena’ iti śeṣaḥ; ato
                                yaḥ samprakāśito vidhistena vidhineti sambandhaḥ| anye
                                vyākhyānayanti- śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ tāvadbhavati, tacca kāraṇāntaraduṣṭaṃ
                                sadvidhinā yathoktena punaḥ śuddhaṃ bhavatīti yojanīyam||3||

viśuddhaṃ śoṇitaṃ kiṃ karotītyāha-
                                tadviśuddhamityādi| tena vidhinā viśuddhaṃ tadviśuddhaṃ; kiṃvā
                                taditi śoṇitam| prāṇaḥ śoṇitaṃ hyanuvartata iti
                                śoṇitānvayavyatirekamanuvidhīyate| yaduktaṃ- “daśaivāyatanānyāhuḥ
                                prāṇā yeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ| śaṅkhau marmatrayaṃ kaṇṭho raktaṃ
                                śukraujasī gudam”- (sū.a.29) iti||4||

śuddhihetumabhidhāya duṣṭihetumāha-
                                praduṣṭetyādi| praduṣṭaṃ svaprakṛtiviparītam| anyaiśca tadvidhairiti
                                praduṣṭapānakādibhiḥ; kiṃvā ‘annaiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ|
                                tathā+atilavaṇakṣārairityādi kecidbheṣajaviṣayaṃ varṇayanti,
                                tadvidhairiti vacanenānnapānasyātilavaṇādergṛhītatvāt| niṣpāvaḥ
                                śvetaśimbiḥ| atyādānaṃ tṛptimatikramya bhojanam| kāle ceti
                                śoṇitaduṣṭiyukte śaratkāle| ajīrṇe+adhyaśanamajīrṇādhyaśanaṃ; kiṃvā
                                ajīrṇasyāpakvasyāśanamajīrṇāśanam, adhyaśanaṃ tu pūrvānnaśeṣe
                                yadbhujyate, yadāha- “bhuktasyopari yadbhuktaṃ tadadhyaśanamucyate”
                                (ci.a.15)||5-10||

upakuśaḥ mukharogaviśeṣaḥ; yaduktaṃ suśrute-
                                “veṣṭeṣu dāhaḥ pākaśca tebhyo dantāścalanti ca| yasminnupakuśo nāma
                                pittaraktakṛto gadaḥ” (su. ni. 16) iti| kuṣṭha ityukte+api
                                carmadalābhidhānaṃ viśeṣārtham| śoṇitāśrayā iti bhāṣayā śoṇitasya
                                vātādivat svātantryeṇa rogakartṛtvaṃ nirākaroti|
                                anuktabhūriśoṇitarogagrahaṇārthamāha- śītoṣṇetyādi|
                                ādyagrahaṇāttīkṣṇamṛdvādīnāṃ grahaṇam| samyagiti pūrveṇa
                                    yojanīyam

| tatra śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairiti śoṇitavṛddhimanapekṣya
                                vātādijayārthamātraprayuktairiti mantavyam| yena śoṇitavyādherapi
                                śāntirvakṣyamāṇaraktapittaharakriyādibhiḥ
                                śītoṣṇasnigdhādikriyāpraviṣṭaiva, tataśca śoṇitarogasyāpi
                                śītādikriyābhireva śoṇitapratikūlābhiḥ praśamo bhavati;
                                pravṛddhaśoṇitāśrayāstu vātādaya āśrayaprabhāvānna svacikitsāmātreṇa
                                praśāmyanti||11-17||
samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti raktajāṃstān vibhāvayet

uktaśoṇitasrāvaṇapramāṇamāha- baletyādi|
                                baladoṣapramāṇāditi balasya tathā doṣasya śoṇitavyādhirūpasya
                                pramāṇaṃ vīkṣya; doṣaśabdo hyayaṃ roge vartate| viśuddhyā rudhirasya
                                ceti yāvatā srāvaṇena śoṇitaṃ viśuddhaṃ bhavati| āśayaṃ sthānaṃ
                                duṣṭaśoṇitāśa(śra)yamiti yāvat| yathā- svalpe kuṣṭhe stokameva
                                viśuddhyarthamupādeyaṃ, mahati kuṣṭhe bahu srāvaṇīyam| yaduktaṃ-
                                “pracchanamalpe kuṣṭhe mahati ca śastaṃ sirāvyadhanam” (ci. 7) iti|
                                eṣu ca pakṣeṣu yadyatrānatyayaṃ bhavati tattatra grāhyam||19||

tapanīyaṃ lohitasuvarṇam, indragopaḥ
                                svanāmaprasiddhaḥ kīṭaviśeṣaḥ| viśuddharaktaliṅge nānāvarṇatā
                                vātādiprakṛtitvānmanuṣyāṇām||22|

nātyuṣṇādibhojane hetumāha- tadetyādi|
                                atiśītamagnimāndyaṃ karoti, atyuṣṇaṃ ca pracalasyāsṛjo nitarāṃ
                                pracalatāṃ karoti, tasmānnātyuṣṇaśītam| laghu dīpanīyaṃ
                                cāgnidīptyarthameva||23||

samprati śoṇitādarśanenāpi
                                viśuddharaktajñānārthaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- prasannetyādi| avyāhatā
                                paktiśca vegaśca purīṣādīnāṃ yasya sa tathā||24||

samprati raktavāhidhamanīduṣṭyā ye vyādhayo
                                bhavanti tānāha- yadā tvityādi| sañjñāvahānīti sañjñāhetumanovahāni,
                                manasastu kevalameva śarīramayanībhūtaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “sattvādīnāṃ
                                punaḥ kevalaṃ śarīramayanībhūtam” (vi. 5) ityādi; kiṃvā rasasañjñaṃ
                                dhātumāvahantīti rasasañjñavahāni

'anye tu rasasañjñaṃ
                                    dhātumāvahantīti rasasañjñavahānītyāhuḥ; kintu
                                    “rasāsṛkcetanāvāhisrotorodhasamudbhavāḥ; madamūrcchāyasannyāsā
                                    yathottarabalottarāḥ” iti tantrāntare
                                    manovahadhamanīduṣṭirvyaktā, sā cāsmin vyākhyāne nopapadyate,
                                    iti pūrvavyākhyaiva yuktā' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

|
                                rasavahadhamanīnāṃ tu hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ, tadupaghātācca moha upapanna
                                eva| malā iti duṣṭadoṣasañjñāḥ; yaduktaṃ- “malinīkaraṇānmalāḥ” iti|
                                yathottaraṃ liṅgādhikyaṃ madamūrcchāyasannyāseṣu moharūpaṃ jñeyaṃ;
                                made+api hi stoko moho+asti, uttarayostu vyakta eva mohaḥ||25-29||
pṛthak pṛthak samastā vā srotāṃsi kupitā malāḥ
durbalaṃ cetasaḥ sthānaṃ yadā vāyuḥ prapadyate
yaśca madyakṛtaḥ prokto viṣajo raudhiraśca yaḥ

madaprasaṅgena madyaviṣajayorapi
                                madayoścāturvidhyamāha- yaścetyādi| vātapittakaphatrayāditi vātāt
                                pittāt kaphādvātapittakaphācca; etena teṣāmapyetadeva lakṣaṇaṃ
                                vātādikṛtaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ||34||

mūrcchāyalakṣaṇamāha- nīlaṃ vetyādi| tatra
                                vātamūrcchāye śyāvāruṇā chāyā riṣṭarūpatvānmaraṇāya syād
                                vāyavyatvāditi codyaṃ kurvanti; uktaṃ hi- “vāyavyā sā vināśāya
                                kleśāya mahate+api vā” (iṃ. 7) iti| tanna, animittā hi chāyā riṣṭaṃ
                                na tu dṛśyamānanimittā, iha ca vātasambandho dṛśyata eva nimittaṃ;
                                kiṃvā “kleśāya mahate+api vā” iti vacanādeva vāyavyacchāyāyā
                                mārakatvaṃ vyabhicaritam| tamobhirghanaiśceti tamoghanaiḥ; kiṃvā
                                tamobhireva ghanaiḥ| vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitairiti
                                dantakhādanāṅgavikṣepaṇādikaṃ vinā||35-41||

'tamaḥ praviśati mūrcchatītyarthaḥ, śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyata iti

amitābhyāṃ jñānavijñānābhyāṃ chinnaḥ saṃśayo
                                yeṣāṃ te tathā| “bhavantaśchettumarhanti kāśirājasya saṃśayam” iti
                                pāṭhaḥ sugamaḥ| “bhavanto+arhanti naśchettuṃ kāśirāje ca saṃśayam”

ātmajaḥ puruṣa ityādipraśnadvayasyottaraṃ; tatra

|
                                praśnottaratā tvasya granthasya sugamaiva| kāraṇatve hetumāha- sa

ātmajaḥ puruṣo rogāścātmajāḥ kāraṇaṃ hi saḥ
sa cinotyupabhuṅkte ca karma karmaphalāni ca

mana ityukte manyate+aneneti
                                vyutpattyā+a+atmā+api śaṅkyeta, taduktaṃ- sattvasañjñakamiti| narte
                                śarīrācchārīrā vātādijanyāḥ śoṣādayastiṣṭhanti; tathā na manasaḥ
                                sthitiḥ, ṛte śarīrāditi yojyam| rajastamaḥparītasya hi manaso nityaṃ
                                śarīra eva sthitiḥ; yattu nirdoṣaṃ manastattu na puruṣasya nāpi ca
                                vyādheḥ kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| rasajānītyādau smṛtā nirvṛttihetava iti
                                vyādhipuruṣayoḥ| etena vyādhipuruṣajanakarasakāraṇatvenāpaḥ
                                kāraṇakāraṇatayā puruṣavikārayoḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavanti| kiṃvā āpo
                                nirvṛttihetava iti rasānāṃ; kiṃvā yasmādrasavatya āpastasmāttā
                                nirvṛttihetava iti yojanā||10-13||
vāryovidastu netyāha na hyekaṃ kāraṇaṃ manaḥ

'na hyekaṃ kāraṇaṃ mana' iti 'vyādhimātraṃ prati' iti śeṣaḥ;
                                    vyādhimātraṃ prati manasaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ kathaṃ nāstītyāha- narte
                                    ityādi; mānasarogeṣveva manasaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ, śārīrā vātādijanyā
                                    vyādhayaḥ punaḥ śarīrādṛte na tiṣṭhantīti śarīrasyaiva
                                    kāraṇatvaṃ, na tu manasa iti bhāvaḥ śarīrotpattāvapi manasaḥ
                                    kāraṇatvaṃ nāstītyāha- na manasaḥ sthitiriti; atrāpi śarīrādṛta
                                    iti yojyaṃ, śarīramantareṇa raja stamaḥsambaddhasya manasaḥ
                                    sthitireva nāsti, manasi rajastamaḥsambandhasya śarīrādhīnatvāt;
                                    tathā rajastamaḥsambandhe sati śarīrotpattiḥ, śarīrasambandhe ca
                                    manasi rajastamaḥsambandha iti
                                    parasparāśrayaprasaṅgāccharīrotpattiṃ prati rajastamaḥparītasya
                                    manasaḥ kāraṇatvaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ; rasajānītyādi; bhūtāni
                                    pṛthivyādīni; etena teṣāṃ rasajatvena tanmelakasya puruṣasyāpi
                                    rasajatvamiti bhāvaḥ' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

nahyātmetyādau nātīndriyaṃ mano rasajaṃ
                                smṛtamiti yojanā; yasmādatīndriyaṃ mana ātmā cātīndriyaḥ, tasmānna

                                vikāre na rasaḥ kāraṇamityarthaḥ| ātmā pṛthivyādīni ca pañca ṣaḍ
                                dhātavaḥ| yaduktaṃ- “khādayaścetanāṣaṣṭhā dhātavaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ”

hiraṇyākṣastu netyāha na hyātmā rasajaḥ smṛtaḥ

nahyṛte karmaṇo janma rogāṇāṃ puruṣasya vā

kartā pūrvaṃ hītyādi| karmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ kartā
                                ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| yena karmaṇā sa puruṣaḥ kartavyaḥ, tasya
                                karmaṇaḥ puruṣapūrvabhāvitvāt
                                    kāraṇatvaṃ
svīkartavyaṃ; tataśca sa cedvinā karma puruṣo+abhūt

, tat kathaṃ puruṣasya karma kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ|

bharadvājastu netyāha kartā pūrvaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ
dṛṣṭaṃ na cākṛtaṃ karma yasya syāt puruṣaḥ phalam

svabhāvādityatra ādau ‘yadi’ ityadhyāhartavyaṃ;

| sraṣṭetyādau jagataḥ sukhaduḥkhayośca
                                sraṣṭā prajāpatiriti yojanā| sa ca brahmaṇo+apatyam| amitasaṅkalpa

jagat kālavaśaṃ sarvaṃ kālaḥ sarvatra kāraṇam

pakṣasaṃśrayāditi rāgataḥ pakṣasaṅgrahāt|
                                niścitāniveti paramārthato+aniścitā eva, paraṃ
                                pakṣarāgādbuddhiprakarṣānniścitā ivābhidhīyante pakṣā ityarthaḥ|
                                pakṣāntamiti samyagarthāvadhāraṇarūpaṃ pakṣāntam|
                                tilapīḍakastailārthaṃ yantropari sthito manuṣyaḥ; tilapīḍako yathā
                                gatau gamane sati, gamyadeśāprāptyā cāntaṃ nāsādayati, punastatraiva
                                bhramaṇāt; tathā pakṣasaṃśrayādvādino+apītyarthaḥ| saṅghaṭṭaḥ
                                anyonyapīḍako melakaḥ| adhyātmaṃ tattvam| skandhaḥ samūhaḥ|
                                pakṣarāgaśceha tattvajñānapratibandhakatvena tamaskandha ucyate|
                                siddhāntamāha- yeṣāmityādi| yeṣāmiti yajjātīyānāṃ, te ca
                                mahābhūtādayaḥ| tena mahābhūtatvenaiva vātādīnāṃ grahaṇam| sampaditi
                                praśastaguṇatā| naramiti saṃyogipuruṣam| vipaditi vaiguṇyam|
                                samudīrayediti janayet| eteṣāṃ ca ṛṣivādānāṃ kathanaṃ
                                pūrvapakṣasiddhāntaśravaṇena
                                    śiṣyasandehanivṛttyartham
maivaṃ vocata tattvaṃ hi duṣprāpaṃ pakṣasaṃśrayāt

prādhānyaṃ
                                darśayati nānyapratiṣedham, ācārasya svapnādestathā śabdādīnāmapi
                                kāraṇatvenoktatvāt| vyādhinimittamiti vyādhyabhivṛddhinimittaṃ
                                madhyapadalopājjñeyam, abhivṛddhikāraṇasyaiva pṛṣṭatvāt;
                                tathā+ahitāhārasya yadvyādhinimittatvaṃ, tasya ‘teṣāmeva
                                vipadvyādhīn vividhān samudīrayet’ ityanenaivoktatvāt| kiṃvā
                                vyādhinimittaśabdena sāmānyena janako vardhakaśca heturucyate|
                                anapavādamiti avyabhicāri| hitāhitāhāradurjñānatāhetumāha-
                                hitasamākhyātānāmityādi| viparītakāritvamiti pathyasyāpathyatvaṃ
                                tathā apathyasya pathyatvaṃ mātrādivaśādbhavati| tatra pathyā
                                raktaśālyādayo+atimātrā hīnamātrā vā mātrādoṣādapathyā bhavanti|
                                tathā kālavaśātta eva raktaśālyādayo laghutvādbalavadagnīnāṃ hemante
                                na hitāḥ; kālaśabdena ceha nityaga eva kālo gṛhyate, āvasthikasya
                                puraṣāvasthāśabdena gṛhītatvāt| kriyā tu saṃskaraṇaṃ, tena ca
                                raktaśālirasamyaksvinnāprasrutatvādinā odanadoṣeṇāhito bhavati,
                                tathā sa eva bhūmisambandhādānūpadeśajaḥ sannapathyo bhavati| tathā
                                dehāpekṣayā medasvino raktaśālirlaghutayā na hito bhavati, taduktaṃ-

                                tathā- puruṣasya bālyāvasthāyāṃ śleṣmapradhānāyāṃ tiktādi pathyaṃ,

                                mātrādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| evamahitasyāpi mātrādiparigraheṇa

athātreyasya bhagavato vacanamanuniśamya punareva
                                vāmakaḥ kāśipatiruvāca bhagavantamātreyaṃ- bhagavan!

                                kimabhivṛddhikāraṇamiti

tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ- hitāhāropayoga eka eva
                                puruṣavṛddhikaro bhavati, ahitāhāropayogaḥ
                                    punarvyādhinimittamiti

evaṃvādinaṃ bhagavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca-
                                kathamiha bhagavan! hitāhitānāmāhārajātānāṃ
                                lakṣaṇamanapavādamabhijānīmahe;
                                hitasamākhyātānāmāhārajātānāmahitasamākhyātānāṃ ca
                                mātrākālakriyābhūmidehadoṣapuruṣāvasthāntareṣu
                                viparītakāritvamupalabhāmaha iti

siddhāntayati- yadāhārajātamityādi| anena ca
                                granthena hitāhitatvaṃ na svarūpeṇa bhāvānāṃ, kintu
                                mātrādisavyapekṣamiti darśitaṃ bhavati| na tvetadityādi| etaditi
                                hitāhitam| evamupadiṣṭamiti yadāhārajātamityādilakṣaṇoddiṣṭam|
                                vijñāsyanti na tviti sambandhaḥ| etasmin hitāhitalakṣaṇe
                                    mātrādyavasthāntarajñānaṃ

vinā na hitatvamahitatvaṃ vā hitānāṃ
                                raktaśālyādīnāmahitānāṃ yavakādīnāṃ ca jñātuṃ pāryate,
                                mātrādyavasthāyāśca durjñānatvena sarvavaidyā jñātumakṣamā iti
                                bhāvaḥ||33-34||

tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ- yadāhārajātamagniveśa!
                                samāṃścaiva śarīradhātūn prakṛtau sthāpayati viṣamāṃśca
                                samīkarotītyetaddhitaṃ viddhi, viparītaṃ tvahitamiti;
                                ityetaddhitāhitalakṣaṇamanapavādaṃ bhavati

evaṃvādinaṃ ca bhagavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca-
                                bhagavan! na tvetadevamupadiṣṭaṃ bhūyiṣṭhakalpāḥ sarvabhiṣajo
                                vijñāsyanti

etadevāsarvabhiṣagjñeyatvaṃ lakṣaṇasyāha- yeṣāṃ
                                hītyādi| guṇata iti iha prakaraṇe gurulaghutvādiguṇataḥ| dravyata
                                iti kāraṇataḥ, yathā- idamāpyamidamāgneyamityādi; kiṃvā dravyata
                                ityāhāradravyādraktaśālyādeḥ| karmataḥ kāryataḥ; yathā- idaṃ
                                jīvanamidaṃ bṛṃhaṇamityādi| sarvāvayavaśaśceti
                                rasavīryavipākaprabhāvebhyaḥ| mātrādayaścānantaroktāḥ puruṣāntā
                                jñeyāḥ| āhāratattvaṃ ca guṇādibhyo viditaṃ mātrādayaśca viditā iti
                                yojanā| kiṃvā guṇaśabdena rasavīryādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ,
                                sarvāvayavaśaśceti mātrādijñānena sambadhyate| yathetyādau etaditi
                                hitāhitam| bhūyiṣṭhakalpā nānāprakārā uttamādhamamadhyamā ityarthaḥ,
                                bhūyiṣṭhakalpā iti kṛtvā sarvagrahaṇamuttamādīnāmeva
                                śreṣṭhaśreṣṭhataraśreṣṭhatamādibhedagrahaṇārthaṃ; kiṃvā
                                    śalyādyaṣṭāṅgādhyāyivaidyagrahaṇārthaṃ

; kiṃvā
                                bhūyiṣṭhakalpā iti vijñātabhūrihitāhitodāharaṇāḥ; agryādhikāre hi
                                bahu hitāhitaṃ vaktavyaṃ, taccālpabuddhīnāṃ vyavahārāya bhavati,
                                prakṛṣṭabuddhīnāṃ cānuktajñānāyeti bhāvaḥ| lakṣaṇata iti
                                    lakṣaṇamāhāratvaṃ

                                    śītavīryasyāpi ghṛtasya tattaddravyasaṃyogāduṣṇatā, tathā
                                    māṃsarasasiddhasya raktaśālergurutvamityādi' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

; deśo dvividho bhūmirāturaśca, tatra bhūmau ‘śvetakāpotī
                                valmīkādhirūḍhā viṣaharī’, tathā “himavati bheṣajāni mahāguṇāni
                                bhavanti”, śarīradeśe yathā- “sakthimāṃsādgurutaraṃ
                                skandhakroḍaśiraspadām” (sū. 27) ityādi; kālavaśaṃ tu yathā
                                mūlakamadhikṛtyoktaṃ- “tadbālaṃ doṣaharaṃ vṛddhaṃ tridoṣam” (sū.
                                27), tathā “yathartupuṣpaphalamādadīta” (ka. 1) ityādi| atra
                                caikaprakaraṇoktā ye+anuktāste cakārāt
                                svabhāvādiṣvevāntarbhāvanīyāḥ| yaduktaṃ- “caraḥ śarīrāvayavāḥ
                                svabhāvo dhātavaḥ kriyāḥ| liṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ saṃskāro mātrā cāsmin
                                parīkṣyate” (sū. 27) iti| tatra, caraśarīrāvayavadhātūnāṃ deśena
                                grahaṇaṃ, mātrā vicāre praviśati, śeṣaṃ svabhāve; tathā rasavimāne
                                vakṣyamāṇaṃ cātrāpraviṣṭamāhāraviśeṣāyatanamantarbhāvanīyaṃ
                                yathāsambhavam| snigdharūkṣādyā ityatrādigrahaṇenānuktā api
                                tīkṣṇamṛdvādayo na rasāḥ, kintu dravyaguṇāḥ pṛthageveti darśayati|
                                kṣaraṇāt adhogamanakriyāyogāt kṣāro dravyaṃ nāsau rasaḥ, rasasya hi
                                niṣkriyasya kriyā+anupapannetyarthaḥ| kṣaraṇaṃ ca kṣārasya
                                pānīyayuktasyādhogamanena, vadanti hi laukikāḥ- ‘kṣāraṃ srāvayāmaḥ’
                                iti; śāstraṃ ca- “chittvā chittvā+a+aśayāt kṣāraḥ kṣaratvāt
                                kṣārayatyadhaḥ” (ci. 5) iti| hetvantaramāha- dravyaṃ
                                tadanekarasotpannamiti; anekarasebhyo muṣkakāpāmārgādibhya
                                utpannamanekarasotpannaṃ; yataścānekarasotpannamata evānekarasaṃ,
                                kāraṇaguṇānuvidhāyitvāt kāryaguṇasyeti bhāvaḥ| anekarasatvamevāha-
                                kaṭukalavaṇabhūyiṣṭhamiti|-
                                bhūyiṣṭhaśabdenāpradhānarasāntarasambandho+astīti darśayati|
                                hetvantaramāha- anekendriyārthasamanvitamiti| kṣāro hi sparśena
                                gandhena cānvitaḥ, tena dravyaṃ, rase hi guṇe na sparśo nāpi gandha
                                iti bhāvaḥ| hetvantaramāha- karaṇābhinirvṛttamiti; karaṇena
                                bhasmaparisrāvaṇādinā+abhinirvṛttaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ, na raso+anena
                                prakāreṇa kriyata iti bhāvaḥ| avyaktarasapakṣaṃ niṣedhayati-
                                avyaktībhāva ityādi| avyaktībhāva ityabhūtatadbhāve cvipratyayena
                                rasānāṃ madhurādīnāṃ vyaktānāmeva kvacidādhāre+avyaktatvaṃ, nānyo
                                madhurādibhyo+avyaktarasa ityarthaḥ| rasānāmiti madhurādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇām|
                                prakṛtāvityādi| prakṛtau kāraṇe jala ityarthaḥ| avyaktatvaṃ ca
                                rasasāmānyamātropalabdhirmadhurādiviśeṣaśūnyā, sā ca jale bhavati;
                                yata uktaṃ jalaguṇakathane suśrute- “vyaktarasatā rasadoṣaḥ” (su.
                                sū. 45) iti, ihāpi ca ‘avyaktarasaṃ ca’ iti vakṣyati, loke+api
                                cāvyaktarasaṃ dravyamāsvādya vaktāro vadanti- jalasyevāsya raso na
                                    kaścinmadhurādirvyakta

iti| viśeṣamadhurādyanupalabdhiścānudbhūtatvena| yathā-
                                dūrādavijñāyamānaviśeṣavarṇe vastuni rūpasāmānyapratītirbhavati, na
                                śuklatvādiviśeṣabuddhiḥ, tathā+anurase+avyaktībhāvo bhavati;
                                pradhānaṃ vyaktaṃ rasamanugato+avyaktatvenetyanurasaḥ, yathā
                                veṇuyave madhure kaṣāyo+anurasaḥ| yaduktaṃ- “rūkṣaḥ kaṣāyānuraso
                                madhuraḥ kaphapittahā” (sū. 27) iti| anurasasamanvita iti
                                sarvānurasayukte, yathā- viṣe; vacanaṃ hi- “uṣṇamanirdeśyarasaṃ”
                                (ci. 23) ityādi| kiṃvā, ‘aṇurasasamanvite’ iti pāṭhaḥ; tena,
                                aṇurasenaikena maricena śarkarāpānake

'aparisaṅkhyeyapakṣaṃ dūṣayati- aparisaṅkhyeyatvamityādi;
                                    ādiśabdena guṇakarmasaṃsvādānāṃ grahaṇam,
                                    āśrayaguṇakarmasaṃsvādānāṃ ye viśeṣā
                                    bhedāsteṣāmaparisaṅkhyeyatvātteṣāṃ rasānāmaparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ
                                    yaducyate tanna yuktaṃ; tatra hetumāha- ekaiko+apītyādi;
                                    eṣāmāśrayaguṇakarmasaṃsvādānāṃ viśeṣanekaiko+api
                                    madhurādirāśrayate, na tvasmādāśrayādibhedādanyatvamāśritasya
                                    madhurāderbhavati; etena, āśrayādaya eva paraṃ bhinnāḥ,
                                    madhurādistveka evetyarthaḥ; tathāhi- yadyapi
                                    śālimudgaghṛtakṣīrādayo madhurasyāśrayā bhinnāḥ. tathā+api tatra
                                    madhuratvajātyākrānta eka eva raso bhavati, balākākṣīrādiṣu
                                    śuklavarṇavat; evaṅguṇānāṃ gurupicchilādīnāmanyatve+api tathā
                                    karmaṇāṃ rasādivardhanabalavarṇakaraṇādīnāṃ bhinnatve+api tathā
                                    madhurasyāvāntarāsvādabhede+api na madhurarasasyānyatvaṃ,
                                    madhuratvajātyanatikramāditi bhāvaḥ' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

dūṣayati- aparītyādi| teṣāmiti rasānām, aparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ na
                                yuktam; āśrayādīnāṃ bhāvānāmiti āśrayaguṇakarmasaṃsvādānām;
                                viśeṣāparisaṅkhyeyatvāditi āśrayādi bhedasyāparisaṅkhyeyatvāt| atra
                                hetumāha- ekaiko+api hītyādi| eṣāmāśrayaguṇakarmasaṃsvādānāṃ
                                viśeṣānekaiko+api madhurādirāśrayate, na ca
                                tasmādāśrayādibhedādanyatvamāśritasya madhurāderbhavati| evaṃ
                                manyate- yadyapi śālimudgaghṛtakṣīrādayo madhurasyāśrayā bhinnāḥ,
                                tathā+api tatra madhuratvajātyākrānta eka eva raso bhavati
                                balākākṣīrakārpāsādiṣu śuklavarṇa iva| tathā guṇānāṃ
                                gurupicchilasnigdhādīnāmanyatve+api karmaṇāṃ vā
                                rasādivardhanāyurjananavarṇakaratvādīnāṃ bhinnatve satyapi na
                                madhurarasasyānyatvaṃ, yata eka eva madhurastattadguṇayukto bhavati
                                tatkarmakārī ceti ko virodhaḥ| tathā madhurasyāvāntarāsvādabhede+api
                                madhuratvajātyanatikramaḥ, kṛṣṇavarṇāvāntarabhede yathā
                                kṛṣṇatvānatikramaḥ| nanu, maivaṃ bhavatvaparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ rasānāṃ,
                                parasparasaṃyogāttu ya āsvādaviśeṣaḥ sa kāryaviśeṣakaro+api; nahi
                                yanmadhurāmlena kriyate, tanmadhureṇa vā+amlena vā śakyam; atastena
                                parasparasaṃyogenāparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha- parasparetyādi|
                                saṃsṛṣṭamiti bhāvektaḥ, tena parasparasaṃsargabhūyiṣṭhatvādeṣāṃ
                                madhurādīnāmabhinirvṛtterna guṇaprakṛtīnāmasaṅkhyeyatvamiti yojanā;
                                ayamarthaḥ- yadyapi rasāḥ parasparasaṃsargeṇātibhūyasā yuktāḥ
                                santo+abhinirvṛttā dvirasādau dravye bhavanti, tathā+api na teṣāṃ
                                guṇā gurulaghvādayaḥ, prakṛtayo vā madhurādīnāṃ yā yā
                                āyuṣyatvarasābhivardhakatvādyāstā asaṅkhyeyā bhavanti, kintu ya eva
                                madhurādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtayaśca uddiṣṭāsta eva miśrā
                                bhavanti| kiṃvā guṇaprakṛtīnāmiti

'guṇaprakṛtīnāmiti
                                    parasparasaṃsargahetutvānmadhurādiguṇā eva prakṛtayaḥ, tāsāṃ
                                    madhurādiṣaḍguṇasvarūpāṇāmityarthaḥ; tathā ca,
                                    parasparasaṃsargabhūyiṣṭhatvādeṣāṃ rasānāmabhinirvṛtteḥ
                                    prakṛtibhūtānāṃ madhurādiguṇānāmasaṅkhyeyatvaṃ na ceti yojanā;
                                    tena, rasānāṃ rasāntarasaṃsarge rasāntarabhedasaṃsarge vā
                                    tatsaṃsargāṇāmevāparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ, na punaḥ
                                    prakṛtibhūtamadhurādiṣaḍrarasānāṃ ṣaṭtvātikramaḥ, yathā- doṣāṇāṃ
                                    parasparasaṃsargabhūyastve+api tritvānatikrama ityarthaḥ; yataḥ
                                    saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ rasānāṃ madhurādiṣaḍrasaprakṛtikatvānna
                                    rasāntaratvam, ata eva saṃsṛṣṭarasānāṃ pṛthakkarma
                                    śāstrāntare+api noktamityāha- tasmānna saṃsṛṣṭānāmityādi'; iti
                                    śivadāsasenaḥ;

madhurādiṣaḍguṇasvarūpāṇāmityarthaḥ;
                                tena, rasasya rasāntarasaṃsarge doṣāṇāmiva doṣāntarasaṃsarge rasānāṃ
                                nāparisaṅkhyeyatvamityarthaḥ| prakṛtiśabdena karma vocyate, tena
                                guṇakarmaṇāmityarthaḥ| madhurādīnāmavāntarāsvādaviśeṣo+api
                                parasparasaṃsargakṛte jñeyaḥ| yata eva heto rasānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ
                                nānye guṇakarmaṇī bhavataḥ, ata eva saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ rasānāṃ pṛthakkarma
                                śāstrāntare+api noktamityāha- tasmādityādi| karmaśabdeneha
                                gauravalāghavādikārakā gurutvādayo rasaraktādijananādayaścāpi
                                boddhavyāḥ| na kevalamanyaśāstrakārai rasānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ karma
                                nopadiṣṭaṃ, kintu vayamapi nopadekṣyāma ityāha- taccaivetyādi|
                                taccaiva kāraṇamiti parasparasaṃsarge+api
                                rasānāmanadhikaguṇakarmatvam| lakṣaṇena pṛthaktvaṃ
                                lakṣaṇapṛthaktvam| tatra lakṣyate yena tallakṣaṇam; atastu ‘madhuro
                                rasaḥ’ ityādinā granthena, tathā ‘snehanaprīṇanahlādana’ ityādinā ca
                                yadvācyaṃ, tat sarvaṃ gṛhyate;| kiṃvā, lakṣaṇaśabdena ‘madhuro rasa’
                                ityādigranthavācyaṃ lakṣaṇamucyate, pṛthaktvaṃ ca
                                rasabhedajñānārthaṃ yadvakṣyati ‘snehanaprīṇana’ ityādi
                                tadgṛhyate||9||

ṣaḍeva rasā ityuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ punarvasuḥ,
                                madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyāḥ

ṣaṇṇāṃ
                                rasānāṃ yonirudakaṃ, chedanopaśamane dve karmaṇī, tayormiśrībhāvāt
                                sādhāraṇatvaṃ, svādvasvādutā bhaktiḥ

, hitāhitau prabhāvau, pañcamahābhūtavikārāstvāśrayāḥ
                                prakṛtivikṛtivicāradeśakālavaśāḥ, teṣvāśrayeṣu dravyasañjñakeṣu guṇā
                                gurulaghuśītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyāḥ; kṣaraṇāt kṣāraḥ, nāsau rasaḥ
                                dravyaṃ tadanekarasasamutpannamanekarasaṃ
                                kaṭukalavaṇabhūyiṣṭhamanekendriyārthasamanvitaṃ karaṇābhinirvṛttam;
                                    avyaktībhāvastu

khalu
                                rasānāṃ prakṛtau bhavatyanurase+anurasasamanvite vā dravye;
                                aparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ punasteṣāmāśrayādīnāṃ bhāvānāṃ
                                viśeṣāparisaṅkhyeyatvānna yuktam, ekaiko+api hyeṣāmāśrayādīnāṃ
                                bhāvānāṃ viśeṣānāśrayate viśeṣāparisaṅkhyeyatvāt, na ca
                                tasmādanyatvamupapadyate; parasparasaṃsṛṣṭabhūyiṣṭhatvānna
                                caiṣāmabhinirvṛtterguṇaprakṛtīnāmaparisaṅkhyeyatvaṃ bhavati;
                                tasmānna saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ rasānāṃ karmopadiśanti buddhimantaḥ

taccaiva kāraṇamapekṣamāṇāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ rasānāṃ
                                paraspareṇāsaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇapṛthaktvamupadekṣyāmaḥ

agre tvityādi| raseṣu vācyeṣu
                                dravyabhedamabhipretya pratipādanīyatayā parigṛhya rasānāṃ
                                dravyajñānādhīnajñānatvāddravyābhidhānamagre kṛtamityarthaḥ|
                                kiñciditi āyurvedopayogidravyasvarūpaṃ na sarvam, aprasaṅgadoṣāditi
                                bhāvaḥ| sarvadravyamiti kāryadravyam| asminnarthe asmin prakaraṇe|
                                dravāntā iti vacanena pūrvoktān viṃśatiguṇānāha| atra ca
                                paratvāparatvādīnāmihānabhidhānena cikitsāyāṃ
                                paratvādīnāmaprādhānyaṃ darśayati; ye+api tatrāpi
                                yuktisaṃyogaparimāṇasaṃskārābhyāsā atyarthacikitsopayogino+api na te
                                parthivādidravyāṇāṃ śabdādivat sāṃsiddhikāḥ kintarhyādheyāḥ, ata iha
                                naisargikaguṇakathane noktāḥ| uktamiti apāmārgataṇḍulīye| etacca
                                prādhānyāducyate, tena bṛṃhaṇādyapi boddhavyam||10||

'asminnartha ityasmin prakaraṇe, tena pāñcabhautikatvaṃ
                                    yaddravyāṇāṃ tadāyurvedasiddhāntaḥ, na tu
                                    śāstrāntarasyetyarthaḥ; naiyāyikādibhiḥ
                                    pāñcabhautikatvādyanabhyupagamāt' iti śivadāsasenaḥ;

bahulaśabdo gurvādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate;
                                kiṃvā gandhenaiva, yato gandhaguṇabahulā pṛthivyeva bhavati; ata eva
                                dravyāntaralakṣaṇe+api vaiśeṣikaguṇo+anta eva paṭhyate
                                ‘rasaguṇabahulāni’ ityādi; tena tatrāpi rasādibhireva bahulaśabdo
                                yojyaḥ| sarvakāryadravyāṇāṃ pāñcabhautikatve+api pṛthivyādyutkarṣeṇa
                                pārthivatvādi jñeyam| saṅghātaḥ kāṭhinyaṃ, sthairyam avicālyam|
                                bandhanaṃ parasparayojanaṃ, prahlādaḥ śarīrendriyatarpaṇam| sūkṣmaṃ
                                sūkṣmasroto+anusāri| prabhā varṇaprakāśinī dīptiḥ; yaduktaṃ-
                                “varṇamākrāmati cchāyā prabhā varṇaprakāśikā” (iṃ.a.7) ityādi|
                                vicaraṇaṃ vicāro gatirityarthaḥ| sauṣiryaṃ randhrabahulatā|
                                atrākāśabāhulyaṃ dravyasya pṛthivyādibhūtāntarālpatvena
                                bhūrivyaktākāśatvena ca jñeyaṃ, yadeva bhūriśuṣiraṃ tannābhasaṃ;
                                kiṃvā ākāśaguṇabahulatvena nābhasaṃ dravyamityucyate||11||

aneneti pratiniyatadravyaguṇopadeśena; yat
                                pārthivādi dravyaṃ yadguṇaṃ tadguṇe dehe sampādye tad bheṣajaṃ
                                bhavatītyarthaḥ| tacca pārthivādi dravyaṃ na sarvathā na ca
                                sarvasmin vyādhau bheṣajamityāha- tāṃ tāṃ yuktimityādi|- yuktimiti
                                upāyam, arthamiti prayojanam, abhipretyeti adhikṛtya; tena
                                kenacidupāyena kvacit prayojane kiñciddravyamauṣadhaṃ bhavati na
                                sarvatra| tena yaducyate- vairodhikānāṃ sarvadā+apathyatvena
                                ‘nānauṣadhaṃ dravyam’ iti vaco virodhi; tanna bhavati, vairodhikāni
                                hi saṃyogasaṃskāradeśakālādyapekṣāṇi bhavanti,
                                vairodhikasaṃyogādyabhāve tu pathyānyapi kvacit syuḥ| yānyapi
                                    (sarvadā+api

) svabhāvādeva viṣamandakādīnyapathyāni,
                                tānyapyupāyayuktāni kvacit pathyāni bhavanti; yathā udare- “viṣasya
                                tilaṃ dadyāt” (ci. 13) ityādi| yattu tṛṇapāṃśuprabhṛtīni
                                nopayujyante, ato na tāni bheṣajānītyucyate; tanna, teṣāmapi
                                bheṣajasvedādyupāyatvena bheṣajatvāt||12||

anenopadeśena nānauṣadhibhūtaṃ jagati
                                kiñciddravyamupalabhyate tāṃ tāṃ yuktimarthaṃ ca taṃ
                                tamabhipretya

pārthivādidravyāṇāṃ
                                gurukharādiguṇayogādbheṣajatvamuktaṃ, tena guṇaprabhāvādeva bheṣajaṃ
                                syāditi śaṅkāṃ nirasyannāha- na tu kevalamityādi|
                                dravyaprabhāvādyathā- dantyā virecakatvaṃ, tathā maṇīnāṃ
                                viṣādihantṛtvamityādi| guṇaprabhāvādyathā- jvare tiktako rasaḥ,
                                śīte+agnirityādi| dravyaguṇaprabhāvādyathā- kṛṣṇājinasyoparīti,
                                atrāpi kṛṣṇatvaṃ guṇo+ajinaṃ ca dravyamabhipretaṃ; yathā vā-
                                “maṇḍalairjātarūpasya tasyā eva payaḥ śṛtam” (ci. a. 2. pā. 3);
                                tatra maṇḍalaguṇayuktasyaiva jātarūpasya
                                    kārmukatvam

| kathaṃ
                                kurvantītyāha- tasmiṃstasminnityādi| tāṃ tāṃ yuktimāsādyeti tāṃ tāṃ
                                yojanāṃ prāpya| yat kurvantītyādāvudāharaṇaṃ yathā-
                                śirovirecanadravyāṇi yacchirovirecanaṃ kurvanti, tacchirovirecanaṃ
                                karma; yenoṣṇatvādikāraṇena śirovirecanaṃ kurvanti, tadvīryaṃ,
                                vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, sā ca dravyasya guṇasya vā; yatra śirovirecanaṃ
                                kurvanti tadadhikaraṇaṃ śiraḥ, nānyatrādhikaraṇe śirovirecanadravyaṃ
                                prabhavatītyarthaḥ; yadeti vasantādau śirogauravādiyukte ca kāle,
                                etenākāle śīte śirovirecanaṃ stabdhatvānna kārmukaṃ, kintu svakāla
                                eva; yathā yena prakāreṇa pradhamanāvapīḍanādinā tathā
                                “prasāritāṅgamuttānaṃ śayane saṃstarāstṛte| īṣatpralambaśirasaṃ
                                saṃveśya cāvṛtekṣaṇam” ityādinā vidhinā kurvanti, sa upāyaḥ; yat
                                sādhayanti śirogauravaśūlādyuparamaṃ

, tat phalaṃ; phalam
                                uddeśyam| karma kāryaṃ sādhanam, uddeśyaṃ phalaṃ sādhyaṃ; yathā-
                                yāganiṣpādyo dharmaḥ kāryatayā karma, tajjanyastu svargādiruddeśyaḥ
                                phalam; evaṃ vamanādiṣvapi karmādhikaraṇādyunneyam||13||

na tu kevalaṃ guṇaprabhāvādeva dravyāṇi kārmukāṇi
                                bhavanti; dravyāṇi hi
