                                vākyārthaḥ| savarṇā yathāsvadaṃṣṭrāsamānavarṇāḥ| bahūttaraviṣā iti
                                uttarottaraṃ bahuviṣāḥ| bhṛśā iti duḥkhasādhyāḥ| duḥkhasādhyatvamapi
                                yathottaraṃ jñeyam| nanu, pūrvaṃ darvīkarādīnāṃ daṃśasya varṇabheda
                                uktaḥ, idānīṃ tu daṃṣṭrābhedena varṇabheda ucyate, tena sarvatraiva
                                darvīkarādau sarvavarṇopapattiḥ, tataśca pūrvoktadaṃśavarṇavirodhaḥ;
                                uktaṃ cātraivārthe āṣāḍhavarmaṇā yat- “darvīkaramaṇḍalinorasitaḥ
                                pītaśca varṇato daṃśaḥ” iti lakṣaṇena,
                                    yasmādanekavarṇāstu

daṃśāḥ” (?)| atrocyate- daṃṣṭrānukārivarṇatā
                                daṃśamātrasthite viṣe bhavati, darvīkakarādyullekhavihitastu yo
                                varṇo doṣakṛtaḥ sa pravisṛte viṣe bhavatīti avasthābhedānna
                                virodhaḥ| uktaṃ ca parihāravārtike “daṃśe tvete varṇāḥ, sāvarṇyaṃ
                                doṣaje visṛte” iti||137-139||

- sarpāṇāmityādi| viṇmūtrāditi
                                kīṭaśabdaniruktyarthamanayorupādānaṃ, tenānyānyapi

                                vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭāstu vi(tri)vidhāḥ smṛtāḥ” (su.ka.a.8)
                                iti| kīṭāśca yadyapi suśrute vātapittakaphasannipātakopanāḥ
                                kumbhīnasādayaḥ saptaṣaṣṭiḥ pratipāditāḥ, tathā+apīha
                                sañjñeyābhidhitsayā dūṣīviṣaprāṇaharabhedenaivocyante; evaṃ
                                lūtādiṣvapi sañjñeyabhedāddvaividhyoktirjñeyā| dūṣīviṣāḥ
                                cirakāriviṣāḥ, prāṇaharāḥ jhaṭiti prāṇaharaviṣāḥ| saha
                                ugragandhyasṛjā vartata iti sogragandhyasṛk sogragandhi
                                lohitam||140-143||

gātraṃ raktaṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā
                                piḍakānvitam

muktā mauktikam| kṣīraśuklā vidārī|

chatrītyādau chatrī divā, rātrau
                                jharjharapāṇiścarediti vadanti; anye tūbhayatrāpyubhayaṃ bruvate|
                                jharjharakaḥ ‘khurkhuraka’ iti khyātaḥ| chāyāśabdau yathāsaṅkhyaṃ
                                chatrajharjharayoḥ| tābhyāṃ tadātve vitrastāḥ| daṃśakāle
                                kartavyamāha- daṣṭamātra ityādi| dhāraṇādeva viṣāpahamāha-
                                vajramityādi| sāra iti sarajūviśeṣaṇam(?)| picuko maṇiruttarāpathe
                                prasiddhaḥ| viṣamūṣikā viṣamaṇiḥ| karketanamaṇiḥ padmarāgaḥ|
                                garamaṇiśabdena nānāmaṇīnāṃ grahaṇam| varauṣadhya iti
                                tantrāntaroktāḥ akṣīvajātapippalājaruhākāyoṣī (?) prabhṛtayaḥ; uktaṃ
                                ca- “akṣīvajātasya pippalasya maṇiḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ”
                                ityādi||250-253||

tatra ślokaḥ- itīdamuktaṃ dvividhasya
                                vistarairbahuprakāraṃ viṣarogabheṣajam

adhītya vijñāya tathā prayojayan vrajedviṣāṇāmaviṣahyatāṃ
                                budhaḥ

itīdamityādisaṅgrahaḥ|
                                vrajedviṣāṇāmaviṣahyatāmiti viṣāṇi taṃ soḍhuṃ na pārayantīti
                                bhāvaḥ||254||

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ
                                nāma trayoviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||23||

mohajanakatvasāmānyāt tathā
                                viṣasamānaguṇajanyatvācca viṣacikitsitamanu madātyayasya
                                cikitsitamucyate||1-2||

surairityādinā madirāstutyā tathā
                                vakṣyamāṇanindayā vidhinā pīyamānasurāyāḥ
                                śubhaphalamavidhipānāccātyarthaninditaphalavattvaṃ darśayati| yā
                                purā paripūjitetyanena prathamaṃ devaireveyaṃ paripūjitā, tataḥ
                                surayogāt sureti copadiṣṭeti darśayati| sautrāmaṇiḥ
                                surāhaviryajñāntarniviṣṭo yajñaviśeṣaḥ; tasyāṃ hūyate surā|
                                karmibhiryā pratiṣṭhiteti yājñikairabhiṣavaṇādibhiḥ pratiṣṭhitā
                                pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpitā| yajñaṃ vahatīti yajñauhī; anena ca
                                laukikayajñāntarāṇyapi surayā kriyanta ityucyate; sautrāmaṇihome tu
                                tasyā eva pradhānāṅgatocyate| śakraśca somātipatita iti
                                ‘śakro+atipītena somena kṣapitabalo nirojasko nirvīryībhūtaḥ sa kila
                                punarāpyāyya nijaṃ vīryamāpāditaḥ’ ityeṣā śrutiḥ; atipānena patitaḥ
                                    atipatitaḥ

|
                                prakalpyā iti abhiṣotavyā sandhānāyeti yāvat| yajñīyā yajñasiddhaya
                                iti yajñavidhau kānicit kratvarthāni yūpabarhyādīni, kānicittu
                                puruṣārthāni vāsagarbhādīni, kānicid yajñārthāni puruṣārthāni ca
                                yathā sarpiriṣṭakādīni, tadiha surā ‘yajñīyā’ ityanena vāsanādivat
                                ‘puruṣārthā’ ityucyate, yajñasiddhaye bhavatītyanena yūpādivad
                                yajñārthatvaṃ surāyā ucyate||3-5||
yajñauhī yā yayā śakraḥ somātipatito bhṛśam
dṛśyā spṛśyā prakalpyā ca yajñīyā yajñasiddhaye

yonītyādau viśeṣaśabdaḥ
                                pratyekamabhisambadhyate| yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ, tadviśeṣāḥ-
                                dhānyaphalamūlasārapuṣpapatrakāṇḍatvacaḥ śarkarānavamāḥ
                                sūtrasthānoktāḥ| saṃskāro+api bahuprakārasaṃskārayogaḥ| nāmaviśeṣāḥ
                                surāmadhumaireyādayaḥ| ādigrahaṇāt prabhāvaguṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| mado
                                lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasmānmadalakṣaṇāt sāmānyāt madyasvarūpāt||6||

somo bhūtvā dvijātīn yā yuṅkte śreyobhiruttamaiḥ

amṛtaṃ bhūtvetyādau surādhiṣṭhātrī devatā
                                amṛtādirūpeṇa devādīn tarpayatīti darśayati| śreyobhiriti
                                mahatkalyāṇaiḥ||7||

āśvinaṃ yā mahatteja ityādāvapi
                                surādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāyā eva tejovīryādikāraṇatvāttādrūpyaṃ jñeyam|
                                tejaḥ sarvadevatādigaṃ, tathā sārasvataṃ balaṃ mantrabalam| somaḥ
                                sautrāmaṇau ca yetyanena somarūpatocyate, pūrvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ hūyata
                                ityuktamiti na paunaruktyam| yā prītirityādau prītyādikāraṇatvena
                                prītyādirūpatayā nirdeśo jñeyaḥ||8-10||
āśvinaṃ yā mahattejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā
vīryamaindraṃ ca yā siddhā somaḥ sautrāmaṇau ca yā
yā prītiryā ratiryā vāgyā puṣṭiryā ca nirvṛtiḥ
ratiḥ suretyabhihitā tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet

vidhinā pibedityatroktavidhimāha- śarīretyādi|
                                śarīre snānavasrādibhirbāhya ābhyantaraśca prakṛtyādyapekṣayā
                                snigdhoṣṇānnādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ saṃskāro yena sa śarīrakṛtasaṃskāraḥ|
                                śuciriti manaḥśuciḥ| yathartūddāmagandhibhiriti ṛtvavasthānuguṇatayā
                                vihitaiḥ| yathartuke sarvartusukhe| kusumaprakarīkṛte visṛjatkusume|
                                sarasāḥ priyāḥ, tāsāṃ sammate| svaśarīrasukhe sthita iti
                                yathāśarīrasukhaṃ sthitaḥ| sukṛtairiti saṃskṛtaiḥ| śikṣitābhiriti
                                abhyastopacārābhiḥ| gandhapiśunairiti gandhāḍhyaiḥ| ambaracāriṇaḥ
                                śyenādayaḥ| paurogavargā iti sūdaśāstrābhijñāḥ| arthibhya iti
                                arthino baladeva-caṇḍī-yakṣādayaḥ, tebhyaḥ||11-20||

sāmānyaṃ vidhimuktvā vātikādīnāṃ pānavidhimāha-
                                abhyaṅgetyādi| māricakairiti maricasaṃskṛtaiḥ| vasumatāmiti
                                dhanavatām| bhaviṣyadvibhavā utpadyamānadhanāḥ| yathopapatti
                                yathāparicchadopapatti| kaphapittādhikebhya ityādau
                                viparyayatantrayuktyā kaphādhikebhyo mādhavaṃ, pittādhikebhyastu
                                mārdvīkaṃ; mārdvīkaṃ mṛdvīkākṛtaṃ, madhukṛtaṃ tu mādhavam||21-25||
prahṛṣṭo yaḥ pibenmadyaṃ tasya syādamṛtaṃ yathā

bahudravyamiti nānāvidhadravyasampāditam|
                                bahuguṇamiti bhūrivakṣyamāṇalaghvādiguṇam| bahukarmeti
                                lekhanadīpanādibahukarmakaram| madātmakamiti madasvabhāvam|
                                yasmādevaṃ svabhāvaṃ tasmādguṇadoṣe ca taṃ madyamapekṣete; kiñcit
                                puruṣamapekṣya yaugikatvādguṇakaraṃ, kiñcittvayaugikatvāddoṣakaraṃ;
                                yathā- prathame made guṇakaraṃ, doṣakaraṃ ca dvitīyamade iti bhāvaḥ|
                                vidhineti yathoktavidhinā| kāle iti yasya madyasya ya ucito
                                viparītaguṇaḥ kālastasmin| hitairannairiti madyahitairannaiḥ|
                                yathopetamiti yadeva madyamahitamapyupagatam| prasaṅgāditi
                                atiyogena| viṣavaditi mohādikartṛtvāt||26-28||

madyaṃ yathā madayati tathā prāha- madyamityādi|
                                daśabhiriti laghvādibhirguṇaiḥ, daśāpi gurvādīnojoguṇān saṅkṣobhya,
                                na dvitrādikaiḥ, ceto vikriyāṃ nayati vikṛtaṃ karoti| yena guṇena
                                madyasya ojoguṇakṣobho bhavati tadāha- gurutvaṃ lāghavādityādi|
                                prasādaṃ cāśubhāvanāditi prasādākhyaguṇamāśugatvāddhanti; āśugatvaṃ
                                ca yadyapi prasādaviruddhaṃ na bhavati, tathā+api madyameva
                                pratikūlatayā ojaḥprasādaṃ

hanti, tatrāśuguṇa āhanane vyāpriyata iti jñeyam| vyavāyitvāt
                                sthiratvamiti vyavāyitvaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ, tacca sthiratvaṃ
                                tadviparītatvādeva hanti; āśugatvavyavāyitvayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ-
                                yadāśugaṃ śīghraṃ gacchati, vyavāyi tu sarvavyāpakam| vikāsitvaṃ
                                vikasanaśīlatvaṃ saratvamiti yāvat; tacca ślakṣṇaviparītatvādeva
                                ślakṣṇatāṃ hanti| sāndratā ghanatā| ete vikāsitvāśugatvādayo guṇā
                                yadyapi viṃśatiguṇagaṇanāyāṃ na
                                paṭhitāstathā+apyasaṅkhyeyatvādguṇānāmeṣāmapi guṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ; ye
                                tu tatra paṭhitāste tāvadāviṣkṛtatamā jñeyāḥ|
                                āśrayopaghātādāśritopaghāto bhavatīti darśayannāha- sattvamityādi|
                                sattvasya ca oja āśrayaḥ, oja upakāryam; yathā- rājāśritaḥ puruṣaḥ|
                                rasavātetyādi| rasavātādivahānāṃ daśadhamanīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ,
                                rasavahā eva yā daśa dhamanyo hṛdayāśrayā uktāstā eva vātādivahāḥ|
                                yaduktaṃ “vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ sarvaśarīracarāṇāṃ sarvāṇi
                                srotāṃsyayanabhūtāni” (vi.a.5) iti; raktādīnāṃ tu
                                sarvaśarīracarāṇāmapi viśeṣeṇa hṛdayaṃ sthānamuktaṃ- “ṣaḍaṅgamaṅgaṃ
                                vijñānamindriyāṇyarthapañcakam| ātmā ca saguṇaścetaścintyaṃ ca hṛdi
                                saṃśritam” (sū.a.30) iti| dhātava iti
                                sattvabuddhīndriyādayaḥ||29-36||
rūkṣaṃ vikāśi viśadaṃ madyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam

guru śītaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ bahalaṃ madhuraṃ
                                sthiram
hṛdayaṃ yāti vikṛtiṃ tatrasthā ye ca dhātavaḥ
madhyamo vihate+alpe ca vihate tūttamo madaḥ

madyaṃ ceto vikriyāṃ nayatītyutsargavidheḥ
                                prathamamade+apavādamāha- ojasyavihate ityādi| hṛdayāśritabuddhyādau
                                pratibodhite, hṛdayaśabdeneha tatsthopacārāddhṛdayāśritā
                                buddhyādayo+abhidhīyante, yathā- mañcāḥ krośantīti;
                                buddhyādibodhanaṃ prathamamadakāryaṃ madyasya prabhāvāt|
                                madhyamottamamadopapattisāmagrīmāha- madhyama ityādi| vihate iti
                                vighāte; ojasaḥ alpe vighāte madhyamo mado bhavati| vihate iti
                                viśeṣeṇa atyarthaṃ hate, uttama iti tṛtīyaḥ||37-38||

hṛdītyādinā sāmānyena madalakṣaṇamāha| tarṣaḥ
                                abhilāṣaḥ| yathāsattvamiti prakṛtyā rājase sattve rājasāḥ, tāmase ca
                                tāmasāḥ| citrā iti nānāprakārāḥ| mohanidrāntā iti
                                mohanidrāvasānāḥ||39-40||

prathamādimadānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- praharṣaṇa
                                ityādi| pānānnaguṇadarśaka iti pānānnaguṇān samyagbodhayatītyarthaḥ|
                                viṣayeṣviti viṣayasevāsu, na cākṣama iti nākṣamatākara ityarthaḥ|
                                yuktāyuktapralāpa iti sambaddhāsambaddhavacanaḥ| pracalāyanaṃ
                                ghūrṇanam| yojanā saviparyayeti sthānādīnāṃ samyagyojanā
                                kadācidbhavati, kadācicca sthānādiyojanāviparyayo+asamyagyojanārūpo
                                bhavatītyarthaḥ| madhyamaṃ madamutkramyetyādi| yadyapi trividho mada
                                uktaḥ, tathā+api dvitīyamadāvasāne tṛtīyamadāprāptyavasthāyā eva
                                atyarthanindyatāṃ darśayan tṛtīyamadasyātyantanindyatāṃ darśayati;
                                yena tasya tṛtīyamadasya pūrvarūpāvasthaiva
                                sarvāśubhakaraṇādihetutayā nitāntaṃ nindyeti bhāvaḥ| iyaṃ ca
                                madhyamadātikramatṛtīyamadāprāptiśabdābhidheyā+apyavasthā
                                madhyamamadāntatṛtīyamadādyarūpāvasthābhidhāyikaiva; yathā-
                                “kumbhamīnayormadhye yadā carati candramā” ityatra madhyepadena
                                kumbhāntamīnādirevocyate, paramārthatastayormadhyasyābhāvāt;
                                    tathehāpi

paramārthato+anyamadakālābhāvād
                                dvitīyāntatṛtīyamadādyabhidhānamevātra tṛtīyamadātyarthanindārthaṃ,
                                na caturthamadopadarśanam| asvantamiti aśobhanāntam| bhagnadārviveti
                                bhagnavṛkṣa iva patitastiṣṭhati| udarkam uttarakālam| sa duḥkhaṃ
                                vyādhimiti madātyayam||41-51||
na ca buddhismṛtiharo viṣayeṣu na cākṣamaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ tu madaṃ prāpya bhagnadārviva niṣkriyaḥ
ramaṇīyān sa viṣayānna vetti na suhṛjjanam
yadarthaṃ pīyate madyaṃ ratiṃ tāṃ ca na vindati
kāryākāryaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ loke yacca hitāhitam
yadavastho na jānāti ko+avasthāṃ tāṃ vrajedbudhaḥ
sa dūṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nindyaścāgrāhya eva ca

pretya ceha ca yacchreyaḥ śreyo mokṣe ca yat
                                param

madye moho bhayaṃ śokaḥ krodho mṛtyuśca
                                saṃśritaḥ

kintu madyaṃ svabhāvena yathaivānnaṃ tathā
                                smṛtam

pretya cehetyādinā ekīyamataṃ madyanindakaṃ
                                darśayati| pretyeti janmāntare| taṭasthasyeti vacanena
                                vātākṣobhyatāṃ darśayati| satyamityādinā svamatamāha| ete doṣāḥ
                                madyasyaikīyamatoktā ahitādidharmayuktasyaiva bhavanti, na
                                hitālpamātravidhipītasyeti bhāvaḥ| vidhivarjitamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam|
                                madyasyānnasārūpyadarśanena vidhivadupayoge guṇavattāmavidhyupayoge
                                ca doṣavattāmāha- kintvityādi| yuktyā deśakālamātrādyapekṣayā
                                yojanayā yuktaṃ śubham, aśubhaṃ cāyuktiyuktam|
                                yukteranvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kāryamāha- prāṇā ityādi| prāṇahetutvāt
                                prāṇāḥ| ayuktiyuktamiti avidhiprayuktam| yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanamiti
                                yathā “viṣasya tu tilaṃ dadyāt” (ci.a.1) ityādiprayoge tilamānasya
                                rasāyanatvaṃ, tathā jñeyam||52-60||

vidhipītamadyaguṇānāha- harṣamityādi| harṣam
                                utsāhaṃ kāyikam| mudamiti manaḥsantoṣam| pauruṣamiti śukram| āśviti
                                vacanena śīghraṃ harṣādīni karoti na pariṇāmaṃ yāvadapekṣate|
                                sukhamadapradamiti sukhapradamadaṃ, prathamaṃ madamiti yāvat| anye
                                tu ‘madasukhapradam’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi madasukhaṃ
                                prathamamadārambha eva||61||

rocanamityādinā madyaguṇānāha| svāpanaṃ
                                naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ tathā bodhanaṃ cātinidrāṇāmiti
                                kāryadvayakaraṇamucitanidrākaratvaprabhāvādeva; kiṃvā naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ
                                nidrābhighātahetvaticintanādivismārakatayā nidrākaraṃ bhavati,
                                atinidrāṇāṃ nidrāhetumanovahasrotorodhādihantṛtayā prabodhakaṃ
                                bhavatīti jñeyam| madyotthānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ madyameva prabādhakamiti
                                hetuviparītārthakāritāprabhāvādityarthaḥ| ratiriti
                                ratikārakamityarthaḥ| viṣayasaṃyoge prītisaṃyogavardhanamiti
                                viṣayāṇāṃ śabdādīnāṃ saṃyoge prītiṃ saṃyogaṃ ca vardhayati;
                                pītamadyo yadā viṣayaiḥ śabdādibhiḥ saṃyujyate tadā teṣvapi prītimān
                                bhavati, prītaśca sukhākāṅkṣī san punasteṣu saṃyujyate|
                                pravayasāmiti vṛddhānām| utsavaḥ autsukyaṃ viṣayābhilāṣa iti yāvat,
                                āmodo harṣaḥ| nanu viṣaye svabhāvādeva prītirbhavati, tat kiṃ
                                madyena kriyate? ityāśaṅkya prathamamadasya viśiṣṭaratikartṛtvamāha-
                                pañcasvityādi| ratiśceha atyarthasukhajanakatvādevopādeyeti
                                vijñeyam| viśrāma iti duḥkhārtaviśrāmahetuḥ| jīvaloka iti
                                    jīvamānalokaḥ
pañcasvartheṣu kānteṣu yā ratiḥ prathame made
yūnāṃ vā sthavirāṇāṃ vā tasya nāstyupamā bhuvi

yuktyā niṣevitamityatroktāṃ madyapānayuktimāha-
                                annapānetyādi| tatrānnaṃ trividhaṃ vātapittakaphakaram, evaṃ
                                pānamapi trividhaṃ, bālyādibhedādvayo+api trividhaṃ, vyādhirapi
                                mṛdumadhyatīvrabhedena trividhaḥ, kiṃvā saumyāgneyavāyavyabhedena
                                trividhaḥ, balaṃ pravarāvaramadhyabhedāttrividhaṃ, kālastu
                                śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇastrividhaḥ, trividhaṃ sattvaṃ śuddhaṃ rājasaṃ
                                tāmasaṃ ca| yojaneti samyagyojanārūpā| yuktiṃ phalenāvadhārayati-
                                yayā yuktyetyādinā| sattvaguṇocchrito madyaguṇān samaśnute iti
                                yojyam| tatrānnāpekṣayā yuktiryathā- vātakaramannamupayujya
                                vātaharaṃ madyaṃ peyam, evaṃ pittakarakaphakaratve+api
                                pittakaphaharānnopayogaḥ| evaṃ pānādyapekṣayā+api yojanā vyākhyātā
                                bhavati| vayastrike+api bālye sthavire ca tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ na peyaṃ,
                                yauvane tu tīkṣṇamapīti| vyādhyapekṣayā+api yojanā yathā-
                                mṛduvyādhau tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ, uṣṇe ca śītamadhuraṃ, varṣākāle tu snigdhaṃ
                                dīpanaṃ ca madyam| doṣabhedena tu madyaṃ vāte snigdhoṣṇaṃ gauḍikādi,
                                pitte śītamadhuraṃ śārkarādi, kaphe rūkṣatīkṣṇaṃ mādhavādi| uktaṃ
                                hi- “vātikebhyo hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyo gauḍikapaiṣṭikam|
                                kaphapittādhikebhyastu phālamādhavaśārkaram” iti| doṣagrahaṇenaiva
                                vātalādiprakṛtirapi gṛhītā| sattvabhedenāpi sāttvikena tu bahvapi
                                madyaṃ pātavyaṃ, rājasatāmasaistu svalpameva| sattvānīti manāṃsi|
                                avyaktatām īṣadvyaktatāṃ, madhye cāvyaktatāṃ yāntītyarthaḥ, uttame
                                tu sarvathā+apyavyaktaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kecittu ‘sasyasambodhakaṃ
                                varṣaṃ’ ityādi ślokaṃ paṭhanti| tatra hemaprakṛtidarśako hutāśo
                                yathā suvarṇasya śuddhāśuddhatāṃ darśayati, tathā madyaṃ
                                tūbhayakārakamiti manaḥprabodhakaṃ manoguṇadarśakaṃ ca| rūpāṇāmiti
                                hemarūpāṇāṃ; kiṃvā ‘rukmāṇāṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ| vyaktidarśaka iti
                                ākāradarśakaḥ||68-73||
madyasya ca guṇān sarvān yathoktān sa samaśnute
sattvāni tu prabudhyante prāyaśaḥ prathame made

sāttvikādibhedena pānaṃ trividhamāha-
                                sugandhītyādi| śobhano gandho yasya tat sugandhi, gandharvaḥ gānam|
                                śobhano+anto yasya tat svantam| sumadamiti samamadam| na
                                cottamamadapradamiti nottamamadakaraṃ, kadācidapi
                                madyapānāttṛtīyamadāśaṅkā na bhavati; uttamamadaḥ sāttvike na
                                bhavatītyarthaḥ| uttamamadāprāptau hetumāha- vaiguṇyamityādi|
                                sattvasaṃyogāditi sattvākhyaguṇayogāt; sattvākhyo hi guṇaḥ
                                prakāśakatayā na madena mohakenābhibhūyata iti bhāvaḥ| etadevāha-
                                sahasetyādi| rājasapānamāha- saumyāsaumyetyādi| saumyakathā
                                saumyasambandhā, tadviparītā asaumyā| viśadāviśadamiti
                                prasannāprasannam| citramiti
                                sambaddhāsambaddhavākyādiyogānnānāprakārakam| tathetyādinā
                                tāmasamāha| sammohaḥ krodho nidrā ca ante yasya tat
                                sammohakrodhanidrāntam||74-78||
madyaṃ hi balavatsattvaṃ gṛhṇāti sahasā na tu

yairityanena rājasatāmasāḥ pratyavamṛśyante,
                                taiḥ samaṃ piban tatprasaktyā svayamapyatipiban madyadoṣān
                                dvitīyatṛtīyamadadoṣān prāpnoti||79||

upādeyān sāttvikānāha- sukhaśīlā ityādi| sumukhā
                                iti priyākārāḥ| viśadā iti avāmāḥ| āpānaṃ vardhayantīti āpāne
                                prasādaṃ vardhayanti na pānaprasaktiṃ vardhayantītyarthaḥ, tasyā
                                ninditatvāt| manoramairityatra ‘sādhīyāṃsaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| sukṛtibhiḥ
                                samā iti evambhūtapānasya sukṛtilabhyatvāt| sthirasattvetyādau
                                pūrvānnā iti madyapānāt pūrvamupayuktānnāḥ| madyapānvayā iti
                                madyapavaṃśajāḥ, teṣāṃ madyapānaṃ madyasātmyatvādeva na vikārakaraṃ
                                bhavati, viṣakanyāyā viṣamiva||80-87||
te sahāyāḥ sukhāḥ pāne taiḥ pibansaha modate
pibanti susahāyā ye te vai sukṛtibhiḥ samāḥ
bahumadyocitā ye ca mādyanti sahasā na te
svalpenāpi madaṃ śīghraṃ yānti madyena mānavāḥ

madyapānadoṣaguṇānabhidhāya madātyayān
                                hetvādibhirāha- ūrdhvamityādi| sambhavamiti kāraṇam|
                                vātaprāyamityādau prāyaḥśabdenādhikavācinā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ
                                sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajanyatvaṃ darśayati| sa tu vātetyādau sa
                                tviti paittikaḥ; vātolbaṇasya paitto madātyayo
                                vātapittasaṃyogakṛtatayā bāhya ivāgnirvāyuyuktaḥ śīghrakārī bhavati|
                                tatreyaṃ vyavasthā- yatra sadyaḥphalā kriyā tatra śīghrameva
                                śāmyati, akriyāyāṃ ca śīghraṃ hanti, śaṅkhakarohiṇyādivat||88-97||
rūkṣaṃ pariṇataṃ madyaṃ niśi nidrāṃ vihatya ca

‘lakṣaṇāni bhavantyasya yāni tāni nibodha me’ iti
                                    pā.;
tu vātolbaṇasyāśu praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā

madyasya tridoṣakaratve hetumāha- viṣasyetyādi|
                                yadyapi madyamamlaṃ, viṣaṃ tvavyaktamadhuraṃ, tathā+api
                                bahuguṇasāmānyāt ta eva madye dṛśyanta ityuktam| tathaivāntyo mada
                                iti prāṇaharo rogakaraścetyarthaḥ| pṛthaktvamiti vātikatvādinā
                                pārthakyam||98-100||
ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ
hantyāśu hi viṣaṃ kiñcit kiñcidrogāya kalpate
yathā viṣaṃ tathaivāntyo jñeyo madyakṛto madaḥ

śarīraduḥkhamityādinā sarvamadātyayasya sāmānyaṃ
                                lakṣaṇaṃ brūte, kiṃvā tridoṣamadātyayasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ; yato
                                rogasaṅgrahe vātapittakaphasannipātaiścatvāro madā uktāḥ| “yaśca
                                madyamadaḥ prokto viṣajo raudhiraśca yaḥ| sarva ete madā narte
                                vātapittakaphatrayāt” (sū.a.24) ityanena madasya vātādijatvena
                                cāturvidhyamuktam| tena madātyayasya cāturvidhyaṃ madacāturvidhyāt;
                                yato mada eva ātyayiko madātyaya iti nirucyate| vidyuttulyeti
                                vidyudvatkṣaṇasthāyinī| sphuraṇaṃ kiñcitkampanaṃ, vepanamekadeśe
                                vyaktakampanam||101-106||

utkleśaviśeṣeṇa cikitsāmāha- sarvamityādi|
                                samasarvadoṣe cikitsāmāha- kaphasthānetyādi| kaphasthānānupūrvyā
                                cātra cikitsā kaphasthānodbhūtatayā prathamaṃ kaphasambandhāt
                                sannipātajvara iva jñeyā| ādau kaphaprabalatāmevāha-
                                pittamārutaparyanta iti; anena cārthāt kaphāditvaṃ lambhayati|
                                samapītena tenaiveti yajjātīyena madyena madātyayo janitaḥ nitarāṃ
                                tajjātīyenaiva śāmyati| yathā viṣaṃ maulaṃ daṃṣṭrīyeṇa śāmyati,
                                tathā madyamapi vijātīyena madyena śāmyatītyeke; kintu
                                tenaivetyanena tāmeva madyajātiṃ pratyavamṛśati, tenāvaśyaṃ
                                tajjātīyameva madyaṃ jñeyam| yato+anantaraṃ vakṣyati- ‘yacca yasmai
                                hitaṃ bhavet’ iti| tathā ‘dadyāt salavaṇaṃ madyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ
                                vātaśāntaye’ ityanena yena kenacinmadyenodbhūte vātamadātyaye
                                paiṣṭikamuktaṃ, tathā ‘saśarkaraṃ śārkaraṃ vā’ ityādi viśeṣavidhānaṃ
                                bahu kariṣyati; tena tajjātīyamanyajātīyaṃ ca madyaṃ madātyaye
                                deyam||107-111||

sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣamadhikaṃ tu
                                yam

antardāhaṃ jvaraṃ tṛṣṇāṃ pramohaṃ vibhramaṃ
                                madam
śreṣṭhamamleṣu madyaṃ ca yairguṇaistān paraṃ śṛṇu
madhuraśca kaṣāyaśca tiktaḥ kaṭuka eva ca

annarasotkleda ityatra ‘amlarasakledaḥ’ iti
                                kecit paṭhanti| kṣāramādhuryāya yadā+amlamadyadānaṃ, tadā kimiti
                                anyadamlaṃ na dīyate ityāha- kṣāro hītyādi| uparyuparīti
                                upariṣṭādapyupari atyarthaṃ śreṣṭhamityarthaḥ||112-116||

; kecittu ‘jvarādayaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra
                                jvarapradhānāstarṣādaya ityartha unneyaḥ| avadaṃśo yamupayujya
                                madyaṃ pīyate| dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ| veśavāraḥ khāniṣkaḥ, sa
                                coktalakṣaṇo+asakṛt| pūpavartiḥ vartyākārā pūpalikā| rasapralepīti
                                rasapralepanarūpatayā nirvṛttaṃ ‘rasapraleha’ iti yāvat|
                                agurupaṅkairiti agurulepaiḥ| ghanairiti bahalaiḥ|
                                saṃrodhoṣṇasukhāvahairiti saṃrodhajanitoṣmaṇā
                                sukhakārakaiḥ||117-135||
dāḍimasya rasaṃ vā+api jalaṃ vā pāñcamūlikam

bhavyetyādinā paittike vidhimāha| bhavyam
                                auttarāpathikam, anye karmaraṅgamāhuḥ| mārdvīkamiti
                                mṛdvīkārasakṛtam| satīnaḥ vartulakalāyaḥ| rogādvimucyata iti
                                prakṛtapittamadātyayādvimucyata ityarthaḥ| kramamiti
                                vamanānantaroktamannasaṃsarjanakramam| doṣaśeṣaḥ koṣṭhopalapako+atra
                                jñeyaḥ| guḍūcītyādau rasamiti kvātham| tittiriḥ pratibhojanaṃ
                                paścājjīrṇe bhojanaṃ yasmin rase taṃ tittiripratibhojanam| anutarṣaṃ
                                ca pāyayediti bhojanasamaye tṛṣāṃ lakṣīkṛtya pāyayet; anupānaṃ
                                dāpayediti yāvat| etadanupānasya mātrāmāha- anutarṣasyetyādi|
                                anutarṣasyeti muhurmuhurdīyamānānupānasya| yayā+asya mano na dūṣyata
                                iti na vikṛtiṃ yāti; etena tṛṣāyāṃ manodainyamātrahantṛ yanmadyaṃ
                                bhavati tadanutarṣasañjñaṃ bhavati, natu madaparyantaṃ madyaṃ
                                deyamityarthaḥ| tṛṣṇāghnamiti śītakaṣāyarūpaṃ rasam| cukrīkā
                                cāṅgerī| badarītyādau badaryādipatrāṇi mathitvā tajjaḥ pheno
                                grāhyaḥ| ariṣṭakaḥ nimbaḥ||136-163||-
madyaṃ drākṣārasaṃ toyaṃ dattvā tarpaṇameva vā
anutarṣasya mātrā sā yayā no dūṣyate
tṛṣṇā yenopaśāmyeta madaṃ yena ca nāpnuyāt
toyadānāṃ ca śabdā hi śamayanti madātyayam

ullekhanetyādinā kaphamadātyayacikitsitam|
                                tṛṣyate salilamityādau ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā jalasādhanaṃ sādhviti|
                                madhuprakṛtikaṃ mādhavam| vyoṣapradhāno yūṣo vyoṣayūṣaḥ|
                                nīrasavartitamiti anatidravavartitaṃ śuṣkākhyaṃ vyañjanamityarthaḥ|
                                vṛṇuyāditi vyāpnuyāt| ārdrakapeśikā ārdrakadīrghakhaṇḍāni;
                                ‘prabhūtārdrakapeṣitam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ| sauvarcalamityādau
                                tvagelāmaricādīnāṃ pratyekameva bhāgārdhatvam| śarkarābhāgaḥ
                                pūrvaikadravyabhāgaḥ| kaṭukairyuktāmiti kiñcidūṣaṇām| śvetāmiti
                                mṛdvīkāṃ, śvetā ca drākṣā kāśmīrabhavā jñeyā| kāravīmiti
                                svalpadrākṣām| āmrāmalakayoḥ peśītyanena phalagataṃ sasyaṃ gṛhyate|
                                saṅkocoṣṇasukhāṅgīnāṃ saṅkocena saṃśleṣeṇa uṣṇasukhamaṅgaṃ yāsāṃ
                                tāsāṃ; kecittu saṅkocaṃ kuṅkumamāhuḥ||164-188||
śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇamariṣṭaṃ sīdhumeva vā

‘rūkṣaṃ tarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ
                                    yavānnaṃ vā pradāpayet’ iti pā.;

sthālyāṃ vā+atha kapāle vā bhṛṣṭaṃ
                                    nirdravavartitam
tairannaṃ rocate digdhaṃ samyagbhuktaṃ ca jīryati

yadidamityādinā sānnipātikamadātyayacikitsāmāha|
                                yadyapi trayodaśavidhaḥ sannipāto vṛddhadoṣāṇāmuktastathā+api
                                sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajatvād
                                yadetadvātādimadātyayacikitsitamuktaṃ
                                tadekadoṣolbaṇasannipātajamadātyayacikitsitaṃ bhavati, tena
                                dvyulbaṇahīnamadhyādhikabhedasamasannipātairye daśāvaśiṣṭāḥ
                                sannipātāstānabhipretyedamuktaṃ- sannipāte daśavidhe
                                tadvikalpyamiti; hīnamadhyādhikadoṣatrayodbhūtamadātyayeṣu
                                hīnamadhyādhikadoṣabhedena vikalpya cikitsā kartavyā; samasannipāte
                                tu trayāṇāmapi militvā cikitsā kartavyā||189-190||
nākṣobhya hi mano madyaṃ śarīramavihatya ca

ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhiḥ śamaṃ yāti
                                madātyayaḥ

madātyayasya praharṣajanikā kriyā kartavyetyāha-
                                vanānītyādi| kasmāt punarmadātyaye praharṣiṇī cikitsā kāryetyāha-
                                nākṣobhyetyādi| manaḥprītyā śarīrapraśamārthaṃ praharṣaṇī kriyā
                                kartavyeti bhāvaḥ| uktakṣīraprayogasya viṣayaṃ guṇaṃ cāha-
                                laṅghanairityādi| tatra kāryakṣīravṛttikramaṃ punarmadyābhyāsakramaṃ
                                cāha- payasā+abhihṛte ityādi| krameṇeti kālakrameṇa| alpālpamiti
                                stokaṃ stokam||191-198||

etadviparyayeṇa madyasevāyāṃ doṣamāha-
                                vicchinnetyādi| dhvaṃsakavikṣayau vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇau|
                                dhvaṃsakavikṣayau cemau suśrutenāpyuktau| kecittu “vicchinnamadyaḥ
                                sahasā yo+atimadyaṃ niṣevate| tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ
                                sambhavanti hi” iti granthena dhvaṃsakavikṣayāvarodhaṃ varṇayanti|
                                etayościkitsāmāha- tayorityādi| karmeti cikitsā| tau hītyādinā
                                prakṣīṇadurbalatayā dhvaṃsakavikṣayayorvātapradhānatāṃ darśayati|
                                yuktamadyasyeti yathoktavidhinā madyamācarataḥ||199-205||
tau hi prakṣīṇadehasya jāyete durbalasya vai

sarvathā madyaparityāgaphalamāha- nivṛtta
                                ityādi| jitendriya iti viśeṣaṇaṃ madyanivṛttāveva prayojakam|
                                śārīramānasairvikārairiti yogyatayā madyavyāpattijanyaireva
                                śārīramānasairvikāraiḥ; anyahetujāñ śārīramānasavikārān prati
                                madyanivṛttirakiñcitkarīti bhāvaḥ| na yujyata iti
                                śārīramānasavikārairmadyanivṛttyā na yukto bhavati||206||

tatra ślokāḥ- yatprabhāvā bhagavatī surā peyā
                                yathā ca sā
yaddravyā yasya yā ceṣṭā yogaṃ cāpekṣate yathā
yo mado madabhedāśca ye trayaḥ svasvalakṣaṇāḥ
ye ca madyakṛtā doṣā guṇā ye ca madātmakāḥ
madātyayasya yo heturlakṣaṇaṃ yad yathā ca yat

madyaṃ madyotthitān rogān hanti yaśca
                                kriyākramaḥ

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                cikitsāsthāne madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne
                                madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||24||

madyamattasya samprahārādinā vraṇotpattau
                                vraṇacikitsārthaṃ dvivraṇīya ucyate||1-2||

, tajjānātīti parāvarajñaḥ|
                                tayorliṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ cetyatra hetorapi vyādhigamakatayā liṅgenaiva
                                grahaṇam||3-4||

doṣā yadyapi śārīrā eva, tathā+apīha śārīrapadaṃ
                                snāyukledādiṣvapīha prayuktadoṣavyudāsārtham|
                                nijāgantuvraṇabhedamāha- mantretyādi| nijaiḥ samamāgantavo vraṇā
                                viparītā mantrādibhirbheṣajaiśca, tathā hetubhiśca
                                vadhabandhanādibhiḥ, tathā liṅgaikadeśaiśca; sa ca liṅgaikadeśo
                                yathā- āganturvyathāpūrvamudeti paścādvātādīn kopayati, nije tu
                                pūrvaṃ vātādayaḥ prakupyanti paścādvyathotpadyate| yaduktaṃ-
                                “āganturvyathāpūrvamutpanno jaghanyaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ
                                vaiṣamyamāpādayati” (sū.a.20) iti||5-8||

na vaktavyaḥ;
                                tena tasya cikitsāmapi samāsādevāha- vraṇānāmityādi| āgantūnāṃ
                                vraṇānāṃ nijahetūnāṃ satāṃ mantrādicikitsayā aśāmyatāṃ nijānāṃ
                                yathauṣadhaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ tathaiva doṣabalāvekṣī san kuryāditi
                                yojanā| āgantūnāṃ cehāgantucikitsayā+apraśamanaṃ
                                nijadoṣānubandhādeva jñeyam; ata eveha nijahetūnāmiti kṛtam||9||

yathāsvairityādinā
                                nijavraṇahetusamprāptyādikathanam| atra yathāsvairhetubhiriti
                                vacanena vātādīnāṃ svātantryeṇa prakopaṃ darśayati, svahetuduṣṭo hi
                                doṣaḥ svatantro bhavati; kiñca yathāsvairhetubhiriti vacanena ya eva
                                vātādikopahetavasta evātra nijavraṇakārakā bhavanti, na
                                punarvraṇānāṃ viśiṣṭo heturasti; sāmānyavātādihetostu
                                viśiṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇakāryotpattiḥ samprāptibhedādbhavatīti
                                jñeyam||10||

stabdha ityādinā vātādivraṇānāṃ lakṣaṇāni tathā
                                cikitsāsūtraṃ cāha| pradehaiḥ pariṣekaiścetyatra ‘asnigdhaiḥ’
                                ityanuvartate| ciraṃ vikāraṃ karotīti cirakārī|
                                cikitsāsamāsābhidhānaṃ ca sukhagrahaṇārthameva||11-16||

tau dvāvityādi| nānātvakārako bhedo
                                nānātvabhedaḥ| prakarṣeṇa duṣṭāḥ praduṣṭāḥ||17-19||
teṣāṃ parīkṣā trividhā, praduṣṭā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ

ete ca vraṇabhedādayo+agre kṛtyotkṛtya ityādinā
                                vyākriyante| tatra kṛtyaḥ chedanādyupakramopakramaṇīyaḥ, utkṛtyasya
                                tu nātra kiñcitkaraṇīyamasti paraṃ ropaṇīya eva; kiṃvā kṛtyaḥ
                                sādhyaḥ, akṛtyastvasādhyaḥ| kṛtyādayaḥ ṣaṭ saviparyayā evoktāḥ,
                                saṃvṛtādayastu saptoddiṣṭāḥ saviparyayāḥ santaścaturdaśa| utsanna
                                udgatamāṃsaḥ| utsaṅgī sthūlaparyantaḥ, kiṃvā vraṇādbahiḥ
                                pūyāvakāśarūpotsaṅgavānutsaṅgī| suśrute tu
                                “tatrātisaṃvṛto+ativivṛttaḥ” (su.sū.a.22) ityādinā
                                yadduṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tadatisaṃvṛtādiviṣayam, iha tu
                                saṃvṛtatvavivṛtatvamātramucyate, teneha duṣṭavraṇena saṃvṛtasya
                                    grahaṇamudbhāvanīyam

parīkṣātraividhyamuktaṃ vibhajate- darśanetyādi|
                                indriyāṇi ca yadyapyatīndriyatvādanumānagamyāni, tathā+apīha
                                tadadhiṣṭhānānāmindriyaśabdenopādānam| agniśca yadyapi “agniṃ
                                jaraṇaśaktyā” (vi.a.4) iti vacanādanumānaviṣaya uktastathā+api
                                praśnenāgniravagamyata eveti kṛtveha vacanaparīkṣaṇīyataivoktā
                                vahneḥ| saviparyaye iti kāṭhinyauṣṇye| anumānaṃ ca yadyapi
                                parīkṣādhikāre proktaṃ “dvividhā parīkṣā jñānavatāṃ
                                pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca” (vi.a.4) ityādinā, tathā+apyatrānumānasya
                                prāyo vyāpārābhāvādanupādānamiti brūte; kintu
                                darśanādipūrvakatvādanumānasya darśanādinā anumānamapyatīndriyādiṣu
                                grāhakaṃ saṅgṛhītamiti yuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ| darśanaśabdaścātra
                                sākṣādupalabdhivacanaḥ, tena vraṇagatagandhenāpi vraṇaparīkṣaṇaṃ
                                saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati| darśanaśabdena ca gṛhīto+api sparśa iha bhūyasā
                                vyāpriyamāṇatvāt punaruktaḥ||22-23||

śveto+avasannetyādinā praduṣṭavraṇānāha|
                                ropyalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntarādavagantavyaṃ, tathāhi bhojaḥ- “rūḍhā
                                rūḍhāḥ prakupyanti sāntardoṣāḥ punaḥ punaḥ| bahiḥ śuddhā ivābhānti
                                ropyāste samprakīrtitāḥ” iti| eteṣāmeva śvetādīnāṃ
                                bhedakāraṇāntarabhedena caturviṃśatitvaṃ bhavatīti darśayannāha-
                                caturviṃśatirityādi| kalpāntareṇeti
                                vraṇaduṣṭikārakakāraṇayogabhedena snāyukledādinā
                                bhidyamānāścaturviṃśatibhedā bhavantītyarthaḥ||24-25||

sarpirityādinā gandhanirdeśaḥ| śyāvagandhaṃ
                                dadhyādestāmraghṛṣṭasamānaṃ gandhamāhuḥ; kecittu ‘śāvaṃ’ iti
                                paṭhanti; śavasya gandhaḥ śāvaḥ| amlasahacaritagandho+amlagandha
                                ucyate||27||

prakārāntaroddiṣṭāñcaturviṃśatidoṣānāha-
                                snāyukledādityādi| atra nakhakāṣṭhaprabheda ekameva kāraṇam|
                                carmalomātighaṭṭanaṃ tu kāraṇadvayam| cikitsāvarjanīyatvaṃ
                                niṣkriyatvam||31-35||
vraṇā na praśamaṃ yānti niṣkriyatvācca dehinām

asādhyo nirupakrama iti asādhyatvamabhidhāyāpi
                                nirupakramatābhidhānena sopakramasādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ niṣedhayati||36-37||
sadyaḥ śuddhaśarīrāṇāṃ praśamaṃ yānti hi vraṇāḥ

avasaraprāptāyāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramarūpāyāṃ
                                cikitsāyāṃ vaktavyāyāṃ saṃśodhanasya prādhānyopadarśanārthaṃ
                                pṛthagagre+abhidhānaṃ- vraṇānāmityādinā||38||-

upakramānāha- śophaghnamityādinā| śophaghna
                                upakramo raktāvasekādirvakṣyamāṇaḥ| ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarmeti
                                pāṭanādi; atraivāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śalyatantroktamadhikaṃ
                                karmadvayamantarbhāvanīyaṃ; kiṃveṣaṇaṃ śastrakarmāṅgaṃ na
                                śastrakarma, tattu pṛthageva| avapīḍanaṃ kalkādinā ālepanaṃ
                                pūyanirgamanārthaṃ vakṣyati| nirvāpaṇaṃ dāhauṣṇyaśamanam| śodhanau
                                ropaṇīyau ca kaṣāyau sapralepanau iti śodhanaropaṇakaṣāyau tathā
                                śodhanaropaṇālepau| dve taile tadguṇe ityatra ghṛtasyāpi
                                snehatvasāmānyāt tailenaiva grahaṇaṃ; tena yadyapi catvāri
                                tailaghṛtāni pratyekaśodhanaropaṇabhedādvakṣyati, tathā+api
                                śodhanaropaṇakarmadvayakartṛtayā dvitvamevātra
                                tailaghṛtayorgaṇanīyam| kāśmīrāstu “dvau snehau tadguṇau” iti
                                paṭhanti| patraṃ chādane iti patrameka upakramaḥ, chādanaṃ tu
                                dvividhaṃ bāhyāntarabhedena vakṣyamāṇam| utsādanaṃ
                                nimnavraṇotthāpanam| avasādanam utsannavraṇamāṃsakṣayakaram|
                                kāṭhinyamārdavakare dhūpanālepane iti kāṭhinyakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ,
                                mārdavakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ ceti; evamālepanamapi dvividhaṃ jñeyam|
                                vraṇāvacūrṇanaṃ dvividhaṃ vadanti tvagvarṇakararomajanakabhedena|
                                evaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramā bhavanti; śalyatantre tu ṣaṣṭirupakramā
                                uktāste+apyatraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ||39-43||

saktavo madhukaṃ sarpiḥ pradehaḥ syāt
                                saśarkaraḥ

atha yathāvasthaṃ vraṇopakramānāha-
                                pūrvarūpamityādi| śothastu vraṇapūrvarūpaṃ,
                                śothacikitsā+anāgatavraṇavihitatvādvraṇopakramatvenoktā|
                                kaṣāyapānaiḥ sarpirbhiśceti kaṣāyasarpirbhiḥ| vijayā balā||44-48||
sa cedevamupakrāntaḥ śopho na praśamaṃ vrajet
tailena sarpiṣā vā+api tābhyāṃ vā saktupiṇḍikā

upanāhairiti soṣṇabahalalepaiḥ| kiṇvaṃ
                                surābījam| umā atasī| saudhaṃ payaḥ snuhīkṣīram| hemakṣīrī
                                kaṅkuṣṭham| mukūlakaḥ dantī| sukumārasyeti cchedaḥ| kṛcchrasyeti
                                asukumārasya, śastraṃ paraṃ bhedanamiti sambandhaḥ||49-54||

pāṭanamityādinā prokte ṣaḍvidhaśastrakarmaṇi
                                tisraiṣaṇīyoktādhikadāraṇādiśastrakarmāvarodho boddhavyaḥ, tena na
                                virodhaḥ||55||
pāṭanaṃ vyadhanaṃ caiva chedanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā
pracchanaṃ sīvanaṃ caiva ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarma tat

pāṭanādīnāṃ pṛthagviṣayamāha- nāḍīvraṇā ityādi|
                                sampakva gulmā ye te vyadhyāḥ| tathā ye ca raktajā iti raktagulmāḥ|
                                śoṇitarogā vidhiśoṇitīyoktāḥ| vyadhyā iti sirāvyadhādisādhyāḥ|
                                lekhyānīti lekhanāvasthāprāptāni||56-60||-
dakodarāṇi sampakvā gulmā ye ye ca raktajāḥ

vraṇapīḍane iti vraṇapīḍanaśca lepo niḥsneho
                                vraṇamukhaṃ varjayitvā kartavyaḥ||61-62||

nyagrodhādikamiti
                                nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthetyādinoktamatraiva| balādikaṃ ‘vijayā
                                madhukaṃ vīrā’ ityādinā śothaharopakramopadiṣṭam||63-64||-

samena samamaṅgena kṛtveti
                                samenāvikṛtenānyenāṅgena samaṃ sadṛśaṃ kṛtvā sandadhīteti yojyam|
                                kavalikākuśikābandhau suśrute draṣṭavyau

asthibhagnaṃ cyutaṃ sandhiṃ sandadhīta samaṃ
                                punaḥ

balā guḍūcītyādi| atra balādīni piṣṭāni
                                śarkarākṣīramadhūcchiṣṭatailādibhiḥ samairutkarikāṃ kṛtvā svedaḥ
                                kartavyaḥ; anye tu balādikalkena tailādisnehaṃ caturguṇe kṣīre
                                sādhayitvā snehapādikaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaprakṣepamāhuḥ| snehasyātra
                                saṃhatāvasthitatvāt madhuśarkarāvat ‘snehaśarkarā’ iti vyapadeśaḥ|
                                dvipañcamūlakvathiteneti ambhasā payasā sarpiṣā tailena veti
                                yojanīyam||72-79||
śuṣkā mahārujaḥ stabdhā ye vraṇā mārutottarāḥ
jīvantī śarkarā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ matsyavasā ghṛtam

dvividhāmityādau audbhidairmṛdubhirnālaiḥ
                                mṛdvīṃ, lohaiḥ kaṭhinām| pāṭhyamiti eṣaṇīyaṃ pāṭhyaṃ ca||80-82||

nimbakolakapatrāṇītyatra nimba eva
                                mṛdurnimbakolaka ucyate; kiṃvā kulaketi pāṭhaḥ, kulakaḥ
                                paṭolaḥ||83-85||

nātirakta ityādinā śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇamabhidhāya
                                ropaṇamāha- nyagrodhetyādi| kaṣāyā iti
                                bahuvacananirdeśādyathoktavyastasamastaprayogān sūcayati|
                                dārvyāstvak dārvītvak vraṇaśodhanī ropaṇī ca| ghṛtaṃ taireva
                                sādhayediti yathoktatailadravyaireva sādhayediti| ghṛtaviṣayamāha-
                                raktapittottaramityādi| ropaṇīyamiti vacanād ropaṇameva ghṛtaṃ
                                kartavyaṃ, natu śodhanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ||86-94||
na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ
mede mūrvā samaṅgā ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vraṇaropaṇam
ropaṇaṃ satilaṃ dadyāt pralepaṃ saghṛtaṃ vraṇe
paṭolaṃ picumardaṃ ca lodhraṃ mustaṃ priyaṅgukam
piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ bhavettailaṃ tat paraṃ vraṇaropaṇam
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ kākolyau dve ca candane
yenaiva vidhinā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ tenaiva sādhayet

vārkṣa ityādau vṛkṣabhavaṃ valkalaṃ vārkṣam|
                                savyadakṣiṇa iti vāmadakṣiṇaḥ; vāmaparikṣepaḥ savyaḥ,
                                dakṣiṇaparikṣepo dakṣiṇaḥ| atraiva śalyoktacaturdaśabandhāvarodhaḥ
                                kāryaḥ||95-96||

stanyāni ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktāni|
                                aśmakāsīsaṃ dhātukāsīsam| adhobhāgāni trivṛtādīni
                                virecanadravyāṇi||97-100||

chedye iti chedanārhe| klṛpteṣviti kartiteṣu|
                                rūkṣasnigdhadāhabhedaviṣayaṃ dāhakavastubhedaṃ ca darśayannāha-
                                sukumārāṇāmityādinā| dāhaviśeṣaviditi dāhānāṃ viśeṣaṃ
                                snigdharūkṣādirūpaṃ tathā binduvalayādirūpaṃ jānātīti dāhaviśeṣavit|
                                viṣādināmiti bhakṣitaviṣāṇām||101-106||

yadyapyupakrameṣu kṣāraḥ pṛthaṅna paṭhitaḥ,
                                tathā+api śastrāgnivyāpārakartṛtvācchastrāgnyupakramagṛhīta eveti
                                kṛtvā kṣāramapyavacārayediti vacanena kṣāro+api vihitaḥ||107-109||

kaṭhinatvaṃ vraṇā yānti gandhaiḥ sāraiśca
                                dhūpitāḥ

sarujaḥ kaṭhināḥ stabdhā nirāsrāvāśca ye
                                vraṇāḥ

kakubhetyādiprakaraṇena tvagjananaṃ tathā
                                savarṇakaraṇaṃ tathā romajananamiti upakramatrayamāha| tvacamāśveva
                                gṛhṇantīti satvaco bhavanti| triphalākusumānīti
                                triphalāvṛkṣapuṣpāṇi| latā priyaṅguḥ| kāntā mañjiṣṭhā| rasottamaḥ
                                pāradaḥ, ghṛtaṃ vā| amṛtāsaṅgaḥ karparikātuttham||113-119||
teṣāṃ cikitsā nirdiṣṭā yathāsvaṃ sve cikitsite

tatra ślokau- dvau vraṇau vraṇabhedāśca parīkṣā
                                duṣṭireva ca
sthānāni gandhāḥ srāvāśca sopasargāḥ kriyāśca yāḥ

ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte
                                dṛḍhabalasampūrite cikitsāsthāne dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma
                                pañcaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ

iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ
                                carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne
                                dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ||25||

dvivraṇīye
                                dvisaṅkhyāvacchinnarogacikitsābhidhānānantaraṃ
                                trisaṅkhyāvacchinnaśirobastihṛdayamarmarogacikitsābhidhānārthaṃ
                                trimarmīyacikitsita ucyate| trimarmaśabdena hi trimarmāśritā
                                rogāstasyopacāraścābhidhīyate; tena trimarmīyarogānadhikṛtya kṛtaṃ
                                cikitsitaṃ trimarmīyacikitsitam||1-2||

marmāṇi bastiṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraśca pradhānabhūtāni vadanti
                                tajjñāḥ

prāṇāśrayāt, tāni hi pīḍayanto vātādayo+asūnapi
                                pīḍayanti

prakṛtapradhānamarmatrayamavadhārayati-
                                saptottaramityādi| śarīrasaṅkhyāmadhikṛtyeti śarīrasaṅkhyāśārīre
                                (śā.a.7) uktamadhikṛtyetyarthaḥ| hṛdayādimarmaprādhānye hetumāha-
                                prāṇāśrayāditi| hṛdayādīnāṃ prāṇāśrayatve evopapattimāha- tānītyādi|
                                hṛdayādyupaghātena yasmādviśeṣataḥ prāṇopaghāto bhavati, tasmād
                                hṛdayādyāśritāḥ prāṇā ucyante; yathā bhittyupaghātopahanyamānaṃ
                                citraṃ bhittyāśrayamucyate| tatsaṃśritānāmiti prāṇāśrayāṇāṃ
                                hṛdayādīnāṃ; saṃśritaśabdena hi saṃśraya ucyate| mahānto gadā yeṣu
                                bhavanti teṣāṃ mahāgadānāṃ bastyādīnāmanupālanārthaṃ rakṣāṃ śṛṇu;
                                kiṃvā tatsaṃśritānāmiti bastyādisaṃśritānāṃ prāṇānāmanupālanārthaṃ,
                                mahāgadānāṃ mahāmarmabastyādivyāpakodāvartādīnāṃ, rakṣāmiti
                                cikitsām||3-4||

bastyādijānāṃ yathākramaṃ hetvādimāha-
                                kaṣāyetyādi| ūṣaṇaḥ kaṭukaḥ| pakvāśaye ityādinā
                                udāvartasamprāptiliṅgacikitsitāni prāha| nanu kathamapānaḥ
                                kupito+apānasyaiva saṅgaṃ karotīti mārutasaṅgaśabdenocyate? brūmaḥ-
                                ātmanaivāyaṃ duṣṭaḥ samyagapravartamāna ātmanaḥ saṅgaṃ
                                karotītyucyate, yathā mana eva manonigrahaṃ karoti| uktaṃ ca
                                “indriyābhigrahaḥ karma manasaḥ svasya nigrahaḥ” (śā.a.1) iti|
                                ūrdhvaśceti ūrdhvagamanasvabhāvaḥ||5-10||

pakvāśaye kupyati cedapānaḥ srotāṃsyadhogāni balī sa
                                ruddhvā

kṛcchreṇa śuṣkasya cirāt pravṛttiḥ syādvā tanuḥ syāt
                                khararūkṣaśītā

anye ca rogā bahavo+anilotthā bhavantyudāvartakṛtāḥ
                                sughorāḥ

cikitsitaṃ cāsya yathāvadūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyate tacchṛṇu
                                cāgniveśa!

tailajvaranāśanāktamiti
                                śītajvaranāśanāgurvādyāktam| śyāmetyādiphalavartau śyāmā
                                trivṛdbhedaḥ| daśabhāgā māṣasya yasyāṃ sā daśabhāgamāṣā|
                                dvirlavaṇāmiti dvibhāgalavaṇām| guḍenetivacanena yāvatā guḍena
                                vartiḥ kartuṃ yujyate tāvanmāno guḍo deyaḥ| yāvaśūkairityantena
                                dvitīyā vartirguḍainaiva

kartavyā| śaṅkhinī śvetabuhnā| rāḍhaḥ madanaphalam| veśmadhūmaḥ
                                agāradhūmaḥ| rakṣoghnaḥ sarṣapaḥ| karahāṭaḥ madanaḥ| teṣāṃ vighāte
                                iti phalavarticūrṇanāmuktānāṃ kāryākaraṇe| ūrdhvānulomauṣadhaṃ
                                vamanavirecanauṣadham| vāte+adhika ityādinā doṣabhedena
                                bastāvāvāpamāha| udāvarte pittakaphau vātakopitāveva jñeyau| sa iti
                                pūrvokto bastiḥ||11-17||

sanīlikāṃ dvirlavaṇāṃ guḍena vartiṃ karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ
                                vidadhyāt

vāte+adhike+amlaṃ lavaṇaṃ satailaṃ, kṣīreṇa pitte
                                tu, kaphe samūtram

prasannā madyopari svaccho bhāgaḥ| guḍakṛtaḥ
                                sīdhuḥ guḍasīdhuḥ||18||

bhūyo+anubandhe iti bastiprayoge
                                satyapyudāvartānubandhe| etacca virecanaṃ bastidānāt
                                saptāhādūrdhvam| yaduktaṃ- “naro viriktastu nirūhadānaṃ vivarjayet
                                saptadinānyavaśyam| śuddho nirūheṇa virecanaṃ ca” (si.a.1) iti||19||

dviruttaretyādau yathottaraṃ dravyāṇāṃ
                                dvaiguṇyam| suvarcikā svarjikākṣāraḥ| sukhāmbunā ‘pītam’ iti śeṣaḥ|
                                ugragandhā ajamodā||20-22||

siddhaḥ kaṣāye dvipalāṃśikānāṃ prastho ghṛtāt syāt
                                pratiruddhavāte

sthirādivargasyeti alpapañcamūlasya|
                                śampākapūtīkakarañjayoścetyatra pūtīkaśabdaḥ karañjaviśeṣaṇam|
                                tathāhi jatūkarṇaḥ- “āragvadhapūtikapunarnavāsthirādyairghṛtaṃ
                                siddhamḥ” ityādi||23||

phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktaṃ hiṅgvarkamūlaṃ
                                daśamūlamagryam

snuk citrakaścaiva punarnavā ca tulyāni sarvairlavaṇāni
                                pañca

snehaiḥ samūtraiḥ saha jarjarāṇi śarāvasandhau
                                vipacet sulipte

phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktamiti
                                dīrghañjīvitīye (sū.a.1) mūlinīphalinīvirecanakarmaṇyuktaṃ; kiṃvā
                                kalpe virecanayogeṣu vakṣyamāṇam||24-25||

hṛdityādinā udāvartasyaiva
                                hetulakṣaṇaviśeṣakṛtāmānāhasañjñāṃ pradarśya tatra
                                bheṣajamāha||26-31||

pṛthaṅmalāḥ svaiḥ kupitā nidānaiḥ sarve+athavā
                                kopamupetya bastau

mūtrasya mārgaṃ paripīḍayanti yadā tadā mūtrayatīha
                                kṛcchrāt

tīvrā rujo vaṅkṣaṇabastimeḍhre svalpaṃ
                                muhurmūtrayatīha vātāt

pītaṃ saraktaṃ sarujaṃ sadāhaṃ kṛcchrānmuhurmūtrayatīha
                                pittāt

basteḥ saliṅgasya gurutvaśothau mūtraṃ sapicchaṃ
                                kaphamūtrakṛcchre

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātādbhavanti tat kṛcchratamaṃ hi
                                kṛcchram

vyāyāmetyādinā bastyāśrayarogeṣu
                                mūtrakṛcchrāṇyāha| pṛthagityādinā vātapittakaphasannipātajānāṃ
                                mūtrakṛcchrāṇāṃ samprāptimāha| tīvrā hi rugityādinā caturṇāṃ
                                pratyekaṃ rūpamāha||32-35||

viśoṣayedityādinā
                                catuṣprakārānapyaśmarīrogānāha| tantrāntare+aśmaryastu
                                vātapittakaphaśukrajā uktāḥ; yadyapi sarvāśmarīṣu
                                doṣatrayajanyatvamasti, “saṃhantyāpo yathā divyā māruto+agniśca
                                vaidyutaḥ| tadvadbalāsaṃ bastisthamūṣmā saṃhanti sanilaḥ” (su. ni.
                                a. 3) iti suśruta pratipāditaṃ; tathā+apyutkaṭaikadoṣābhiprāyeṇa
                                vātajādivyapadeśo jñeyaḥ| vātajāyāmaśmaryāṃ prabalena vāyunā
                                mūtraśoṣe kriyamāṇe tadgataḥ kapha evāśmarīrūpaḥ kriyate, evaṃ
                                pittāśmaryāmapi jñeyam, ata eva suśrute śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvā
                                evāśmarya uktāḥ| aśmaryutpāde dṛṣṭāntamāha- pitteṣviva rocanā
                                goriti; pitteṣviti bahuvacanaṃ
                                    pittabahutvāpekṣayā

viśoṣayedbastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ
                                pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā

yadā tadā+aśmaryupajāyate tu krameṇa pitteṣviva rocanā
                                goḥ

mūtrasya cenmārgamupaiti ruddhvā mūtraṃ rujaṃ tasya karoti
                                bastau

mṛdnāti meḍhraṃ sa tu vedanārto muhuḥ śakṛnmuñcati mehate
                                ca

kṣobhāt kṣate mūtrayatīha sāsṛk tasyāḥ sukhaṃ
                                mehati ca vyapāyāt

kadambapuṣpākṛtyādayo viśeṣā yathāyogyatayā
                                doṣabhedādunneyāḥ| tatra vātena kadambapuṣpākṛtistripuṭī ca,
                                pittenāśmatulyā ślakṣṇā, mṛdvī kaphena śukreṇa ca| kṣobhāt kṣata iti
                                aśmarīkṣobhānmūtramārge bastau vā kṣate| tasyā iti aśmaryāḥ|
                                vyapāyāditi mūtramārgāpagamāt| sukhamiti nirvedanam||37-38||-

eṣetyādinā śarkarāmāha| bhinnamūrtiriti
                                aṇurūpatayā bheditamūrtiḥ| ata eva mūtrapathāt kṣarantītyuktam| tena
                                vātena dvidhā tridhā bhinnā+anekadhā vā+aśmarī mūtrapathena kṣarantī
                                śarkareva bhavati||39-41||

śukreṇa saṃruddhagatipravāho mūtraṃ sa kṛcchreṇa
                                vimuñcatīha

tamaṇḍayoḥ stabdhamiti bruvanti reto+abhighātāt pravadanti
                                    kṛcchram

śukraṃ malāścaiva pṛthak pṛthagvā mūtrāśayasthāḥ
                                prativārayanti

tadvyāhataṃ mehanabastiśūlaṃ mūtraṃ saśukraṃ kurute
                                vibaddham

stabdhaśca śūno bhṛśavedanaśca tudyeta
                                bastirvṛṣaṇau ca tasya

śukraṃ malā ityādinā
                                śukrajamūtrakṛcchralakṣaṇam| mūtrāśayasthā iti
                                mūtramārgasthitāḥ||42||-

kṣatābhighātāt kṣatajaṃ kṣayādvā prakopitaṃ
                                bastigataṃ vibaddham

ādhmātatāṃ vindati gauravaṃ ca basterlaghutvaṃ ca
                                viniḥsṛte+asmin

kṣatetyādinā raktajaṃ mūtrakṛcchramāha|
                                kṣatajamiti raktam| kṣayādvā prakopitamiti ativyavāyācchukrakṣaye
                                sati vāyunodīrya bastimānītam| ādhmātatāmiti bastipūrṇatām|
                                tasminniti rakte atisañcite| evaṃ sūtrasthānoddiṣṭā aṣṭau mūtraghātā
                                mūtrakṛcchraśabdeneha nirdiśya vyākṛtāḥ| ye tu trimarmīyasiddhau
                                trayodaśa mūtrāghātā vaktavyāste sūtrasthāne+asūtritā api
                                ekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhavadantarbhāvanīyāḥ|
                                mūtrāghātamūtrakṛcchrayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yanmūtrakṛcchre mūtraṃ
                                kṛcchreṇa vahati, mūtrāghāte mūtraṃ śoṣyate pratihanyate vā;
                                suśrute+api ca
                                mūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātayorviśeṣo+adhyāyabhedenaivoktaḥ| anye tu
                                mūtrakṛcchraviśeṣāneva mūtrāghātānāhuḥ, yathāyogyatayā
                                vātapittādicaturṣu mūtrakṛcchreṣu mūtrāghātānantarbhāvayanti; tena
                                na pṛthaṅmūtrāghātābhidhānam||43-44||

tailaṃ varāharkṣavasā ghṛtaṃ ca taireva
                                kalkairlavaṇaiśca sādhyam

etāni cānyāni varauṣadhāni piṣṭāni śastānyapi
                                copanāhe

mūtrakṛcchre cikitsāmāha- abhyañjanetyādi|
                                sthirādibhiḥ pañcamūlaiḥ| vātaharairiti tatra tatra vātaharatvena
                                pratipāditaiḥ| pattūraḥ śāliñcakā| aśmabhit pāṣāṇabhedaḥ| anyānīti
                                evaṅguṇānyevānyāni| tailaphalāni tilomāsphotādīni||45-48||

graiṣmo vidhiriti tasyāśītīyokto grīṣmavidhiḥ|
                                tatra śiśirāveva sekāvagāhau yadyapyuktau, tathā+api viśeṣeṇa
                                śiśirasekāvagāhakaraṇārthaṃ punarabhidhānam| daṇḍairakā ‘hoggala’
                                iti khyātā| pūrveṇa kalpeneti kvāthena madhuśarkarayoryogena
                                ca||49-51||

kvāthaṃ suśītaṃ madhuśarkarābhyāṃ yuktaṃ pibet
                                paittikamūtrakṛcchrī

ervārubījaṃ trapuṣāt kusumbhāt sakuṅkumaḥ
                                syādvṛṣakaśca peyaḥ

dārvīṃ tathaivāmalakīrasena samākṣikāṃ pittakṛte tu
                                kṛcchre

kṣāroṣṇetyādi| kaphakṛcchre kṣārādibhiryuktaṃ
                                bheṣajamannapānaṃ ca prayojyam| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| truṭiḥ elā|
                                sārasaḥ pakṣī svanāmakhyātaḥ| kolapramāṇamiti aṣṭamāṣakamānam|
                                kaiṭaryaḥ pārvato nimbaḥ| śitivārakaḥ śāliñcaḥ||54-57||

pibettruṭiṃ kṣaudrayutāṃ kadalyā rasena kaiḍaryarasena
                                vā+api

takreṇa yuktaṃ śitivārakasya bījaṃ pibet
                                kṛcchravināśahetoḥ

paktvā jale tena pibedyavāgūṃ siddhaṃ kaṣāyaṃ
                                madhusaṃyutaṃ vā

sarvaṃ tridoṣaprabhave tu vāyoḥ sthānānupūrvyā
                                prasamīkṣya kāryam

tribhyo+adhike prāgvamanaṃ kaphe syāt pitte virekaḥ pavane
                                tu bastiḥ

sarvamityādi| etadeva vātādibheṣajaṃ militaṃ
                                tridoṣaprabhave kṛcchre kartavyam| tacca sameṣvapi doṣeṣu vāyoḥ
                                sthānānupūrvyā cikitsitaṃ kartavyaṃ, na jvara iva tridoṣabhave
                                kaphasthānānupūrvyā kartavyaṃ; mūtrakṛcchrasya
                                samatridoṣārabdhatve+api vātasthānabhavatvena vāyureva prathamaṃ
                                cikitsya iti bhāvaḥ| viṣamasannipātārabdhe kriyāmāha- tribhyo+adhike
                                ityādi| tribhyo+adhike iti granthaḥ kaphe tathā pitte tathā pavane
                                ityanena ca krameṇa sambadhyate||58||

kriyā hitā seti yā kaphamārutotthe kṛcchre
                                vihitā sā militaiva śarkarāyāmaśmaryāṃ ca kartavyā| kharāśvā
                                ajamodā| cūrṇaṃ pibedityatra jalenaiva pānam| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣaḥ|
                                kunduruḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ| triphalādvibhāgamiti triphalāyāḥ pratyekaṃ
                                mūlabhāgād bhāgadvayam| amlairiti kāñjikādibhiḥ| aśuktairiti
                                śuktavarjitaiḥ| madyaṃ cātrāmlagrahaṇagṛhītamapi
                                bastiśodhanatvādaśamarībhedakatvaprakarṣakhyāpanārthaṃ punarucyate|
                                aśmabhiditi aśmarībhedī| sitopalā śarkarā| śalyaviduddharediti
                                śalyaśāstravettā taduktavidhānenāśmarīmākarṣet| samīkṣya doṣamiti
                                doṣamulbaṇaṃ samīkṣya| pratikarma kuryāt pratikarma cikitsitam|
                                madhvasanākhyaparṇyau madhuparṇī guḍūcī, asanaparṇī aparājitā,
                                ‘dāruparṇī’ ityapare| saṃsargaje iti tridoṣānugate| vihaṅgaḥ
                                pakṣī||59-72||

kriyā hitā sā+aśmariśarkarābhyāṃ kṛcchre yathaiveha
                                kaphānilābhyām

utkuñcikā hiṅgu savetasāmlaṃ syāddve bṛhatyau
                                hapuṣā vacā ca

āloḍya dadhnā madhureṇa peyaṃ dināni
                                saptāśmaribhedanāya

śīto+aśmabhit syāddadhimaṇḍayuktaḥ peyaḥ prakāmaṃ lavaṇena
                                yuktaḥ

sitopalā vā samayāvaśūkā kṛcchreṣu sarveṣvapi bheṣajaṃ
                                syāt

pītvā+atha madyaṃ nigadaṃ rathena hayena vā
                                śīghrajavena yāyāt

taiḥ śarkarā pracyavate+aśmarī tu śamyenna
                                cecchalyaviduddharettām

retobhighātaprabhave tu kṛcchre samīkṣya doṣaṃ
                                pratikarma kuryāt

kārpāsamūlaṃ vṛṣakāśmabhedau balā sthirādīni gavedhukā
                                ca

vṛścīra aindrī ca punarnavā ca śatāvarī
                                madhvasanākhyaparṇyau

tatkvāthasiddhaḥ pavane rasaḥ syāt pitte+adhike
                                kṣīramathāpi sarpiḥ

kaphe ca yūṣādikamannapānaṃ saṃsargaje sarvahitaḥ
                                kramaḥ syāt

evaṃ na cecchāmyati tasya yuñjyāt surāṃ purāṇāṃ
                                madhukāsavaṃ vā

śuddhasya tṛptasya ca vṛṣyayogaiḥ priyānukūlāḥ pramadā
                                vidheyāḥ

khādediti asiddhānyeva khādet| ghṛtaṃ
                                śvadaṃṣṭretyādau sāhacaryāt kecicchvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasamapyaṣṭaguṇaṃ
                                vadanti; tanna, svarasaḥ snehasama eva sneheṣu bhavati, uktaṃ hi
                                jatūkarṇe- “kalkāccaturguṇaḥ snehaḥ, svarasaḥ snehasammitaḥ” iti;
                                tena kṣīravat sarvasneheṣu svarasavidhānaṃ jñeyam|
                                sthirādikānāmityādau katakādiḥ madhuraskandhe (vi.a.8)
                                    “...katakakāśmarya...

‘kālaṅkatakakāśmaryetyādinokto gaṇo
                                    jñeyaḥ; kālaṅkatako vikaṅkatakaḥ’ iti pā.;

” ityādinokto
                                gaṇo jñeyaḥ| vidhinaiva teneti pūrvaghṛtavidhinaiva; tena
                                śvadaṃṣṭrāsthāne sthirādīni pratyekaṃ kalpanīyāni|
                                svāduphalotthiteneti madhūkākṣoṭādiphalaniṣpannena tailena||73-75||

pibet sitākṣaudrayutāni khādedikṣuṃ vidārīṃ trapuṣāṇi
                                caiva

ghṛtaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasena siddhaṃ kṣīreṇa
                                caivāṣṭaguṇena peyam

yanmūtrakṛcchre vihitaṃ tu paitte kāryaṃ tu
                                tacchoṇitamūtrakṛcchre

stabdhaṃ guru syāt stimitaṃ ca marma kaphāt
                                prasekajvarakāsatandrāḥ

vidyāttridoṣaṃ tvapi sarvaliṅgaṃ tīvrārtitodaṃ kṛmijaṃ
                                sakaṇḍūm

nidānādikrameṇa hṛdrogacikitsāmāha| gadāticāra
                                iti rogāṇāmasamyagupacāraḥ| hṛdrogakartRūṇīti yathā “bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇāṃ
                                bhayaśokahartā”, tena “tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari” (pā.a.2|2|15|)
                                ityanenātra samāsaḥ| vaivarṇyetyādau hṛdrogajā iti
                                vacanāddhṛdrogānantarakālabhāvitayā
                                vaivarṇyādīnāmupadravatvamicchanti; ye tu vaivarṇyādīnāṃ
                                sāmānyahṛdrogalakṣaṇatvamāhuḥ, te hṛdrogeṇa samaṃ jāyante iti
                                hṛdrogajā iti vigrahālliṅgatvaṃ vyutpādayanti| hṛdrogāśca
                                kiyantaḥśirasīye (sū.a.17) vistareṇoktā api cikitsāprakaraṇādiha
                                saṅkṣepeṇābhidhīyante| marmeti hṛdayam||77-80||

tailamityādinā yathākramaṃ cikitsāmāha|
                                tailādīnāmatra samabhāgānāṃ peyatvaṃ jñeyam| vayaḥkayastheti
                                vayaḥsthākāyasthayorguḍūcyāmalakayoḥ svarasagrahaṇam| agryasarpiriti
                                atrāgryapadamasya sarpiṣaḥ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| vikartikeha
                                hṛdayaparikartikākārā vedanā| kvāthaḥ kṛta ityādau nāgarādīnāṃ
                                kalkaṃ pauṣkarādikvāthe prakṣepamāhuḥ| pathyāśatītyādau yamakena
                                bhṛṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ guḍaprasannālavaṇaiśca peya iti vyākhyeyam| dve
                                triphale ityatra drākṣākāśmaryaparūṣakāṇi dvitīyā triphalā| truṭiḥ
                                sūkṣmailā||81-89||

tailaṃ sasauvīrakamastutakraṃ vāte prapeyaṃ lavaṇaṃ
                                sukhoṣṇam

punarnavāṃ dāru sapañcamūlaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān
                                bilvakulatthakolam

sapuṣkarāhvaṃ phalapūramūlaṃ mahauṣadhaṃ śaṭyabhayā
                                ca kalkāḥ

syāttryūṣaṇaṃ dve triphale sapāṭhe
                                nidigdhikāgokṣurakau bale dve

ṛddhistruṭistāmalakī svaguptā mede madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ
                                sthirā ca

prasthaṃ ghṛtasyeha pacedvidhijñaḥ prasthena dadhnā tvatha
                                māhiṣeṇa

mātrāṃ palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ picuṃ vā
                                prayojayenmākṣikasamprayuktām

śvāse sakāse tvatha pāṇḍuroge halīmake
                                hṛdgrahaṇīpradoṣe

śītā ityādi pittahṛdrogacikitsitam| kṣate iti
                                kṣatakṣīṇacikitsite| śreyasī rāsnā| kharjūraṃ kharjūraphalam|
                                kṣaudrānvitamiti sādhanottarakālaṃ pādikamadhuyuktam|
                                svāduphaletyādau svarasā iti rasāḥ||90-95||

śītāḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni tathā vireko hṛdi
                                pittaduṣṭe

kṣate ca sarpīṃṣi hitāni sarpirguḍāśca ye tān prasamīkṣya
                                samyak

taireva sarve praśamaṃ prayānti pittāmayāḥ śoṇitasaṃśrayā
                                ye

granthiśca sarpiḥ payasā pacettaiḥ kṣaudrānvitaṃ
                                pittahṛdāmayaghnam

sthirādikalkaiḥ payasā ca siddhaṃ
                                drākṣārasenekṣurasena vā+api

sarpirhitaṃ svāduphalekṣujāśca rasāḥ suśītā hṛdi
                                pittaduṣṭe

svinnasyetyādi kaphajahṛdrogacikitsādhikāraḥ|
                                śaṅkarāṇīti kalyāṇakarāṇī| udumbaretyādau udumbarādikvāthe
                                bhāgatraye trivṛttryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ pādikaṃ prakṣepyam| aśiśirāmbuyukta
                                iti uṣṇasalilānupānaḥ| kalpavidhānadiṣṭamiti rasāyane vihitam;
                                kalpaśabdena ca kṣudrarasāyanamucyate| prāśa iti cyavanaprāśaḥ|
                                āgastyamiti lehaviśeṣaṇam||96-99||

svinnasya vāntasya vilaṅghitasya kriyā kaphaghnī
                                kaphamarmaroge

tridoṣaje laṅghanamāditaḥ syādannaṃ ca sarveṣu
                                hitaṃ vidheyam

hīnātimadhyatvamavekṣya caiva kāryaṃ trayāṇāmapi karma
                                śastam

tridoṣaje ādau laṅghanavidhānaṃ hṛdayasya
                                kaphasthānatayā tadgate tridoṣaje+api kapha evādau laṅghanena jeya
                                iti matvā kṛtam| tridoṣaje tūlbaṇadoṣacikitsāsūtramāha- hīnātītyādi|
                                hīnatvamadhikatvaṃ madhyamatvaṃ ca doṣāṇāmavekṣya yat karma
                                śastamadhikadoṣavijetṛtayā tat kāryamiti vākyārthaḥ||100||

bhukte+adhikamityādinā sānnipātikahṛdroge
                                prāyobhāviśūlaṃ lakṣaṇabhedena vibhajañcikitsati|
                                bhukte+adhikamityādinā śleṣmaśūlamucyate| sthitamiti praśāntam|
                                jīrṇe+adhikamityādinā anilaśūlaṃ, jīryatyadhikamityanena ca
                                paittikaṃ brūte| phalairiti drākṣākāśmaryādibhiḥ| triṣvevetyādinā
                                sānnipātikaśūlamāha| mūlavirecanaṃ trivṛnmūlādibhirvirecanam| atra
                                virecanopapattimāha- prāyo+anila ityādi| atra cānilakope yadyapi
                                bastirucitaḥ, tathā+apyāmāśayāpekṣayā+a+amāśayaśodhanaṃ virecanameva
                                deyam||101-102||-

bhukte+adhikaṃ jīryati śūlamalpaṃ jīrṇe sthitaṃ
                                cet suradārukuṣṭham

satilvakaṃ dve lavaṇe viḍaṅgamuṣṇāmbunā sātiviṣaṃ pibet
                                saḥ

jīrṇe+adhike snehavirecanaṃ syāt phalairvirecyo
                                yadi jīryati syāt

triṣveva kāleṣvadhike tu śūle tīkṣṇaṃ hitaṃ mūlavirecanaṃ
                                syāt

kramāgataśirorogacikitsāyāṃ vaktavyāyāṃ
                                śirorogapradhānatvādbhūriśirorogahetutvācca pratiśyāyameva tāvadāha|
                                śālākye+apyuktaṃ- “bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vyādhayaḥ sarve pratiśyāyanimittajāḥ|
                                tasmādrogaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ pūrvamevopadiśyate” iti| yadyapi
                                rājayakṣmacikitsite pratiśyāya ukta eva, tathā+api tatra
                                yakṣmapūrvarūpatayoktaḥ, iha tu svatantraḥ pratiśyāya ucyata iti
                                viśeṣaḥ| rajaḥ dhūliḥ| atisvapnaḥ divāsvapnaḥ| avaśyāyaḥ tuṣāraḥ|
                                saṃstyānadoṣe iti ghanībhūtadoṣe| ghrāṇārtītyādinā
                                vātādipratiśyāyānāṃ caturṇāṃ kramāllakṣaṇamāha| sasvaramūrdharoga
                                iti svararogaḥ svarabhedaḥ| kaphādgururityādau guruśabdaḥ
                                kaṇḍūviśeṣaṇam| srotasīti nāsāsrotasi||104-106||-

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātāt syuḥ pīnase
                                    tīvraruje+atiduḥkhe

tatastu rogāḥ kṣavathuśca nāsāśoṣaḥ
                                pratīnāhaparisravau ca

sarvo+ativṛddha ityādinā pratiśyāyajān
                                kṣavathvādīnāha| atra mukharogaṃ ye na paṭhanti te
                                śirorogagrahaṇenaiva mukharogasya grahaṇamiti manyante| eṣāṃ tu
                                duṣṭapratiśyāyakṣavathvādīnāṃ śālākyādiṣu vistaraḥ, atra tu
                                parādhikāratvāt saṅkṣepa eva||107-109||

rodhābhighātetyādinā
                                duṣṭapratiśyāyādīnāmarjunalomaparyantānāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇānyāha|
                                kruddha ityādau sa iti anilaḥ| mastuluṅgāditi mastiṣkāt| kuryāt
                                sapitta ityādinā aruṃṣikāmāha; sā tu śirobhavā jñeyā||110-117||

rodhābhighātasravaśoṣapākairghrāṇaṃ yutaṃ yaśca na
                                vetti gandham

saṃspṛśya marmāṇyanilastu mūrdhni viṣvakpathasthaḥ
                                kṣavathuṃ karoti

kruddhaḥ sa saṃśoṣya kaphaṃ tu
                                nāsāśṛṅgāṭakaghrāṇaviśoṣaṇaṃ ca

ucchvāsamārgaṃ tu kaphaḥ savāto rundhyāt
                                pratīnāhamudāharettam

‘ghrāṇāddhanaḥ pītasitastanurvā doṣaḥ sravet
                                    srāvamudāharettam’ iti pā.;

ānahyate yasya viśuṣyate ca praklidyate dhūpyati cāpi
                                nāsā

na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ
                                vyavasyettamapīnasena

sadāharāgaḥ śvayathuḥ sapākaḥ syād ghrāṇapāko+api
                                ca raktapittāt

ghrāṇāt sravedvā śravaṇānmukhādvā pittāktamasraṃ tvapi
                                pūyaraktam

kuryāt sapittaḥ pavanastvagādīn sandūṣya cārūṃṣi
                                sapākavanti

nāsā pradīpteva narasya yasya dīptaṃ tu taṃ
                                rogamudāharanti

bhṛśārtiśūlaṃ sphuratīha vātāt pittāt sadāhārti
                                kaphādguru syāt

bhṛśārtītyādinā yadyapi pratiśyāyotpannatvena
                                śirorogāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate, tathā+api svatantrotpannānāmapi
                                śirorogāṇāmetadeva lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| evaṃ mukharogādilakṣaṇeṣvapi
                                vācyam| sarvaistridoṣamiti vātādilakṣaṇairmilitaistridoṣaṃ
                                syādityarthaḥ||118||

niṣpatanamiti mukhasrāvaḥ| tṛṣṇetyādi
                                pittajamukharogalakṣaṇam| śālākye prapañcoktamukharogāṇāmatraiva
                                caturvidhamukharoge+antarbhāvaṃ darśayannāha- saṃsthānetyādi|
                                saṃsthānaṃ sthānamoṣṭhādi, dūṣyaṃ raktādi, ākṛtiḥ liṅgaṃ, nāma
                                śītādādi, eṣāṃ bhedād vikalpāccatuḥṣaṣṭividhā bhavanti, te ca
                                śālākye evonneyāḥ| suśrute pañcaṣaṣṭimukharogā uktāḥ, tathā+apīha
                                vaidehamatānusāreṇādūrāntareṇeyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ| yathāpradeśamiti
                                yathācikitsāpradeśam||119-123||

mukhāmaye mārutaje tu śoṣakārkaśyaraukṣyāṇi calā
                                rujaśca

pittāt samūrcchā vividhā rujaśca varṇāśca
                                śuklāruṇavarṇavarjyāḥ

utkleśamandānalatā ca tandrā rujaśca mandāḥ
                                kaphavakraroge

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu vakraroge bhavanti yasmin sa tu
                                sarvajaḥ syāt

yathāpradeśaṃ tu caturvidhasya kriyāṃ pravakṣyāmi
                                mukhāmayasya

āsyarogāntarniviṣṭatvādevārocakānāha| yadyapi
                                rājayakṣmacikitsite+apyarocakā uktāḥ, tathā+api śoṣoktārocakebhyaḥ
                                pṛthagutpannā evārocakā abhidhīyanta iti na paunaruktyam|
                                atilobhenātrārucirucyate, tatrātilobhena kṛtaṃ
                                satatābhyāsamarucikāraṇaṃ darśayati| vibaddhasambaddhayutamiti
                                bandhayuktamityarthaḥ| naikarasamiti anekarasam||124-126||

kaṭvamlamuṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena
                                vidyāllavaṇaṃ ca vakram

śophaḥ sarāgo daraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ sapītapūtiśravaṇaṃ ca
                                pittāt

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātāt srāvaśca
                                tatrādhikadoṣavarṇaḥ

nādo+atirugityādinā karṇarogānāha| ete ca
                                śālākye yadyapyaṣṭāviṃśatiruktāḥ, tathā+apīha caturṣveva karṇarogeṣu
                                śeṣāṇāmapyavarodho vyākhyeyaḥ, śeṣāṇāmapi vātādijanyatvāt||127-128||

alpastu rāga ityādinā catvāro+akṣirogā
                                abhidhīyante| upadehaḥ dūṣikā| subhṛśoṣṇavāhīti atyarthoṣṇasrāvī|
                                anuktanetrāmayānāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- netrāmayāḥ ṣaṇṇavatiriti|
                                netrāmayeṣu ācāryāṇāṃ vipratipattiḥ; netrarogāṇāṃ ṣaṭsaptatiṃ
                                videhaḥ prāha, karālastu ṣaṇṇavatim, aśītiṃ sātyakiḥ prāha| teṣu
                                karālamatenaivaitadabhidhānam, uktaṃ ca tatra- “viṃśatiḥ sapta
                                vartmasthā, nava sandhau prakīrtitāḥ| trayodaśa tu śuklasthāḥ,
                                ṣaḍrogāḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ|| viṃśatiḥ pañca dṛṣṭisthāḥ, ṣoḍaśaiva ca
                                sarvagāḥ” iti| eteṣāṃ jñānopāyamāha- teṣāmityādi| abhivyaktiriti
                                lakṣaṇam| netrarogaprapañcānabhidhāne hetumāha-
                                parādhikāreṣvityādi||129-131||

śuklopadehaṃ bahupicchilāśru netraṃ kaphāt
                                syādgurutā sakaṇḍuḥ

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātānnetrāmayāḥ ṣaṇṇavatistu
                                bhedāt

parādhikāre tu na vistaroktiḥ śasteti tenātra na naḥ
                                prayāsaḥ

teja ityādinā khālityalakṣaṇamāha| tejaḥśabdena
                                dehoṣmā+abhimataḥ; sa vātādyairyuktaḥ khālityādi karotīti yojanīyam|
                                ye tu ‘tejaḥ savātaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, te tejaḥśabdena pittamapi
                                varṇayanti| hariprabhatvamiti kapilatvam| śiroruhāṇāmiti keśānām|
                                aśūnyatārthamiti asya kāyacikitsāśāstrasya
                                śālākyābhidheyarogairaśūnyatārtham| bheṣajasaṅgrahamiti
                                bheṣajābhidhāyakaṃ grantham||132-133||

tejo+anilādyaiḥ saha keśabhūmiṃ dagdhvā+a+aśu
                                kuryāt khalatiṃ narasya

kiñcittu dagdhvā palitāni kuryāddhariprabhatvaṃ ca
                                śiroruhāṇām

ataḥ paraṃ bheṣajasaṅgrahaṃ tu nibodha saṅkṣepata
                                ucyamānam

athaiteṣāṃ kramāccikitsā+abhidhīyate| pratiśyāye
                                dhūmasya niṣedho vairecanikadhūmābhiprāyeṇa kṛtaḥ, teneha
                                snaihikadhūmābhidhānaṃ na virodhi| pāṇisvedaṃ ca upanāhanaṃ ceti
                                pāṇisvedopanāhanam| kṣavathusrāvarodhādāvityatra rodhaśabdena
                                pratīnāho+abhidhīyate| saṅkarādayaḥ saṅkaraprastarādayaḥ
                                svedādhyāyoktāḥ svedāḥ| tarkārī jayantī| srotaḥśṛṅgāṭanāsākṣiśoṣe
                                iti ghrāṇaśrotrākṣitarpaṇīnāṃ sirāṇāṃ sannipātaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaḥ| nāvanaṃ
                                tailamuktamāhaprabhāvyāje ityādi| taduṣmaṇeti ajākṣīroṣmaṇā
