                                piṣṭasvedane mandotsvinnān| sayaṣṭhyāhvacūrṇāniti
                                yaṣṭyāhvacūrṇasyāpradhānatvāt tilacūrṇāt pādikatvam| tenaiva
                                pīḍayediti ajākṣīreṇa| evaṃ niṣpannatailasya
                                daśamūlaniṣkvāthādibhirdaśakṛtvaḥ pākāt siddhaṃ tailamaṇutailaṃ
                                syāt; aṇutā cāsya aṇusrotonusāritvāt, tacceha bhāvanayā
                                pākabhūyastvena niṣpīḍanaviśeṣeṇa ca kriyate| uktaṃ hi videhe-
                                “bhāvanāt pācanādvā+api tailānāmaṇutailatā| mardanādapi sarveṣāṃ
                                dehānāmaṇutailatā” iti| siddhāmletyādinā āhārācārāvāha|
                                nivātoṣṇapratiśraya iti nivātoṣṇagṛhasthāyī||134-143||

siddhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ tailaṃ daśakṛtvo+aṇu tat
                                smṛtam

paitte sarpiḥ pibet siddhamityatra
                                śṛṅgaverasiddhameva sarpirdeyam| raktapittaghnā iti
                                raktapittacikitsoktāḥ| mandapitte iti īṣatpitte||144-148||
dantyā ca sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāt pakvapīnase
ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ yavāḥ śālirgodhūmā jāṅgalā rasāḥ

deyaṃ kaphaghnavamanamiti kaphaghnadravyakṛtaṃ
                                vamanaṃ deyamityarthaḥ| kaṭubhiḥ phalairiti maricapippalyādibhiḥ|
                                pākānmukte iti pākāvasānāccyute| vyāhate vega iti pīnasasya vege
                                mandībhūte| śophe ceti nāsāśophe||149-157||
svedāḥ sekāśca pākārthaṃ lipte śirasi sarpiṣā
manaḥśilā vacā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ hiṅgu gugguluḥ
mūtre lākṣā vacā lambā viḍaṅgaṃ kuṣṭhapippalī

kṛtvā kalkaṃ karañjaṃ ca tailaṃ taiḥ sārṣapaṃ
                                pacet
sarvajit pīnase duṣṭe kāryaṃ śophe ca śophajit

mayūraṃ pakṣādivarjitaṃ
                                jaladroṇe eva pacet| jaladroṇo hyatra kvāthārthaṃ pādāvaśeṣaḥ san
                                ghṛtaprasthāccaturguṇo bhavati| kiñca daśamūlādīnāṃ
                                catvāriṃśatpalena mayūreṇaikena samamadūrāntaraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ
                                kvāthyaṃ droṇamāne jale deyam| kiṃvā daśamūlādīnāṃ mayūreṇa ca
                                militvā yāvat kvāthyaṃ bhavati taccaturguṇaṃ
                                jalamutsargaparibhāṣayaiva deyam| madhurairiti
                                jīvanīyagaṇauktairdaśabhiḥ, jīvanīyāni hi madhuratvaprakarṣādiha
                                madhuraśabdenocyante||158-165||
vātike śiraso roge snehān svedān sanāvanān

jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ
                                pacet

etenaiveti daśamūlādimayūrakvāthena
                                yathoktavidhānakṛtena| dvitīyakharjūraśabdena kharjūraphalaṃ
                                gṛhyate| akṣoṭavātāmādīni auttarāpathikāni|
                                pūrvayogoktakvāthavidhānaṃ yadyapyetenaiva kaṣāyeṇetyādinā siddhaṃ,
                                tathā+api punaḥ pūrvakalpeneti vacanena yathālābhamitipadena ca
                                yathālābhaṃ karaṇīyatvaṃ kalka eva, na kvāthe iti darśayati| atra
                                prayogabhede jatūkarṇaḥ- “tatkvāthocitaśikhinaṃ
                                daśamūlaśreyasībalāmadhukaistripalaiḥ saha sarpiṣā jīvanīyakarṣaiḥ
                                pacet payasā kvāthe+asminneva catuṣke prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathālābhaṃ
                                jīvanabṛṃhaṇavātāmākṣoṭatriphalāpūgamadhukaiḥ
                                kharjūratālamastakatvagelāpauṣkaraśvadaṃṣṭrātāmalakībisabhārgīkaseruśṛṅgāṭakamṛṇāla
                                rāsnāsthirāsamaṅgāśṛṅgyajaḍābhiḥ saha tu māyūraṃ
                                catuṣprayogādūrdhvajatrugadeṣvamṛtavat” iti| atra mayūrasthāne
                                mūṣakādīn darśayannāha- ākhubhirityādinā| ākhunā mayūrāpekṣayā
                                svalpamānenāpyatraikenāpi sādhanaṃ kartavyamityāhuḥ||166-175||

nasye pāne tathā+abhyaṅge bastau caiva
                                prayojayet
śirorogeṣu sarveṣu kāse śvāse ca dāruṇe
ṛtusnātā tathā nārī pītvā putraṃ prasūyate
paitte ghṛtaṃ payaḥ sekāḥ śītā lepāḥ sanāvanāḥ

śṛtairvetyatra kṣīraśṛtaiḥ| sarpiśca
                                nasyamityatra avapīḍasya paścāt sarpiṣā nasyaṃ deyam||176-179||
siddhaṃ syānnāvanaṃ cūrṇaṃ caiṣāṃ pradhamanaṃ hitam

kaphānilodbhave dāha ityatra kaphodbhave
                                anilodbhave ca suśrutavacanāllalāṭaśaṅkhadeśe dāhaḥ kartavyaḥ| uktaṃ
                                hi suśrute- “śirorogādhimanthaprabhṛtiṣu bhrūlalāṭaśaṅkhapradeśeṣu
                                dahet” (su.sū.a.12) iti| gandhairakuṣṭhatagarairiti
                                agurvādigandhaiḥ, kuṣṭhatagaravarjanaṃ cātra
                                mastuluṅgasrāvavarjanārtham| uktaṃ ca śālākye- “natakuṣṭhe srāvayato
                                dhūmavartiprayojite| mastuluṅgaṃ prakarṣeṇa tasmātte naiva yojayet”
                                iti| vyāghrakarajaḥ nakhī| kṣavathuḥ chikkākārakaḥ||180-186||-

śuktetyādi mukharogacikitsitam| śuddhiradha iti
                                virecanam| dārvītvagiti dārvyāstvag| rujāpahamiti rogapīḍāharam|
                                pañcakoletyādau cūrṇasamudāyādguḍo dviguṇaḥ| karkandhūmātrā iti
                                aṣṭamāṣakamānāḥ| kecid rodhrasthāne lohaṃ paṭhanti; uktaṃ hi
                                śālākye- “pāṭhā rasāñjanaṃ vyoṣaṃ tejohvā triphalā+agnikaḥ|
                                gṛhadhūmo yavakṣāro śastraṃ cūrṇaṃ tu kālakam” iti|
                                vātapittakaphāpahā iti pratyekameva kālādayastrayo
                                yogāstridoṣaharāḥ| rasakriyeti ghanībhūtarasasya sañjñā| tāluśoṣe
                                ityādau atṛṣṇasyetipadena tṛṣṇāyuktasya tāluśoṣe auttarabhaktikamapi
                                sarpiḥpānaṃ niṣedhayati| tāluśoṣe ca “tṛṣṇāmūrcchāparītāśca
                                garbhiṇyastāluśoṣiṇaḥ” (sū.a.13) ityādinā yadyapi snehapānaṃ
                                niṣiddhaṃ, tathā+apīha auttarabhaktikaṃ sarpirviśeṣavidhānāt
                                kartavyameva| sirākarmeti sirāvyadhanaṃ; tacca suśrutavacanāt tāluni
                                jihvāyāṃ ca kartavyam||187-205||

pāṭhāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ lodhraṃ dārvīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca
                                cūrṇayet
guḍe purāṇe dviguṇe kvathite guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ
mukharogeṣu ca śreṣṭhaṃ pītakaṃ nāma kīrtitam

mṛdvīkā kaṭukā vyoṣaṃ dārvītvak triphalā
                                ghanam
pāṭhā rasāñjanaṃ mūrvā tejohveti ca cūrṇitam
nāvanaṃ madhurāḥ snigdhāḥ śītāścaiva rasā hitāḥ

droṇaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtvā bhūyaḥ
                                pacecchanaiḥ
tailaṃ cānena kalkena kaṣāyeṇa ca sādhayet

tulāmityādinā khadirādiguṭikāmāha|
                                dviguṇāmarimedasa iti viṭkhadirasya tu tule dve eva| pattaṅgaṃ
                                raktacandanam| lavaṅgādīnāmatra palamānatvam| dantāsyagalarogāḥ
                                śālākyoktā jñeyāḥ| parāyaṇamiti paramayanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bheṣajamiti
                                yāvat| iti mukharogacikitsā||206-214||
bastiṃ samīraṇe, pitte virekaṃ, vamanaṃ kaphe

arocakacikitsāmāha- arucāvityādi| kuṣṭhetyādinā
                                ardhaślokoktāścatvāro yogā vātapittakaphasannipātajeṣvarocakeṣu
                                kramājjñeyāḥ||215-220||

varāṭakānityādau tadbhasmeti varāṭakadāhabhasma|
                                ścyotayet gālayet| gandhatailamiti sugandhadravyakalkayuktaṃ tailaṃ,
                                kiṃvā gandhadravyādhivāsitaṃ tilodbhavaṃ tailam| śuṣkamūlaketyādike
                                kṣārataile madhuśuktaṃ caturguṇamiti madhupradhānaṃ śuktaṃ
                                caturguṇam| śuktaṃ ca “yanmastvādi śucau bhāṇḍe
                                saguḍakṣaudranāgaram| dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ
                                taducyate” iti| mātuluṅgakadalīrasau telasamau| anye tu
                                madhuśuktāvubhāvapi dāpayanti; tatra madhu tailasamaṃ, śuktaṃ tu
                                caturguṇamiti vadanti; tannātihṛdayaṅgamaṃ, yato jatūkarṇe madhu na
                                paṭhyata eva, madhunaḥ śuktagrahaṇenaiva gṛhītatvāt| uktaṃ ca-
                                “mūlakabhasmaśatāhvādvikṣāravacācaturlavaṇakuṣṭhadārurasāñjananāgaraśobhāñjanahiṅgughanabhūrjairmātuluṅgakadalīrasaiścaturguṇaśuktaistailaṃ
                                vipakvaṃ śrutinādabādhiryaśūlajantughnam” iti||221-230||
karṇaśūle tu vātaghnī hitā pīnasavat kriyā

bhojyāni ca yathādoṣaṃ kuryāt snehāṃśca
                                pūraṇān
śatapuṣpā vacā kuṣṭhaṃ dāru śigru rasāñjanam

utpannamātre ityādinā netrarogacikitsitamāha|
                                biḍālakaḥ netrabahirlepaḥ śālākye ucyate| nighṛṣṭamityādau tadvaditi
                                rasakriyetyarthaḥ| harītakī tadvaditi harītakīghṛtayukto biḍālakaḥ|
                                sannipāte tu sarvairiti pratyekavātādyuktabiḍālakadravyaiḥ
                                pralepanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ| netrāñjanaṃ tryahādityatra
                                prāyo+akṣirogāṇāṃ tryaheṇa pākāt tryahādityuktam| pākalakṣaṇaṃ
                                tantrāntare- “praśastavartmatā cākṣṇoḥ saṃrambhāśrupraśāntatā|
                                mandavedanatā kaṇḍūḥ pakvākṣigadalakṣaṇam” iti| āścyotanam
                                akṣisekaḥ| sumanaḥkorakāḥ jātīmukulakāḥ| śvetamaricaṃ
                                śobhāñjanabījam| plavaḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ prasevakagalaḥ| dvau ca
                                pippalyarṇavaphenayoriti śāṇāvityarthaḥ| citrāyāmiti citrānakṣatre|
                                tāpyo dhātuḥ tāpīnadībhavo mākṣikadhātuḥ| cakṣuṣyā vanakulatthikā|
                                pauṣpamañjanaṃ puṣpāñjanam| abhinnacakṣuṣa iti abhinnatārakasya|
                                kṛṣṇasarpasyeti mṛtakṛṣṇasarpasya||231-261||-
kaphe kāryā tathā kṣaudraṃ priyaṅguḥ samanaḥśilā

‘prakṣālya spṛśatā kāryaṃ
                                    samyagnetrāñjanaṃ tryahāt’ iti pā.;
amṛtāhvā bisaṃ bilvaṃ paṭolaṃ chāgalaṃ śakṛt
toye paktvā rase pūte bhūyaḥ pakve rase ghane

saindhavaṃ śaukarī daṃṣṭrā katakaṃ cāñjanaṃ
                                śubham

katakasya phalaṃ śaṅkhaḥ saindhavaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ
                                sitā
timiraṃ paṭalaṃ kācaṃ malaṃ cāśu sukhāvatī
nīlotpalaṃ viḍaṅgāni phenaṃ ca saritāṃ pateḥ
saptarātraṃ sthitaṃ bhūyaḥ piṣṭvā kṣīreṇa vartayet

khālitye ityādinā khālityādicikitsitamāha|
                                harilomnīti kapilalomnī| sahacaraḥ jhiṇṭī| śilāsame bhāṇḍe iti
                                aśmamaye pātre vā meṣaśṛṅge saṃsthitaḥ| ādityaparṇyā mūlānīti
                                ādityaparṇī sūryāvartaḥ| kṛṣṇasairīyakaḥ kṛṣṇajhiṇṭī| somarājī
                                bākucī| śastraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ loham| kṛṣṇapiṇḍitacitrakāviti
                                kṛṣṇamadanakṛṣṇacitrakau| ādityapākamiti ādityaraśmisambandhādeva
                                pakvam| atra bhāgairiti bahuvacanāt pṛthagbhāge siddhe+api pṛthagiti
                                padaṃ nyāyasiddhasyāpi triphalāpṛthagbhāgasya dyotanārtham|
                                kalkabhūyastvaṃ cātra vacanādeva bhavannapi kalpanīyam| tilāḥ
                                sāmalakā ityādiyogāḥ keśarañjakāḥ| pacet saindhavetyādau
                                saindhavāyaścūrṇataṇḍulānāṃ samatvam| śuddhamiti prakṣālitam| śeṣeṣu
                                rogeṣviti tṛṭśvāsakāsajvararaktapittaśoṣeṣu pīnasopadravatayokteṣu|
                                śeṣeṣvādau ca nirdiṣṭā ityatra śeṣaśabdena
                                anuktatrimarmajarogagrahaṇam| ādau nirdiṣṭā iti sāmānyādihaiva

                                tajjānāmiti pañcavātajānām| sūtre iti mahārogādhyāye (sū.a.20)|
                                ucyamānāniti nakhabhedādīn yathāsthūlamucyamānān| paryāyairiti
                                sañjñāntaraiḥ| kathaṃ punaste+aśītinakhabhedādyā upadiṣṭāḥ? ucyate-
                                kevalaṃ vāyumuddiśya kecidgadā vepathvādaya uktāḥ, tathā cāvṛtaṃ
                                vātamuddiśya keciduktāḥ “liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhastṛṣṇā”
                                ityādinā||12-14||

samprati nidānamāha- rūkṣetyādi|
                                viṣamādupacārāditi upacāravairūpyāt| doṣāsṛgityādau doṣaśabdena
                                purīṣamapi gṛhyate| apataṃsanaṃ gajādibhyaḥ patanaṃ, kiṃvā
                                avataṃsanaṃ dhātūnāṃ karṣaṇam; uktaṃ hi kharanāde-
                                “vilikhatyatitaikṣṇyādyat smṛtamullekhanaṃ hi tat|
                                vikarṣatyatidhātūn yattaccoktamava(pa)taṃsanam” iti| riktānīti
                                tucchāni, snehādiguṇaśūnyānītyarthaḥ||15-18||-

laghutā punariti
                                vātavyādhīnāmapāyo+apagamanaṃ śarīrasya laghutā
                                vātavyādhiliṅgavigamena, śarīrakalyateti yāvat; kiṃvā apāyo laghutā
                                na sarvathā vātaliṅgābhāvaḥ, yena prakṛtaliṅgāni santyeva||19||-

kupitānāṃ kāryamāha- saṅkoca ityādi| ete ca
                                saṅkocādayo vyādhayo+api bhavanti; uktaṃ hi- “vyādhayaste tadātve tu
                                liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ” (ni.a.8) iti| huṇḍanaṃ
                                śiraḥprabhṛtīnāmantaḥpraveśaḥ; anye tu keśabhūmisphuṭanaṃ
                                śaṅkhalalāṭabhedaśca śirohuṇḍanaṃ, nāsāhuṇḍanaṃ ghrāṇanāśaḥ,
                                akṣihuṇḍanam akṣivyudāsaḥ, jatruhuṇḍanaṃ vakṣoparodhaḥ,
                                grīvāhuṇḍanaṃ grīvāstambhaḥ| vātavyādhiviśeṣotpāde hetumāha-
                                hetusthānaviśeṣādityādi| hetuviśeṣaḥ pittāvaraṇādiḥ, sthānaviśeṣaḥ
                                koṣṭhādiḥ, kiṃvā hetukṛtaḥ sthānaviśeṣaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “prakupitāstu
                                prakopaṇaviśeṣād dūṣyaviśeṣān dūṣayantaḥ” (vi.a.6) ityādi| kecittu
                                ‘dehe sthānaviśeṣācca’ iti paṭhanti||20-23||-

sthānaviśeṣakṛtameva vyādhibhedamāha- tatra
                                koṣṭhāśrite ityādi| sarvāṅgakupite iti kṛtsnadehakupite| gudasthite
                                iti uttaragudasthite| ātanyate vistāryate| bhuktasya stambha iti
                                bhuktavato gātrastambho bhavatīti| gurvaṅgamityādi māṃsage medege ca
                                lakṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ, tathā bhedo+asthiparvaṇāmityādi asthimajjagayoḥ
                                samānaṃ lakṣaṇam| samāne+api lakṣaṇe
                                vividhāśitapītīyoktaviśiṣṭadhātulakṣaṇairviśeṣa unneyaḥ| santateti
                                    sānubandhā

| kṣipraṃ muñcati
                                badhnātīti vyavāyakāle kṣipraṃ muñcati vā ciraṃ dhārayate, tathā
                                garbhamapi kṣipraṃ muñcati vā ciraṃ dhārayati| vikṛtamiti
                                vyaṅgatvādinānāvikārayuktaṃ garbhaṃ janayati| bāhyetyādinā
                                snāyugatavātalakṣaṇatvenoktāni bahirāyāmādīnyagre
                                    vaktavyāni

|
                                mandarukśophamiti mandarujaṃ mandaśophaṃ ca| suptā iti
                                niḥspandāḥ||24-37||-
tvagrūkṣā sphuṭitā suptā kṛśā kṛṣṇā ca tudyate

kṣipraṃ muñcati badhnāti śukraṃ garbhamathāpi
                                vā
suptāstanvyo mahatyo vā sirā vāte sirāgate

idānīmatibalān
                                vātavikārānabhidhātumudyato+arditamāha- ativṛddha ityādi|
                                ativṛddhagrahaṇena vāyorbalavatprakopamāha| ekamiti vāmaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ
                                vā saṅkocayati bāhuṃ, pādaṃ, jānu ca; vakraṃ ca jihmaṃ karoti|
                                vakraṃ vrajati bhojanamiti na samaṃ mukhena khādati, kintu
                                vakraikadeśena| dīneti agambhīrā| jihmeti kuṭilā| samutkṣipteti
                                atitvaritā| kaleti avyaktā| bādhyete śravaṇāviti yadyapi
                                ekapārśvāśrayo vikāro+ayaṃ, tathā+api prabhāvāt karṇayorbādhā+atra
                                bhavati| kevala iti ardhe eva na kṛtsne| nanu yadā
                                dehārdhavyāpitvamarditasya tadā+arditena ardhāṅgasya ko bhedaḥ?
                                brūmaḥ-ardito vegitayā na sarvakālaṃ bhavati, ardhāṅgastu sarvakālaṃ
                                vyāpya bhavati; uktaṃ hi- “svasthaḥ syādarditādīnāṃ muhurvegāgame
                                gate” iti| kiṃvā yathoktaviśiṣṭalakṣaṇo+arditaḥ, ardhāṅge tu naitāni
                                sarvāṇi bhavanti||38-42||
yadā tadopaśoṣyāsṛgbāhuṃ pādaṃ ca jānu ca
tasmin saṅkocayatyardhe mukhaṃ jihmaṃ karoti ca

manye ityādinā antarāyāmamāha| antaryadā nāḍīḥ
                                prapadyate iti manyāsambaddhā eva antargatāḥ sirāḥ prapadyata
                                ityarthaḥ| antarāyāmasañjñitamiti evaṃvidho manyāstambha antarāyāma
                                ucyate; aparastu manyāstambho vakṣyamāṇabahirāyāma iti vaktavyaḥ|
                                tantrāntare tu manyāstambha āyāmayoḥ pūrvarūpatvenoktaḥ|
                                antarāyamyata iti antaḥ
antarāyamyate grīvā manyā ca stabhyate bhṛśam

pṛṣṭhetyādi bahirāyāmalakṣaṇam| pṛṣṭhamanyāśritā
                                iti pṛṣṭhānugatamanyāsambaddhāḥ| bāhyā iti sirāviśeṣaṇam| bāhyāśca
                                sirāḥ pṛṣṭhagatā eva| kecittu pṛṣṭhamanyāśrita iti vātaviśeṣaṇaṃ
                                paṭhanti| pṛṣṭhato nīyate iti pṛṣṭhaṃ prati ākṛṣyate| jātavega iti
                                    udvegaḥ

| etau cāyāmau
                                “bāhyābhyantaramāyāmaṃ khallīṃ kubjatvameva ca| sarvaikāṅgarogāṃśca
                                kuryāt snāyugato+anilaḥ” ityanena snāyugatānilajanyāvuktau, iha ca
                                sirāgatavātajanyatvenoktau, tenobhayavacanāt
                                sirāsnāyugatavātajanyāveva bhavataḥ| uktaṃ hyanyatra- “mahāheturbalī
                                vāyuḥ sirāḥ sasnāyukaṇḍarāḥ| manyāpṛṣṭhāśritā bāhyāḥ
                                saṃśoṣyāyāmayedbahiḥ” ityādi||45-48||

hanustambhasaṅkocayorlakṣaṇamāha- hanumūle
                                sthita ityādi| saṃsrayatīti cyāvayati| vivṛtāsyatvamathaveti
                                atrāthavāśabdena saṃvṛtavaktratā pākṣikī cāpekṣate| saṃstabhyeti
                                niścalīkṛtya saṃvṛtamukhatāṃ karoti| etaddvayamapi hanustambha
                                eva||49||-

pāṇipādaṃ ca saṃśoṣyetyādi
                                daṇḍākṣepakasamprāptikathanam| pāṇipādaśira ityādi
                                daṇḍakalakṣaṇam||51||-

arditādīnāṃ daṇḍakāntānāṃ samānaṃ rūpamāha-
                                svasthaḥ syādityādi| arditahanustambhādiṣu yatra muhurmuhurvegitvaṃ
                                dṛśyate tadarditāntargatameva jñeyam||52||-

hatvaikamityādi pakṣavadhalakṣaṇam|
                                gṛhītvā+ardhamityādi ekāṅgalakṣaṇam| sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadehajamiti
                                sarvāṅgalakṣaṇam||53-55||
hatvaikaṃ mārutaḥ pakṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vāmameva vā

kaṭipṛṣṭhorujānujaṅghāpadaṃ gṛhṇāti sā gṛdhrasī vātāt; vātakaphāttu
                                sā pūrvoktalakṣaṇā

satī
                                tandrādyanvitā bhavati; evaṃ gṛdhrasīdvayaṃ “dve gṛdhrasyau vātād
                                vātakaphācca” (sū.a.19) ityanenoktaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati||56-57||

anuktanakhabhedādiparigrahārthamāha-
                                sthānānāmityādi| śeṣān nakhabhedādīn
                                nakhagulphādīnāmanurūpairliṅgairbhedaśūlādibhirnirdiśediti jñeyam|
                                kicit ‘sthānanāmānurūpaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| tatra nakhasthānānurūpaṃ
                                bhedasañjñānurūpaṃ ca liṅgaṃ nakhasphuṭanarūpaṃ bhavati| evaṃ
                                cāparavātavikāreṣvapi mahārogokteṣu
                                sthānānurūpaliṅgayogo+anusartavyaḥ|58|-

vātasya pittādisaṃsargaṃ jñāpayannāha-
                                sarveṣvityādi| pittādyairiti pittakapharaktapurīṣādibhiḥ|
                                athāvṛtasya vāyoḥ kathaṃ kupitatvaṃ bhavati yāvatā āvṛto durbala eva
                                bhavatītyāha- vāyorityādi| dhātukṣayāditi sārakṣayāt| mārgāvaraṇena
                                vegapratibandhādeva kupito bhavati| atha bhavatu
                                mārgarodhādvātakopaḥ, āvarakeṇa tu pittena kaphena cāsya kathaṃ na
                                sambandho bhavatītyāha- vātapittetyādi| tritayamelake+api vāyoḥ
                                prādhānyamāha- vāyureva hi sūkṣmatvāditi; sūkṣmamārgānusāritayā
                                prerakatvāt| tasmāt triṣvapi doṣeṣu vāyurevoktanyāyena pradhānam,
                                ataḥ kupitaḥ pittakaphau samuddhūya tābhyāmāvṛtamārgo+api tatra
                                tatra pradeśe gadān karoti; tathā rasādīṃśca tatra tatra kṣipan
                                saṃśoṣayet||58-60||-
kupitastau samuddhūya tatra tatra kṣipan gadān

āvaraṇakṛtaṃ vātakopaṃ darśayitvā
                                āvaraṇaviśeṣakṛtaṃ liṅgamāha- liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte ityādi|
                                kaṭvādyupaśaya iti kaṭūṣṇādikaphaviparītairupaśayaḥ| adhikamiti
                                vātaharairapyupaśayo nādhiko bhavatīti darśayati| māṃsage iti
                                māṃsāvṛte| māṃsagatasya raktādigatasya ca vātasya pūrvameva
                                lakṣaṇamuktam, iha tu raktādyāvṛtasya lakṣaṇamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ|
                                āḍhyavāteti āyurvedasañjñeyaṃ medasā+a+avṛtavātasya| svasthāne iti
                                pakvāśaye| parikṛntati parikartikāṃ janayati||61-71||-
harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca sañcāra iva māṃsage
āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasā+a+avṛtaḥ
śūlaṃ tu pīḍyamāne ca pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham
vrajatyāśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ
cirāt pīḍitamannena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ śakṛt sṛjet

sādhyāsādhyavibhāgamāha- sandhicyutirityādi|
                                atra kubjatvapaṅgutvādayo yadyapi sākṣānna prapañcitāstathā+api
                                śeṣātideśenaiva tallakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| khuḍavātatā gulphavātatā, kiṃvā
                                sandhigatavātatā| majjāsthigā iti
                                majjāsthyāvṛtamajjāsthigatavātajanyā ityarthaḥ| sthānasya
                                gāmbhīryāditi gambhīrasthānāśritatvāt; anye tu gāmbhīryaṃ
                                kṛtāspadatvamāhuḥ| yatnāt sidhyanti vā naveti
                                pākṣikasiddhivacanamitaravaidyābhiprāyeṇa jñeyam; ācāryastu
                                ācāryaprakhyo vā vaidyaḥ sādhayatyeva balāt, itaravaidyastu nāvaśyaṃ
                                sarvatrāvyāhatajñāno bhavati, tena saṃśayābhidhānaṃ; tataśca na
                                pāramārthikī sandigdhatā etādṛśānāṃ sādhyatāṃ pratīti jñeyam|
                                navānāmapyeṣāṃ nirupadravatayā sādhyatāmāha- navānityādi|
                                upadravāścātra śṛṅgagrāhikayā+anuktā api sāmānyopadravalakṣaṇayuktā
                                eva kecidgadā vijñeyāḥ; kiṃvā adhyāyaśeṣe ‘hṛdrogo vidradhiḥ’
                                ityādinā vakṣyamāṇā upadravā jñeyāḥ||72-74||

ete sthānasya gāmbhīryādyatnāt sidhyanti vā na
                                vā

avasaraprāptāṃ kriyāmāha- kriyāmata ityādi|
                                kevalamityādau kevalamiti asaṃsṛṣṭam| nirupastambhamiti anāvṛtam|
                                kaiḥ? snehaiḥ| kathaṃ copācaredityāha-
                                sarpirvasātailamajjapānairiti| snehapānaprayogānantaraṃ
                                kartavyamāha- naraṃ tataḥ snehaklāntamityādi| snehaklāntamiti
                                snehapānodvignaṃ snehaglānaṃ ca| samāśvāsyeti
                                    viśramayitvā

|
                                snehayeditipadaṃ tarpaṇaiḥ pānairityantaṃ yāvadanuvartate| anyairiti
                                kuṭībhūsvedādibhiḥ| yathāyogamiti sarvathā snehapūrvakasvedam|
                                snehapūrvakasvedaguṇamāha- snehāktaṃ svinnamityādi| svedādhyāye
                                “snehapūrvaṃ prayuktena” (sū.a.14) ityādinokto+apyayaṃ
                                snehapūrvakasvedaguṇaḥ punaḥ prakaraṇāgatatvāducyate| āśu prayojita
                                iti padaṃ puṣṇātītyanena sambadhyate| anilāmayā na tiṣṭhanti na
                                sthāyino bhavantītyarthaḥ||75-82||-

yadyanena sadoṣatvādityādi| atra kevalo
                                nirupastambhaśca vāyuścikitsyatvenādhikṛtaḥ, tasya
                                sadoṣatvamanupapannaṃ; tataḥ sadoṣatvaṃ karmaṇi yojanīyaṃ; tena
                                karmaṇo+aviśuddhatvād vāyurna praśāmyati,
                                karmaṇaścoktasyāpyatrāśuddhirmalajanakatvāt; vakṣyati hi
                                “snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyairāhārairhi malaścitaḥ” ityādi| kiṃvā
                                sadoṣatvādityanenottarakālīnaṃ vāyoḥ saṃśamanamucyate,
                                asaṃsṛṣṭatvamanupastambhatvaṃ ca yaduktaṃ tadupakramārambhakāle
                                jñeyam| sadoṣatvaṃ ca snehaprayogeṇānupaśame saṃśodhanakaraṇe ca
                                hetuḥ| samalatvamevottarakālīnaṃ kuto bhavatītyāha- snigdhetyādi|
                                durbalo yo+avirecya iti durbalatvaprakarṣeṇāvirecya ityarthaḥ| tathā
                                hi “anāsthāpyāstvajīrṇī” (si.a.2) ityādau atidurbalaḥ paṭhitaḥ|
                                atyarthaṃ durbalatayā bastyanarhe+api vidhimāha-
                                pācanairdīpanīyaiśceti| pācanaṃ kiñcinna dīpanaṃ, yathā paṭolaṃ
                                dīpanaṃ; dīpanaṃ kiñcinna pācanaṃ yathā triphalā; uktaṃ hi suśrute-
                                “triphalā kaphapittaghnī mehakuṣṭhavināśinī| cakṣuṣyā dīpanī ca”
                                (su.sū.a.38) iti; ataḥ pācanairityasya dīpanairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtam|
                                bhojyairvā tadyutairiti pācanadīpanasaṃyuktairbhojyaiḥ| utthite
                                cāgnau iti dīpte vahnau||83-88||-

sthānaviśeṣeṇa kriyāviśeṣamāha-
                                viśeṣatastvityādinā adho nābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍaka ityantena| kṣāraṃ
                                yavakṣāram, uktaṃ hi “yāvaśūkaḥ sraṃsanīyapācanīyārśoghnānāṃ”
                                (sū.a.25); kiṃvā kṣāramiti grahaṇyādinirdiṣṭaṃ dīpanakṣāram|
                                udāvartanutkarma trimarmīye “taṃ tailaśītajvaranāśanāktaṃ” (ci.a.26)
                                ityādinoktaṃ jñeyam| svedā ityādi tvaggatānilacikitsitam| praharṣaḥ
                                manoharṣaṇam| virecanānantaraṃ pratibhojito viriktapratibhuktaḥ|
                                pūrvoktāmiti śukrajananaharṣiṇīṃ kriyām| utthāpane iti puṣṭijanane
                                sitādibhiḥ siddhaṃ payo hitam| aṃśumatī śālaparṇī|| matsyāniti
                                nābhipradeśe kupite vāte matsyā bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ samaṃ siddhā deyāḥ|
                                nābhipradeśakopaśca vātasyānukto+apīha tatra
                                bhavaśūlatodādibhirjñeyaḥ| veṣṭyamāna iti avamoṭyamāne| upanāhanaṃ
                                ca vātaharadravyaireva kartavyam| nasye pāne ca auttarabhaktikaṃ
                                māṣasaindhavasādhitameva tailaṃ jñeyam| tatra ca māṣasya kvāthaḥ,
                                saindhavasya kalkaḥ| sarpiṣo+avapīḍakaḥ yatra sarpiḥ pītvā
                                tatpīḍakamannaṃ bhujyate||89-98||-
garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānāṃ cāpi śuṣyatām

                                kevalavātapīḍitāḥ| ghṛtamaṇḍaḥ ghṛtasyoparitano bhāgaḥ| śuktiḥ

karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataścaran

vātaśoṇitasya avagāḍhānavagāḍhabhedaṃ
                                cikitsārthamāha- uttānamityādi| antarāśrayamiti
                                tvaṅmāṃsavyatiriktagambhīradhātvāśrayam| sarvairliṅgairiti
                                uttānagambhīravātaraktoktairmilitaiḥ| ayaṃ ca tṛtīyaḥ prakāro
                                bāhyābhyantaraprakāroktaprakāragṛhīta eveti kṛtvā rogasaṅgrahe
                                dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitamuktam| “dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitamuttānamavagāḍhaṃ
                                cetyeke bhāṣante; tattu na samyak, kasmāt? kuṣṭhavaduttānaṃ bhūtvā
                                kālāntareṇāvagāḍhībhavati” (su.ci.a.5) ityanena suśrutena
                                yaddvaividhyaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tadācāryayoḥ paramātmanoḥ
                                suśrutāgniveśayorekasyāpyaprāmāṇyaṃ na saṅgatamiti kṛtvā
                                avirodhamevātra vyākhyānayāmaḥ; tathāhi- suśrutena uttānaṃ
                                vātaśoṇitaṃ kuṣṭhavadgambhīraṃ bhavatītyucyate, na tu
                                sarvamevottānaṃ bhūtvā gambhīraṃ bhavatīti pratijñāyate; tena yo
                                brūte- uttānamevāvatiṣṭhate, taṃ prati suśrutavacanaṃ bādhakaṃ;
                                tanna, carake uttānamevāvatiṣṭhate iti nocyata eva, kintu
                                prathamotpattau kiñciduttānamutpadyate, kiñcittu gambhīramiti, tena
                                na virodhaścarakasuśrutayoḥ||19-23||

tatra vāte+adhike ityādau rakte pitte kaphe vā
                                ‘adhike’ ityanuvartanīyaṃ; tena pittavṛddhiḥ, śoṇitavṛddhiḥ,
                                kaphavṛddhiśca jñeyā| saṃsṛṣṭeṣviti dvitriṣu militeṣu samasteṣviti
                                catuḥṣvapi militeṣvadhikeṣu| sirāyāmetyādinā vātādyulbaṇānāṃ
                                caturṇāṃ lakṣaṇamāha| āyāmaḥ vistaraṇam| śyāvatā śyāvavarṇatvam|
                                śvayathurityādinā asṛjītyantena udriktaraktasya

lakṣaṇam| dvandvatridoṣajamityatra
                                adhikaśoṇitānubandho+api gṛhītavyaḥ; tena
                                vātādicatuṣṭayādhikamelakamapi vātaśoṇitaṃ jñeyam| ata eva
                                ekadvitrisarvādhikabhedād dvividhasyāpi vātaśoṇitasya
                                pūrvaṭīkākṛdbhiḥ pañcacatvāriṃśadbhedā uktāḥ| kharanādena tu
                                prakaraṇāntareṇa ṣaṭtriṃśadvidhamuktam| uktaṃ hi- “vātottaraṃ
                                pravṛddhāsṛk pañcatriṃśadvidhaṃ matam| pittāttriṃśadvidhaṃ yogāt
                                kaphāddaśavidhaṃ matam” iti| ete bhedā anatiprayojanatvānna
                                vivṛtāḥ||24-29||

tatra vāte+adhike vā syādrakte pitte kaphe+api

vidāho vedanā mūrcchā svedastṛṣṇā mado bhramaḥ

staimityaṃ gauravaṃ snehaḥ suptirmandā ca ruk
                                kaphe

sādhyādivibhāgamāha- ekadoṣānugamityādi| yasya
                                ca syurupadravā iti sādhyatvenoktasyāpi
                                vakṣyamāṇopadravayogādasādhyatā| tridoṣasyāsādhyatve+api yadvakṣyati
                                ‘khajena mathitā peyā vātarakte tridoṣaje’ iti,
                                tadasampūrṇalakṣaṇābhinavatridoṣajābhiprāyeṇa| mūrcchāyaḥ mūrcchā|

                                raktamārgamityādi| raktasya mārgaṃ māruto nihanti śākhāsandhiṣu
                                niviśyeti śākhāsandhiṣu sthitvā, tataśca vāyunā raktanirodhāt,
                                anyonyamāvāryeti raktena vātaṃ vātena ca raktamāvārya, vātaraktaṃ
                                vedanābhirharedasūmiti yojyam| ata evātra vātaśoṇite asṛgvimuñcediti
                                bhāvaḥ| asṛṅmokṣaṇena āvaraṇavyapagamādvāyurapi prasanno bhavati,

                                sthānāntaraprasaraṇaśīlam| aṅgaglānāviti aṅgaśoṣe| srāvaṇāhe
                                śoṇite+apyatisrāvaṇāddoṣamāha- gambhīramityādi| khāñjyādīniti

deśāddeśaṃ vrajat srāvyaṃ sirābhiḥ pracchanena

aṅgaglānau na tu srāvyaṃ rūkṣe vātottare ca

virecanavidhāne snehayuktai rūkṣaurveti

viśeṣamiti viśiṣṭacikitsitam| bāhyamiti uttānam|

vyañjanārthaṃ, tathā gavyaṃ māhiṣājaṃ payo hitam

nīvāraḥ uḍikā| sauvarcalamiti sūryāvartaśākam|

vātarakte kṣate kṣīṇe vīsarpe paittike jvare

samyak siddhaṃ ca vijñāya suguptaṃ

dve pañcamūle ityādau varṣābhūḥ śvetapunarnavā|

drākṣetyādau sasitopalamiti prakṣiptaśarkaram|

                                dhānvaprātudavaiṣkiramiti vasāmajjaviśeṣaṇam||71-75||

sthiretyādau catuḥkṣīramiti caturguṇaṃ kṣīram|
                                pṛthak tailaṃ pṛthagghṛtamityanena sammiśrapākaṃ niṣedhayati|
                                kṣīratriguṇa sārdhabhāgā śarkarā yasyāṃ mātrāyāṃ sā kṣīra
                                triguṇā+adhyardhaśarkarā| khajaḥpañcāṅgulo hastaḥ, manthānaṃ vā|

                                dvisitopala iti śarkarāpaladvayayuktaḥ| iyaṃ ca kṣīramātrā
                                uttamāgnīn prati| dhāroṣṇamiti dohakāladhārāpatitamagniyogādvinā
                                uṣṇībhūtam| mūtraṃ cātra kṣīrasamam| satrivṛccūrṇaṃ dhāroṣṇaṃ
                                kṣīramiti sambandhaḥ| prayogeṇeti abhyāsena| kṣīrapradhāno bastiḥ
                                kṣīrabastiḥ||76-87||
kāśmaryāṇyātmaguptā ca vṛścīro dve bale tathā

eṣāṃ kvāthe catuḥkṣīraṃ pṛthak tailaṃ
                                pṛthagghṛtam
tailaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca pāyayedvā sumūrcchitam
triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ vā pibet kṣaudreṇa saṃyutam

madhuyaṣṭyā ityādau madhukatulāyāṃ jaladroṇaṃ
                                dattvā tailāḍhakamānaḥ kvātho bhavati| varī śatāvarī| haṃsapadī
                                svanāmakhyātā| payasyā arkapuṣpī| vitunnakaṃ dhānyakam|
                                catuṣprayogāditi pānābhyaṅgabastinasyaprayogāt||88-95||

guḍūcītyādau guḍūcyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ
                                śatapalatvaṃ, kolādīnāṃ pratyekamāḍhakamānatvam| kāśmaryāṇāmiti
                                gaṅgārīphalānām| sārvayaugikamiti pānādicatuṣprayoge yaugikam|
                                prasavanamiti prasūtikārakam||96-109||

padmavetasetyādau phenilā upodikā|
                                sauvīrasammitamiti snehasamaṃ sauvīrakam| lodhrādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ,
                                kuṅkumaṃ ca dvikārṣikam||110-113||

śatena yaṣṭimadhukādityādau yaṣṭīmadhupalaśataṃ
                                daśaguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhyaṃ, tena caturbhāgasthitena kṣīreṇa tailaṃ

                                madhukapalaśatāt siddhamityarthaḥ| anena ca
                                madhukapalaśatasādhanopadeśena śataṃ kṛtvetyatra śataśabdasya
                                vipulavācitāṃ niṣeṇayati||115-118||
kṣīre sādhyaṃ śataṃ kṛtvā tadevaṃ madhukācchate

balākaṣāyetyādinoktaśatasahasrapāke
                                atyarthapākāt snehakṣayaṃ paśyantaḥ śataguṇena sahasraguṇena vā
                                draveṇaikadaiva pākaṃ vyākhyānayanti; kintu tāvatī snehamātrā+atra

                                paśyāmaḥ| kiñca pratyāsanne eva pāke sadrave snehakalkoddharaṇamatra
                                kartavyaṃ, tena snehāpepakṣayai+api

guḍūcītyādau dravāt pādikaḥ sneha iti nyāyāt
                                prasthaṃ tailasya bhavati| khajitamiti mathitam||121-122||

samadhūcchiṣṭetyādau madhucchiṣṭādīni kalkaḥ,

                                vastrapūtamevaitattelaṃ kartavyamityāhuḥ| kintu,

madhurasiddhairiti jīvanīyasiddhasnehaiḥ|
                                taṇḍuletyādau pratyekaṃ tribhirambuśabdaḥ sambadhyate|

|

kupita ityādi| medasaḥ kaphasya vā ativṛddhyā

gambhīre iti avagāḍhe anuttāne vātarakte|
                                raktamākrāntamiti abhibhūtaṃ vāyunā vātavajjayediti|

,

jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak

vātaletyādau vātalāyā iti viśeṣeṇa
                                vātikayonivyāpadutpādopadarśanārtham| pipīlikāsṛptimiti
                                pipīlikāparisarpaṇākārāṃ vedanām| saśabdarukphenatanurūkṣārtaveti
                                anṛtāvapyevambhūtārtavā bhavati, tena vātikapradararūpeyaṃ

                                asṛgdarasañjñayā cikitsāprastāve vaktavyā; tena saiva pradararūpā|

raktapittakarairityādau garbhe labdhe+api
                                raktamatipravartate, tenāsyā garbho na tiṣṭhati; sāsṛjā
                                raktayonirityarthaḥ| ye tu ‘sā+aprajā’ iti paṭhanti, te “yasyāṃ
                                labdhe+api garbhe asṛgatipravartate, sā tādṛśaraktasrutyā aprajā
